 232 |     // MARK: - Private Helpers
 233 |     
 234 |     /// 递归收集文本文件
 235 |     private func collectTextFiles(in directory: URL) throws -> [URL] {
 236 |         var result: [URL] = []
 237 |         
 238 |         let fm = FileManager.default
 239 |         let contents = try fm.contentsOfDirectory(
 240 |             at: directory,
 241 |             includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isRegularFileKey, .isDirectoryKey, .fileSizeKey],
 242 |             options: [.skipsHiddenFiles]
 243 |         )
 244 |         
 245 |         for url in contents {
 246 |             let fileName = url.lastPathComponent
 247 |             
 248 |             // 跳过排除的文件
 249 |             if excludedFiles.contains(fileName) {
 250 |                 continue
 251 |             }
 252 |             
 253 |             let resourceValues = try url.resourceValues(forKeys: [.isRegularFileKey, .isDirectoryKey, .fileSizeKey])
 254 |             
 255 |             // 目录：递归处理
 256 |             if resourceValues.isDirectory == true {
 257 |                 if !excludedDirs.contains(fileName) {
 258 |                     let subFiles = try collectTextFiles(in: url)
 259 |                     result.append(contentsOf: subFiles)
 260 |                 }
 261 |                 continue
 262 |             }
 263 |             
 264 |             // 文件：检查是否是文本文件
 265 |             if resourceValues.isRegularFile == true {
 266 |                 let ext = url.pathExtension.lowercased()
 267 |                 
 268 |                 // 检查扩展名
 269 |                 guard codeExtensions.contains(ext) else { continue }
 270 |                 
 271 |                 // 检查文件大小
 272 |                 if let size = resourceValues.fileSize, size > maxFileSize {
 273 |                     logger.info("⏭️ Skipping large file: \(fileName) (\(size) bytes)")
 274 |                     continue
 275 |                 }
 276 |                 
 277 |                 result.append(url)
 278 |             }
 279 |         }
 280 |         
 281 |         return result.sorted { $0.path < $1.path }
 282 |     }
 283 |     
 284 |     /// 并行读取并合并文件内容
 285 |     private func mergeFilesParallel(_ files: [URL], basePath: URL, onProgress: ((ExtractionProgress) -> Void)?) async throws -> String {
 286 |         // 目录结构（快速生成）
 287 |         var header = "# 目录结构\n```\n"
 288 |         for file in files {
 289 |             let relativePath = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: basePath.path + "/", with: "")
 290 |             header += relativePath + "\n"
 291 |         }
 292 |         header += "```\n\n# 文件内容\n\n"
 293 |         
 294 |         // 并行读取文件
 295 |         let total = files.count
 296 |         var processedCount = 0
 297 |         
 298 |         // 使用 TaskGroup 并行读取
 299 |         let fileContents: [(Int, String)] = await withTaskGroup(of: (Int, String).self) { group in
 300 |             for (index, file) in files.enumerated() {
 301 |                 group.addTask {
 302 |                     let relativePath = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: basePath.path + "/", with: "")
 303 |                     let ext = file.pathExtension.lowercased()
 304 |                     
 305 |                     do {
 306 |                         let data = try Data(contentsOf: file)
 307 |                         guard let content = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else {
 308 |                             return (index, "## \(relativePath)\n```\n(无法解码文件内容)\n```\n")
 309 |                         }
 310 |                         
 311 |                         // 快速处理：直接截断而不是分割
 312 |                         var processedContent = content
 313 |                         if content.count > self.maxFileSize {
 314 |                             processedContent = String(content.prefix(self.maxFileSize)) + "\n... (truncated)"
 315 |                         }
 316 |                         
 317 |                         // 简化行号（只在文件开头添加）
 318 |                         let lineCount = processedContent.filter { $0 == "\n" }.count + 1
 319 |                         let numbered = self.addLineNumbersFast(processedContent)
 320 |                         
 321 |                         return (index, "## \(relativePath) (\(lineCount) lines)\n```\(ext)\n\(numbered)\n```\n")
 322 |                     } catch {
 323 |                         return (index, "## \(relativePath)\n```\n(无法读取文件内容)\n```\n")
 324 |                     }
 325 |                 }
 326 |             }
 327 |             
 328 |             var results: [(Int, String)] = []
 329 |             for await result in group {
 330 |                 results.append(result)
 331 |                 processedCount += 1
 332 |                 
 333 |                 // 回调进度
 334 |                 if let onProgress = onProgress {
 335 |                     let progress = ExtractionProgress(
 336 |                         current: processedCount,
 337 |                         total: total,
 338 |                         currentFile: files[result.0].lastPathComponent
 339 |                     )
 340 |                     await MainActor.run {
 341 |                         onProgress(progress)
 342 |                     }
 343 |                 }
 344 |             }
 345 |             return results
 346 |         }
 347 |         
 348 |         // 按原始顺序排序并合并
 349 |         let sorted = fileContents.sorted { $0.0 < $1.0 }.map { $0.1 }
 350 |         return header + sorted.joined(separator: "\n")
 351 |     }
 352 |     
 353 |     /// 快速添加行号（优化版，nonisolated 可在 TaskGroup 中调用）
 354 |     private nonisolated func addLineNumbersFast(_ content: String) -> String {
 355 |         var result = ""
 356 |         result.reserveCapacity(content.count + content.count / 10) // 预分配内存
 357 |         
 358 |         var lineNumber = 1
 359 |         var lineStart = content.startIndex
 360 |         
 361 |         for i in content.indices {
 362 |             if content[i] == "\n" {
 363 |                 let line = content[lineStart..<i]
 364 |                 result += "\(lineNumber)│ \(line)\n"
 365 |                 lineNumber += 1
 366 |                 lineStart = content.index(after: i)
 367 |             }
 368 |         }
 369 |         
 370 |         // 最后一行
 371 |         if lineStart < content.endIndex {
 372 |             let line = content[lineStart...]
 373 |             result += "\(lineNumber)│ \(line)"
 374 |         }
 375 |         
 376 |         return result
 377 |     }
 378 |     
 379 |     /// 合并文件内容（保留用于向后兼容）
 380 |     private func mergeFiles(_ files: [URL], basePath: URL) throws -> String {
 381 |         var parts: [String] = []
 382 |         
 383 |         // 添加目录结构
 384 |         parts.append("# 目录结构\n")
 385 |         parts.append("```")
 386 |         for file in files {
 387 |             let relativePath = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: basePath.path + "/", with: "")
 388 |             parts.append(relativePath)
 389 |         }
 390 |         parts.append("```\n")
 391 |         
 392 |         // 添加文件内容
 393 |         parts.append("# 文件内容\n")
 394 |         
 395 |         for file in files {
 396 |             let relativePath = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: basePath.path + "/", with: "")
 397 |             let ext = file.pathExtension.lowercased()
 398 |             
 399 |             do {
 400 |                 var content = try String(contentsOf: file, encoding: .utf8)
 401 |                 
 402 |                 // 限制行数
 403 |                 let lines = content.components(separatedBy: .newlines)
 404 |                 if lines.count > maxLines {
 405 |                     content = lines.prefix(maxLines).joined(separator: "\n")
 406 |                     content += "\n\n... (truncated, \(lines.count - maxLines) more lines)"
 407 |                 }
 408 |                 
 409 |                 // 添加带行号的内容
 410 |                 let numberedContent = addLineNumbers(content)
 411 |                 
 412 |                 parts.append("## \(relativePath)\n")
 413 |                 parts.append("```\(ext)")
 414 |                 parts.append(numberedContent)
 415 |                 parts.append("```\n")
 416 |                 
 417 |             } catch {
 418 |                 logger.warning("⚠️ Failed to read file: \(relativePath)")
 419 |                 parts.append("## \(relativePath)\n")
 420 |                 parts.append("```\n(无法读取文件内容)\n```\n")
 421 |             }
 422 |         }
 423 |         
 424 |         return parts.joined(separator: "\n")
 425 |     }
 426 |     
 427 |     /// 添加行号
 428 |     private func addLineNumbers(_ content: String) -> String {
 429 |         let lines = content.components(separatedBy: .newlines)
 430 |         let lineNumberWidth = String(lines.count).count
 431 |         
 432 |         return lines.enumerated().map { index, line in
 433 |             let lineNumber = String(format: "%\(lineNumberWidth)d", index + 1)
 434 |             return "\(lineNumber)│ \(line)"
 435 |         }.joined(separator: "\n")
 436 |     }
 437 | }

 174 |         provider.onResult = { [weak self] result in
 175 |             Task { @MainActor in
 176 |                 switch result.type {
 177 |                 case .partial:
 178 |                     // 传递完整的 TranscriptionResult
 179 |                     self?.onPartialResult?(result)
 180 |                 case .final:
 181 |                     self?.onFinalResult?(result.text)
 182 |                     self?.isProcessing = false
 183 |                 }
 184 |             }
 185 |         }
 186 |         
 187 |         provider.onError = { [weak self] error in
 188 |             Task { @MainActor in
 189 |                 self?.onError?(error)
 190 |                 self?.isProcessing = false
 191 |             }
 192 |         }
 193 |     }
 194 |     
 195 |     /// 停止录音（正常结束，等待最终识别结果）
 196 |     func stopRecording() -> String? {
 197 |         guard isRecording else { return nil }
 198 |         
 199 |         isProcessing = true
 200 |         
 201 |         // 停止音频引擎
 202 |         audioEngine?.stop()
 203 |         audioEngine?.inputNode.removeTap(onBus: 0)
 204 |         
 205 |         // 通知 Provider 结束处理
 206 |         Task {
 207 |             try? await transcriptionProvider?.finishProcessing()
 208 |         }
 209 |         
 210 |         // 关闭音频文件
 211 |         audioFile = nil
 212 |         audioEngine = nil
 213 |         
 214 |         isRecording = false
 215 |         logger.info("⏹️ Recording stopped")
 216 |         
 217 |         return tempAudioFileURL?.path
 218 |     }
 219 |     
 220 |     /// 取消录音（用户主动取消，丢弃结果）
 221 |     func cancelRecording() {
 222 |         // 即使不在录音状态，也要尝试取消可能残留的任务
 223 |         guard isRecording || transcriptionProvider != nil else { return }
 224 |         
 225 |         // 停止音频引擎
 226 |         audioEngine?.stop()
 227 |         audioEngine?.inputNode.removeTap(onBus: 0)
 228 |         
 229 |         // 取消转录
 230 |         transcriptionProvider?.cancel()
 231 |         
 232 |         // 关闭音频文件
 233 |         audioFile = nil
 234 |         
 235 |         // 清理
 236 |         transcriptionProvider = nil
 237 |         audioEngine = nil
 238 |         
 239 |         isRecording = false
 240 |         isProcessing = false
 241 |         logger.info("🚫 Recording cancelled")
 242 |         
 243 |         // 清理临时文件
 244 |         cleanupTempFile()
 245 |     }
 246 |     
 247 |     /// 清理临时文件
 248 |     func cleanupTempFile() {
 249 |         if let url = tempAudioFileURL {
 250 |             try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: url)
 251 |             tempAudioFileURL = nil
 252 |         }
 253 |     }
 254 |     
 255 |     // MARK: - Private
 256 |     
 257 |     private func createTempAudioFileURL() -> URL {
 258 |         let tempDir = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
 259 |         let fileName = "spoke_\(UUID().uuidString).caf"
 260 |         return tempDir.appendingPathComponent(fileName)
 261 |     }
 262 |     
 263 |     private func processAudioLevel(buffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer) {
 264 |         guard let channelData = buffer.floatChannelData?[0] else { return }
 265 |         
 266 |         let frameLength = Int(buffer.frameLength)
 267 |         // 使用 RMS (均方根) 计算，更能反映听感响度
 268 |         var sumSquares: Float = 0
 269 |         
 270 |         // 降采样以提高性能 (每 4 个采样点取一个)
 271 |         let strideStep = 4
 272 |         for i in stride(from: 0, to: frameLength, by: strideStep) {
 273 |             let sample = channelData[i]
 274 |             sumSquares += sample * sample
 275 |         }
 276 |         
 277 |         let rms = sqrt(sumSquares / Float(frameLength / strideStep))
 278 |         
 279 |         // 非线性放大：
 280 |         // 1. 基础放大倍数 5.0
 281 |         // 2. 加上一个非线性分量 sqrt(rms) * 2.0 提升小音量表现
 282 |         // 3. 限制在 0.01 - 1.0 之间 (保留极小值避免完全静止)
 283 |         var level = (rms * 5.0) + (sqrt(rms) * 2.0)
 284 |         
 285 |         // 添加一点随机抖动，让波形在说话时更生动
 286 |         if level > 0.1 {
 287 |             level += Float.random(in: -0.05...0.05)
 288 |         }
 289 |         
 290 |         let finalLevel = min(max(level, 0.02), 1.0)
 291 |         
 292 |         Task { @MainActor in
 293 |             onAudioLevelUpdate?(finalLevel)
 294 |         }
 295 |     }
 296 | }
 297 | 
 298 | // MARK: - Errors
 299 | 
 300 | enum AudioRecorderError: LocalizedError {
 301 |     case recognizerNotAvailable
 302 |     case engineCreationFailed
 303 |     case requestCreationFailed
 304 |     case permissionDenied
 305 |     
 306 |     var errorDescription: String? {
 307 |         switch self {
 308 |         case .recognizerNotAvailable:
 309 |             return "语音识别器不可用"
 310 |         case .engineCreationFailed:
 311 |             return "音频引擎创建失败"
 312 |         case .requestCreationFailed:
 313 |             return "识别请求创建失败"
 314 |         case .permissionDenied:
 315 |             return "权限被拒绝"
 316 |         }
 317 |     }
 318 | }

   1 | import Foundation
   2 | import Security
   3 | import os
   4 | 
   5 | /// Keychain 服务
   6 | /// 用于安全存储 API Key
   7 | /// 使用内存缓存减少 Keychain 访问次数（避免开发阶段频繁授权弹窗）
   8 | final class KeychainService {
   9 |     
  10 |     private static let logger = Logger(subsystem: "com.spokeanywhere", category: "Keychain")
  11 |     
  12 |     /// 服务名称前缀
  13 |     private static let servicePrefix = "com.spokeanywhere.llm"
  14 |     
  15 |     /// 内存缓存（减少 Keychain 访问）
  16 |     private static var cache: [String: String] = [:]
  17 |     private static let cacheQueue = DispatchQueue(label: "com.spokeanywhere.keychain.cache")
  18 |     
  19 |     // MARK: - Debug Mode
  20 |     
  21 |     /// ⚠️ 测试模式：使用 UserDefaults 代替 Keychain（避免每次启动输入密码）
  22 |     /// 正式发布时请设为 false
  23 |     static var useSimpleStorage: Bool = true
  24 |     
  25 |     /// UserDefaults 存储前缀（测试模式用）
  26 |     private static let simpleStoragePrefix = "debug.apikey."
  27 |     
  28 |     // MARK: - Public API
  29 |     
  30 |     /// 保存 API Key (智能更新)
  31 |     static func save(key: String, value: String) throws {
  32 |         // 测试模式：使用 UserDefaults
  33 |         if useSimpleStorage {
  34 |             UserDefaults.standard.set(value, forKey: simpleStoragePrefix + key)
  35 |             cacheQueue.sync { cache[key] = value }
  36 |             logger.info("✅ [Debug] Saved to UserDefaults: \(key)")
  37 |             return
  38 |         }
  39 |         
  40 |         // 正式模式：使用 Keychain
  41 |         let service = "\(servicePrefix).\(key)"
  42 |         
  43 |         guard let data = value.data(using: .utf8) else {
  44 |             throw KeychainError.encodingFailed
  45 |         }
  46 |         
  47 |         // 1. 尝试更新现有项目
  48 |         let query: [String: Any] = [
  49 |             kSecClass as String: kSecClassGenericPassword,
  50 |             kSecAttrService as String: service,
  51 |             kSecAttrAccount as String: key
  52 |         ]
  53 |         
  54 |         let attributes: [String: Any] = [
  55 |             kSecValueData as String: data,
  56 |             kSecAttrAccessible as String: kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlocked
  57 |         ]
  58 |         
  59 |         var status = SecItemUpdate(query as CFDictionary, attributes as CFDictionary)
  60 |         
  61 |         // 2. 如果项目不存在 (errSecItemNotFound)，则添加新项目
  62 |         if status == errSecItemNotFound {
  63 |             let addQuery: [String: Any] = [
  64 |                 kSecClass as String: kSecClassGenericPassword,
  65 |                 kSecAttrService as String: service,
  66 |                 kSecAttrAccount as String: key,
  67 |                 kSecValueData as String: data,
  68 |                 kSecAttrAccessible as String: kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlocked
  69 |             ]
  70 |             status = SecItemAdd(addQuery as CFDictionary, nil)
  71 |         }
  72 |         
  73 |         guard status == errSecSuccess else {
  74 |             logger.error("❌ Keychain save failed: \(status)")
  75 |             throw KeychainError.saveFailed(status)
  76 |         }
  77 |         
  78 |         // 更新缓存
  79 |         cacheQueue.sync { cache[key] = value }
  80 |         
  81 |         logger.info("✅ Saved to Keychain: \(key)")
  82 |     }
  83 |     
  84 |     /// 加载 API Key（优先从缓存读取）
  85 |     static func load(key: String) -> String? {
  86 |         // 先查缓存
  87 |         if let cached = cacheQueue.sync(execute: { cache[key] }) {
  88 |             return cached
  89 |         }
  90 |         
  91 |         // 测试模式：从 UserDefaults 读取
  92 |         if useSimpleStorage {
  93 |             if let value = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: simpleStoragePrefix + key) {
  94 |                 cacheQueue.sync { cache[key] = value }
  95 |                 return value
  96 |             }
  97 |             return nil
  98 |         }
  99 |         
 100 |         // 正式模式：从 Keychain 读取
 101 |         let service = "\(servicePrefix).\(key)"
 102 |         
 103 |         let query: [String: Any] = [
 104 |             kSecClass as String: kSecClassGenericPassword,
 105 |             kSecAttrService as String: service,
 106 |             kSecAttrAccount as String: key,
 107 |             kSecReturnData as String: true,
 108 |             kSecMatchLimit as String: kSecMatchLimitOne
 109 |         ]
 110 |         
 111 |         var result: AnyObject?
 112 |         let status = SecItemCopyMatching(query as CFDictionary, &result)
 113 |         
 114 |         guard status == errSecSuccess,
 115 |               let data = result as? Data,
 116 |               let value = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else {
 117 |             return nil
 118 |         }
 119 |         
 120 |         // 写入缓存
 121 |         cacheQueue.sync { cache[key] = value }
 122 |         
 123 |         return value
 124 |     }
 125 |     
 126 |     /// 删除 API Key
 127 |     static func delete(key: String) throws {
 128 |         // 测试模式：从 UserDefaults 删除
 129 |         if useSimpleStorage {
 130 |             UserDefaults.standard.removeObject(forKey: simpleStoragePrefix + key)
 131 |             _ = cacheQueue.sync { cache.removeValue(forKey: key) }
 132 |             logger.info("🗑️ [Debug] Deleted from UserDefaults: \(key)")
 133 |             return
 134 |         }
 135 |         
 136 |         // 正式模式：从 Keychain 删除
 137 |         let service = "\(servicePrefix).\(key)"
 138 |         
 139 |         let query: [String: Any] = [
 140 |             kSecClass as String: kSecClassGenericPassword,
 141 |             kSecAttrService as String: service,
 142 |             kSecAttrAccount as String: key
 143 |         ]
 144 |         
 145 |         let status = SecItemDelete(query as CFDictionary)
 146 |         
 147 |         guard status == errSecSuccess || status == errSecItemNotFound else {
 148 |             logger.error("❌ Keychain delete failed: \(status)")
 149 |             throw KeychainError.deleteFailed(status)
 150 |         }
 151 |         
 152 |         // 清除缓存
 153 |         _ = cacheQueue.sync { cache.removeValue(forKey: key) }
 154 |         
 155 |         logger.info("🗑️ Deleted from Keychain: \(key)")
 156 |     }
 157 |     
 158 |     /// 检查是否存在（优先查缓存）
 159 |     static func exists(key: String) -> Bool {
 160 |         // 先查缓存
 161 |         if cacheQueue.sync(execute: { cache[key] }) != nil {
 162 |             return true
 163 |         }
 164 |         return load(key: key) != nil
 165 |     }
 166 |     
 167 |     /// 清除内存缓存（调试用）
 168 |     static func clearCache() {
 169 |         cacheQueue.sync { cache.removeAll() }
 170 |     }
 171 | }
 172 | 
 173 | // MARK: - Keychain Error
 174 | 
 175 | enum KeychainError: LocalizedError {
 176 |     case encodingFailed
 177 |     case saveFailed(OSStatus)
 178 |     case deleteFailed(OSStatus)
 179 |     
 180 |     var errorDescription: String? {
 181 |         switch self {
 182 |         case .encodingFailed:
 183 |             return "数据编码失败"
 184 |         case .saveFailed(let status):
 185 |             return "Keychain 保存失败: \(status)"
 186 |         case .deleteFailed(let status):
 187 |             return "Keychain 删除失败: \(status)"
 188 |         }
 189 |     }
 190 | }

   1 | import Foundation
   2 | import os

   4 | /// LLM 处理管线
   5 | /// 负责协调转写文本的 LLM 精炼处理
   6 | @MainActor
   7 | final class LLMPipeline {
   8 |     
   9 |     // MARK: - Singleton
  10 |     
  11 |     static let shared = LLMPipeline()
  12 |     
  13 |     private let logger = Logger(subsystem: "com.spokeanywhere", category: "LLMPipeline")
  14 |     
  15 |     // MARK: - Dependencies
  16 |     
  17 |     private let settings = LLMSettings.shared
  18 |     private let contextService = ContextService.shared
  19 |     private let clipboardHistory = ClipboardHistoryService.shared
  20 |     
  21 |     // MARK: - Properties
  22 |     
  23 |     /// 当前是否正在处理
  24 |     private(set) var isProcessing = false
  25 |     
  26 |     // MARK: - Init
  27 |     
  28 |     private init() {}
  29 |     
  30 |     // MARK: - Public API
  31 |     
  32 |     /// 检查是否需要 LLM 处理
  33 |     var shouldProcess: Bool {
  34 |         settings.isFullyConfigured
  35 |     }
  36 |     
  37 |     /// 当前 Provider 名称（用于显示）
  38 |     var currentProviderName: String {
  39 |         settings.currentProviderName
  40 |     }
  41 |     
  42 |     /// 对话（Quick Ask 专用）
  43 |     /// - Parameter message: 用户消息
  44 |     /// - Returns: AI 回答
  45 |     func chat(_ message: String) async -> Result<String, LLMError> {
  46 |         guard shouldProcess else {
  47 |             logger.info("⏭️ LLM not configured")
  48 |             return .failure(.notConfigured)
  49 |         }
  50 |         
  51 |         guard let provider = settings.createCurrentProvider() else {
  52 |             logger.error("❌ Failed to create LLM provider")
  53 |             return .failure(.notConfigured)
  54 |         }
  55 |         
  56 |         isProcessing = true
  57 |         defer { isProcessing = false }
  58 |         
  59 |         // Quick Ask 专用系统提示词
  60 |         let systemPrompt = """
  61 |         你是一个友好、专业的 AI 助手。请根据用户的问题提供清晰、准确的回答。
  62 |         
  63 |         如果用户提供了语音转写内容，请注意：
  64 |         - 语音转写可能存在错误（尤其是专业术语、人名、产品名）
  65 |         - 请根据上下文推断用户的真实意图
  66 |         - 如果不确定用户的意思，可以礼貌地询问
  67 |         
  68 |         回答要求：
  69 |         - 使用简洁明了的语言
  70 |         - 适当使用列表或分段来组织内容
  71 |         - 如果是代码相关问题，请提供代码示例
  72 |         """
  73 |         
  74 |         let prompt = LLMPrompt(
  75 |             systemPrompt: systemPrompt,
  76 |             userMessage: message,
  77 |             contextAppName: contextService.getCurrentTargetApp()?.name
  78 |         )
  79 |         
  80 |         logger.info("🤖 Quick Ask: \(message.prefix(100))...")
  81 |         
  82 |         do {
  83 |             let response = try await provider.complete(prompt: prompt)
  84 |             logger.info("✅ Quick Ask complete")
  85 |             return .success(response.text)
  86 |         } catch let error as LLMError {
  87 |             logger.error("❌ Quick Ask error: \(error.localizedDescription)")
  88 |             return .failure(error)
  89 |         } catch {
  90 |             logger.error("❌ Unexpected error: \(error.localizedDescription)")
  91 |             return .failure(.networkError(error))
  92 |         }
  93 |     }
  94 |     
  95 |     /// 精炼文本
  96 |     /// - Parameters:
  97 |     ///   - text: 原始转写文本
  98 |     ///   - customSystemPrompt: 自定义系统提示词（用于历史记录重处理）
  99 |     /// - Returns: 精炼后的文本，失败时返回错误
 100 |     func refine(_ text: String, customSystemPrompt: String? = nil) async -> Result<String, LLMError> {
 101 |         guard shouldProcess else {
 102 |             logger.info("⏭️ LLM not configured, skipping")
 103 |             return .success(text)
 104 |         }
 105 |         
 106 |         guard let provider = settings.createCurrentProvider() else {
 107 |             logger.error("❌ Failed to create LLM provider")
 108 |             return .failure(.notConfigured)
 109 |         }
 110 |         
 111 |         isProcessing = true
 112 |         defer { isProcessing = false }
 113 |         
 114 |         // 构建 Prompt（支持自定义系统提示词）
 115 |         let prompt: LLMPrompt
 116 |         if let customPrompt = customSystemPrompt {
 117 |             // 使用自定义提示词（历史记录重处理场景）
 118 |             prompt = LLMPrompt(
 119 |                 systemPrompt: customPrompt,
 120 |                 userMessage: text,
 121 |                 contextAppName: nil
 122 |             )
 123 |         } else {
 124 |             // 使用默认设置构建提示词
 125 |             prompt = buildPrompt(for: text)
 126 |         }
 127 |         
 128 |         // 调试：打印完整 Prompt
 129 |         logger.info("🤖 Starting LLM refinement...")
 130 |         print("📝 === LLM PROMPT DEBUG ===")
 131 |         print("📝 System Prompt:")
 132 |         print(prompt.systemPrompt)
 133 |         print("📝 User Message: \(prompt.userMessage)")
 134 |         print("📝 === END PROMPT ===")
 135 |         
 136 |         do {
 137 |             let response = try await provider.complete(prompt: prompt)
 138 |             logger.info("✅ LLM refinement complete")
 139 |             return .success(response.text)
 140 |         } catch let error as LLMError {
 141 |             logger.error("❌ LLM error: \(error.localizedDescription)")
 142 |             return .failure(error)
 143 |         } catch {
 144 |             logger.error("❌ Unexpected error: \(error.localizedDescription)")
 145 |             return .failure(.networkError(error))
 146 |         }
 147 |     }
 148 |     
 149 |     // MARK: - Private
 150 |     
 151 |     private func buildPrompt(for text: String) -> LLMPrompt {
 152 |         var systemPrompt = settings.systemPrompt
 153 |         
 154 |         // 添加上下文信息
 155 |         if settings.includeActiveApp {
 156 |             if let appName = contextService.getCurrentTargetApp()?.name {
 157 |                 systemPrompt += "\n\n当前应用: \(appName)"
 158 |             }
 159 |         }
 160 |         
 161 |         if settings.includeClipboard {
 162 |             // 限制为最近 10 条，减少噪音并聚焦最近上下文
 163 |             let historyContext = clipboardHistory.formatForPrompt(limit: 10)
 164 |             if !historyContext.isEmpty {
 165 |                 systemPrompt += "\n\n" + historyContext
 166 |             }
 167 |         }
 168 |         
 169 |         return LLMPrompt(
 170 |             systemPrompt: systemPrompt,
 171 |             userMessage: text,
 172 |             contextAppName: contextService.getCurrentTargetApp()?.name
 173 |         )
 174 |     }
 175 | }

   7 |     let systemPrompt: String
   8 |     let userMessage: String

  10 |

  20 | /// Token 使用统计
  21 | struct TokenUsage: Codable {
  22 |     let promptTokens: Int?
  23 |     let completionTokens: Int?
  24 |     let totalTokens: Int?

 266 |     /// 从旧版配置迁移到 Profile 系统
 267 |     private func migrateToProfiles() {
 268 |         logger.info("🔄 Migrating legacy configs to Profile system...")
 269 |         
 270 |         for (type, config) in providerConfigs {
 271 |             let profile = ProviderProfile.migrate(from: config, type: type)
 272 |             profiles.append(profile)
 273 |             
 274 |             // 如果是之前选中的 Provider，设为当前 Profile
 275 |             if type == selectedProviderType {
 276 |                 selectedProfileId = profile.id
 277 |             }
 278 |         }
 279 |         
 280 |         logger.info("✅ Migrated \(self.profiles.count) profiles")
 281 |     }

 283 |     /// 合并遗留的 API Key 到统一存储
 284 |     private func consolidateLegacyAPIKeys() {
 285 |         let defaults = UserDefaults.standard
 286 |         
 287 |         // 1. 加载统一存储
 288 |         loadAllAPIKeys()
 289 |         
 290 |         // 2. 如果已经完成迁移，直接返回（不再尝试读取遗留 Key）
 291 |         if defaults.bool(forKey: Keys.hasConsolidatedAPIKeys) {
 292 |             logger.info("🔓 API keys already consolidated, skipping migration")
 293 |             return
 294 |         }
 295 |         
 296 |         var hasChanges = false
 297 |         
 298 |         // 3. 检查所有 Profile，尝试迁移遗留 Key
 299 |         for i in profiles.indices {
 300 |             let profile = profiles[i]
 301 |             
 302 |             // 如果缓存中没有 Key，但 Profile 有遗留引用 (且不是 "unified_storage")
 303 |             if apiKeysCache[profile.id.uuidString] == nil,
 304 |                let keyRef = profile.apiKeyRef,
 305 |                keyRef != "unified_storage" {
 306 |                 
 307 |                 logger.info("📥 Consolidating legacy key for profile: \(profile.name)")
 308 |                 
 309 |                 // 尝试从旧 Keychain Item 读取
 310 |                 if let legacyKey = KeychainService.load(key: keyRef) {
 311 |                     // 存入缓存
 312 |                     apiKeysCache[profile.id.uuidString] = legacyKey
 313 |                     
 314 |                     // 更新 Profile 标记
 315 |                     profiles[i].apiKeyRef = "unified_storage"
 316 |                     profiles[i].updatedAt = Date()
 317 |                     
 318 |                     hasChanges = true
 319 |                 }
 320 |             }
 321 |         }
 322 |         
 323 |         // 4. 保存迁移结果
 324 |         if hasChanges {
 325 |             saveAllAPIKeys()
 326 |             save() // 保存 Profile 的 apiKeyRef 更新
 327 |             logger.info("✅ Consolidated legacy API keys to unified storage")
 328 |         }
 329 |         
 330 |         // 5. 标记迁移完成（即使没有任何 Key 需要迁移，也标记为完成）
 331 |         defaults.set(true, forKey: Keys.hasConsolidatedAPIKeys)
 332 |     }

 366 |         if let keyRef = profile.apiKeyRef {

 101 |     func complete(prompt: LLMPrompt) async throws -> LLMResponse {
 102 |         guard isConfigured else {
 103 |             throw LLMError.notConfigured
 104 |         }
 105 |         
 106 |         let request = try buildRequest(prompt: prompt)
 107 |         
 108 |         logger.info("🤖 LLM request to \(self.providerType.displayName)")
 109 |         
 110 |         do {
 111 |             let (data, response) = try await session.data(for: request)
 112 |             
 113 |             guard let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse else {
 114 |                 throw LLMError.invalidResponse
 115 |             }
 116 |             
 117 |             // 处理错误状态码
 118 |             switch httpResponse.statusCode {
 119 |             case 200...299:
 120 |                 break
 121 |             case 401:
 122 |                 throw LLMError.invalidAPIKey
 123 |             case 429:
 124 |                 throw LLMError.rateLimited
 125 |             default:
 126 |                 let message = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8)
 127 |                 throw LLMError.serverError(httpResponse.statusCode, message)
 128 |             }
 129 |             
 130 |             return try parseResponse(data: data)
 131 |             
 132 |         } catch let error as LLMError {
 133 |             throw error
 134 |         } catch let error as URLError where error.code == .timedOut {
 135 |             throw LLMError.timeout
 136 |         } catch {
 137 |             throw LLMError.networkError(error)
 138 |         }
 139 |     }

 160 |     /// 获取可用模型列表

 162 |     func fetchModels() async -> [String] {
 163 |         let urlString = baseURL.trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet(charactersIn: "/"))
 164 |         
 165 |         // 使用 providedAPIKey（由 LLMSettings 注入）
 166 |         let apiKey = providedAPIKey
 167 |         
 168 |         // 根据 provider 类型构建 URL 和请求
 169 |         let modelsURL: URL?
 170 |         var authHeader: (String, String)?
 171 |         
 172 |         switch providerType {
 173 |         case .googleGemini:
 174 |             // Gemini: GET /models?key={apiKey}
 175 |             // 响应: { models: [{ name: "models/gemini-1.5-flash" }] }
 176 |             if let key = apiKey {
 177 |                 modelsURL = URL(string: "\(urlString)/models?key=\(key)")
 178 |             } else {
 179 |                 modelsURL = URL(string: "\(urlString)/models")
 180 |             }
 181 |             
 182 |         case .anthropic:
 183 |             // Anthropic: GET /v1/models, Header: x-api-key
 184 |             // 响应: { data: [{ id: "claude-3-opus-20240229" }] }
 185 |             modelsURL = URL(string: "\(urlString)/models")
 186 |             if let key = apiKey {
 187 |                 authHeader = ("x-api-key", key)
 188 |             }
 189 |             
 190 |         case .ollama:
 191 |             // Ollama: GET /api/tags (不是 /models)
 192 |             // 响应: { models: [{ name: "llama3:latest" }] }
 193 |             modelsURL = URL(string: "\(urlString.replacingOccurrences(of: "/v1", with: ""))/api/tags")
 194 |             
 195 |         case .openRouter:
 196 |             // OpenRouter: GET /api/v1/models, Header: Authorization Bearer
 197 |             // 响应: { data: [{ id: "openai/gpt-4" }] }
 198 |             modelsURL = URL(string: "\(urlString)/models")
 199 |             if let key = apiKey {
 200 |                 authHeader = ("Authorization", "Bearer \(key)")
 201 |             }
 202 |             
 203 |         case .groq:
 204 |             // Groq: GET /openai/v1/models, Header: Authorization Bearer
 205 |             // 响应: { data: [{ id: "llama-3.1-70b-versatile" }] }
 206 |             modelsURL = URL(string: "\(urlString)/models")
 207 |             if let key = apiKey {
 208 |                 authHeader = ("Authorization", "Bearer \(key)")
 209 |             }
 210 |             
 211 |         case .openai, .openAICompatible:
 212 |             // OpenAI 标准: GET /models, Header: Authorization Bearer
 213 |             // 响应: { data: [{ id: "gpt-4" }] }
 214 |             modelsURL = URL(string: "\(urlString)/models")
 215 |             if let key = apiKey {
 216 |                 authHeader = ("Authorization", "Bearer \(key)")
 217 |             }
 218 |         }
 219 |         
 220 |         guard let url = modelsURL else {
 221 |             logger.warning("⚠️ Invalid URL for models endpoint")
 222 |             return []
 223 |         }
 224 |         
 225 |         var request = URLRequest(url: url)
 226 |         request.httpMethod = "GET"
 227 |         request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
 228 |         request.timeoutInterval = 10
 229 |         
 230 |         // 添加认证头
 231 |         if let (headerName, headerValue) = authHeader {
 232 |             request.setValue(headerValue, forHTTPHeaderField: headerName)
 233 |         }
 234 |         
 235 |         // Anthropic 需要额外的版本头
 236 |         if providerType == .anthropic {
 237 |             request.setValue("2023-06-01", forHTTPHeaderField: "anthropic-version")
 238 |         }
 239 |         
 240 |         do {
 241 |             let (data, response) = try await session.data(for: request)
 242 |             
 243 |             guard let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse,
 244 |                   (200...299).contains(httpResponse.statusCode) else {
 245 |                 let statusCode = (response as? HTTPURLResponse)?.statusCode ?? 0
 246 |                 logger.warning("⚠️ Models endpoint returned status \(statusCode)")
 247 |                 return []
 248 |             }
 249 |             
 250 |             return parseModelsResponse(data: data)
 251 |             
 252 |         } catch {

 254 |             return []
 255 |         }

 258 |     /// 解析不同格式的 models 响应
 259 |     private func parseModelsResponse(data: Data) -> [String] {
 260 |         guard let json = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as? [String: Any] else {
 261 |             logger.warning("⚠️ Failed to parse models response as JSON")
 262 |             return []
 263 |         }
 264 |         
 265 |         var models: [String] = []
 266 |         
 267 |         switch providerType {
 268 |         case .googleGemini:
 269 |             // Gemini: { models: [{ name: "models/gemini-1.5-flash", ... }] }
 270 |             if let modelsArray = json["models"] as? [[String: Any]] {
 271 |                 models = modelsArray.compactMap { model -> String? in
 272 |                     guard let name = model["name"] as? String else { return nil }
 273 |                     // 过滤掉 embedding 模型，只保留生成模型
 274 |                     if name.contains("embedding") { return nil }
 275 |                     return name.replacingOccurrences(of: "models/", with: "")
 276 |                 }
 277 |             }
 278 |             
 279 |         case .ollama:
 280 |             // Ollama: { models: [{ name: "llama3:latest", ... }] }
 281 |             if let modelsArray = json["models"] as? [[String: Any]] {
 282 |                 models = modelsArray.compactMap { $0["name"] as? String }
 283 |             }
 284 |             
 285 |         case .openai, .anthropic, .groq, .openRouter, .openAICompatible:
 286 |             // OpenAI 标准格式: { data: [{ id: "gpt-4", ... }] }
 287 |             if let dataArray = json["data"] as? [[String: Any]] {
 288 |                 models = dataArray.compactMap { $0["id"] as? String }
 289 |             }
 290 |         }
 291 |         
 292 |         if models.isEmpty {
 293 |             logger.warning("⚠️ No models found in response")
 294 |         } else {
 295 |             logger.info("✅ Fetched \(models.count) models from \(self.providerType.displayName)")
 296 |         }
 297 |         
 298 |         return models.sorted()
 299 |     }

 303 |     private func buildRequest(prompt: LLMPrompt) throws -> URLRequest {
 304 |         let urlString = baseURL.trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet(charactersIn: "/"))
 305 |         
 306 |         // 使用 providedAPIKey（由 LLMSettings 注入）
 307 |         let apiKey = providedAPIKey
 308 |         
 309 |         if providerType == .googleGemini {
 310 |             return try buildGeminiRequest(urlString: urlString, apiKey: apiKey, prompt: prompt)
 311 |         }
 312 |         
 313 |         // OpenAI Compatible Request
 314 |         guard let url = URL(string: "\(urlString)/chat/completions") else {
 315 |             throw LLMError.invalidResponse
 316 |         }
 317 |         
 318 |         var request = URLRequest(url: url)
 319 |         request.httpMethod = "POST"
 320 |         request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
 321 |         
 322 |         // 添加 API Key
 323 |         if let key = apiKey {
 324 |             request.setValue("Bearer \(key)", forHTTPHeaderField: "Authorization")
 325 |         }
 326 |         
 327 |         // Anthropic 需要额外的版本头
 328 |         if providerType == .anthropic {
 329 |             request.setValue("2023-06-01", forHTTPHeaderField: "anthropic-version")
 330 |             request.setValue(apiKey, forHTTPHeaderField: "x-api-key")
 331 |             // Anthropic 不使用 Bearer Token
 332 |             request.setValue(nil, forHTTPHeaderField: "Authorization")
 333 |         }
 334 |         
 335 |         // 构建请求体
 336 |         var messages: [[String: String]] = []
 337 |         
 338 |         // System prompt
 339 |         if !prompt.systemPrompt.isEmpty {
 340 |             messages.append([
 341 |                 "role": "system",
 342 |                 "content": prompt.systemPrompt
 343 |             ])
 344 |         }
 345 |         
 346 |         // User message
 347 |         messages.append([
 348 |             "role": "user",
 349 |             "content": prompt.userMessage
 350 |         ])
 351 |         
 352 |         let body: [String: Any] = [
 353 |             "model": modelName,
 354 |             "messages": messages,
 355 |             "temperature": temperature,
 356 |             "max_tokens": maxTokens
 357 |         ]
 358 |         
 359 |         request.httpBody = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: body)
 360 |         
 361 |         return request
 362 |     }

 364 |     private func buildGeminiRequest(urlString: String, apiKey: String?, prompt: LLMPrompt) throws -> URLRequest {
 365 |         // Gemini: POST /models/{model}:generateContent?key={apiKey}
 366 |         guard let key = apiKey else { throw LLMError.invalidAPIKey }
 367 |         
 368 |         let model = modelName.isEmpty ? "gemini-pro" : modelName
 369 |         // 处理可能包含 "models/" 前缀的情况
 370 |         let cleanModelName = model.replacingOccurrences(of: "models/", with: "")
 371 |         
 372 |         guard let url = URL(string: "\(urlString)/models/\(cleanModelName):generateContent?key=\(key)") else {
 373 |             throw LLMError.invalidResponse
 374 |         }
 375 |         
 376 |         var request = URLRequest(url: url)
 377 |         request.httpMethod = "POST"
 378 |         request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
 379 |         
 380 |         // 构建 Gemini 请求体
 381 |         // {
 382 |         //   "contents": [{ "role": "user", "parts": [{ "text": "..." }] }],
 383 |         //   "systemInstruction": { "parts": [{ "text": "..." }] },
 384 |         //   "generationConfig": { ... }
 385 |         // }
 386 |         
 387 |         var body: [String: Any] = [
 388 |             "contents": [
 389 |                 [
 390 |                     "role": "user",
 391 |                     "parts": [
 392 |                         ["text": prompt.userMessage]
 393 |                     ]
 394 |                 ]
 395 |             ],
 396 |             "generationConfig": [
 397 |                 "temperature": temperature,
 398 |                 "maxOutputTokens": maxTokens
 399 |             ]
 400 |         ]
 401 |         
 402 |         if !prompt.systemPrompt.isEmpty {
 403 |             body["systemInstruction"] = [
 404 |                 "parts": [
 405 |                     ["text": prompt.systemPrompt]
 406 |                 ]
 407 |             ]
 408 |         }
 409 |         
 410 |         request.httpBody = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: body)
 411 |         return request
 412 |     }
 413 |     
 414 |     private func parseResponse(data: Data) throws -> LLMResponse {
 415 |         if providerType == .googleGemini {
 416 |             return try parseGeminiResponse(data: data)
 417 |         }
 418 |         
 419 |         // 解析 OpenAI 格式响应
 420 |         guard let json = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as? [String: Any] else {
 421 |             throw LLMError.invalidResponse
 422 |         }
 423 |         
 424 |         // 检查 Anthropic 错误格式
 425 |         if let error = json["error"] as? [String: Any], let message = error["message"] as? String {
 426 |             throw LLMError.serverError(400, message)
 427 |         }
 428 |         
 429 |         // 兼容 Anthropic 响应格式 (content 是数组)
 430 |         if let contentArray = json["content"] as? [[String: Any]],
 431 |            let firstContent = contentArray.first,
 432 |            let text = firstContent["text"] as? String {
 433 |             return LLMResponse(text: text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines), usage: nil)
 434 |         }
 435 |         
 436 |         // 标准 OpenAI 格式
 437 |         if let choices = json["choices"] as? [[String: Any]],
 438 |            let firstChoice = choices.first,
 439 |            let message = firstChoice["message"] as? [String: Any],
 440 |            let content = message["content"] as? String {
 441 |             
 442 |             let trimmedContent = content.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
 443 |             if trimmedContent.isEmpty { throw LLMError.emptyResponse }
 444 |             
 445 |             // 解析 usage
 446 |             var usage: TokenUsage?
 447 |             if let usageJson = json["usage"] as? [String: Any] {
 448 |                 usage = TokenUsage(
 449 |                     promptTokens: usageJson["prompt_tokens"] as? Int,
 450 |                     completionTokens: usageJson["completion_tokens"] as? Int,
 451 |                     totalTokens: usageJson["total_tokens"] as? Int
 452 |                 )
 453 |             }
 454 |             
 455 |             logger.info("✅ LLM response received (\(trimmedContent.count) chars)")
 456 |             return LLMResponse(text: trimmedContent, usage: usage)
 457 |         }
 458 |         
 459 |         logger.error("❌ Failed to parse response: \(String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) ?? "nil")")
 460 |         throw LLMError.invalidResponse
 461 |     }
 462 |     
 463 |     private func parseGeminiResponse(data: Data) throws -> LLMResponse {
 464 |         // Gemini: { "candidates": [{ "content": { "parts": [{ "text": "..." }] } }] }
 465 |         guard let json = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as? [String: Any] else {
 466 |             throw LLMError.invalidResponse
 467 |         }
 468 |         
 469 |         // 检查错误
 470 |         if let error = json["error"] as? [String: Any], let message = error["message"] as? String {
 471 |             throw LLMError.serverError(400, message)
 472 |         }
 473 |         
 474 |         guard let candidates = json["candidates"] as? [[String: Any]],
 475 |               let firstCandidate = candidates.first,
 476 |               let content = firstCandidate["content"] as? [String: Any],
 477 |               let parts = content["parts"] as? [[String: Any]],
 478 |               let firstPart = parts.first,
 479 |               let text = firstPart["text"] as? String else {
 480 |             logger.error("❌ Failed to parse Gemini response: \(String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) ?? "nil")")
 481 |             throw LLMError.invalidResponse
 482 |         }
 483 |         
 484 |         let trimmedContent = text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
 485 |         logger.info("✅ Gemini response received (\(trimmedContent.count) chars)")
 486 |         
 487 |         return LLMResponse(text: trimmedContent, usage: nil)
 488 |     }
 489 | }

   5 | /// SFSpeechRecognizer 实现
   6 | /// 适用于 macOS 15+ / iOS 10+
   7 | /// 回退方案，当 SpeechAnalyzer 不可用时使用
   8 | @MainActor
   9 | final class SFSpeechProvider: TranscriptionProvider {
  10 |     
  11 |     // MARK: - Constants
  12 |     
  13 |     private static let cancelledErrorCode = 216
  14 |     
  15 |     // MARK: - Properties
  16 |     
  17 |     let identifier = "sf_speech_recognizer"
  18 |     let displayName = "Apple Dictation"
  19 |     
  20 |     let capabilities: TranscriptionCapability = [.realtime, .punctuation]
  21 |     
  22 |     var locale: Locale {
  23 |         didSet {
  24 |             speechRecognizer = SFSpeechRecognizer(locale: locale)
  25 |         }
  26 |     }
  27 |     
  28 |     var isAvailable: Bool {
  29 |         speechRecognizer?.isAvailable ?? false
  30 |     }
  31 |     
  32 |     var supportedLocales: [Locale] {
  33 |         SFSpeechRecognizer.supportedLocales().map { Locale(identifier: $0.identifier) }
  34 |     }
  35 |     
  36 |     var onResult: ((TranscriptionResult) -> Void)?
  37 |     var onError: ((Error) -> Void)?
  38 |     
  39 |     // MARK: - Private
  40 |     
  41 |     private let logger = Logger(subsystem: "com.spokeanywhere", category: "SFSpeechProvider")
  42 |     private var speechRecognizer: SFSpeechRecognizer?
  43 |     private var recognitionRequest: SFSpeechAudioBufferRecognitionRequest?
  44 |     private var recognitionTask: SFSpeechRecognitionTask?
  45 |     
  46 |     // MARK: - Init
  47 |     
  48 |     init(locale: Locale = Locale(identifier: "zh-CN")) {
  49 |         self.locale = locale
  50 |         self.speechRecognizer = SFSpeechRecognizer(locale: locale)
  51 |     }
  52 |     
  53 |     // MARK: - TranscriptionProvider
  54 |     
  55 |     func requestAuthorization() async -> Bool {
  56 |         await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in
  57 |             SFSpeechRecognizer.requestAuthorization { status in
  58 |                 continuation.resume(returning: status == .authorized)
  59 |             }
  60 |         }
  61 |     }
  62 |     
  63 |     func prepare() async throws {
  64 |         guard let recognizer = speechRecognizer, recognizer.isAvailable else {
  65 |             throw TranscriptionError.notAvailable
  66 |         }
  67 |         
  68 |         // 创建识别请求
  69 |         recognitionRequest = SFSpeechAudioBufferRecognitionRequest()
  70 |         guard let request = recognitionRequest else {
  71 |             throw TranscriptionError.engineNotReady
  72 |         }
  73 |         
  74 |         request.shouldReportPartialResults = true
  75 |         request.addsPunctuation = true
  76 |         request.taskHint = .dictation
  77 |         
  78 |         // 启动识别任务
  79 |         recognitionTask = recognizer.recognitionTask(with: request) { [weak self] result, error in
  80 |             Task { @MainActor in
  81 |                 self?.handleRecognitionResult(result: result, error: error)
  82 |             }
  83 |         }
  84 |         
  85 |         logger.info("✅ SFSpeechProvider prepared")
  86 |     }
  87 |     
  88 |     func process(buffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer) throws {
  89 |         guard let request = recognitionRequest else {
  90 |             throw TranscriptionError.engineNotReady
  91 |         }
  92 |         request.append(buffer)
  93 |     }
  94 |     
  95 |     func finishProcessing() async throws {
  96 |         recognitionRequest?.endAudio()
  97 |         
  98 |         // 等待最终结果
  99 |         var waitTime = 0
 100 |         let maxWait = 2000
 101 |         let interval = 100
 102 |         
 103 |         while waitTime < maxWait && recognitionTask != nil {
 104 |             try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(interval))
 105 |             waitTime += interval
 106 |         }
 107 |         
 108 |         logger.info("✅ SFSpeechProvider finished processing")
 109 |     }

 111 |     func cancel() {
 112 |         recognitionTask?.cancel()
 113 |         recognitionRequest?.endAudio()
 114 |         cleanup()
 115 |         logger.info("🚫 SFSpeechProvider cancelled")
 116 |     }

 119 |         cleanup()
 120 |         logger.info("🔄 SFSpeechProvider reset")
 121 |     }

 123 |     // MARK: - Private
 124 |     
 125 |     private func handleRecognitionResult(result: SFSpeechRecognitionResult?, error: Error?) {
 126 |         if let result = result {
 127 |             let text = result.bestTranscription.formattedString
 128 |             let resultType: TranscriptionResultType = result.isFinal ? .final : .partial
 129 |             let confidence = result.bestTranscription.segments.last?.confidence
 130 |             
 131 |             onResult?(TranscriptionResult(
 132 |                 text: text,
 133 |                 type: resultType,
 134 |                 confidence: confidence
 135 |             ))
 136 |             
 137 |             if result.isFinal {
 138 |                 recognitionTask = nil
 139 |             }
 140 |         }
 141 |         
 142 |         if let error = error {
 143 |             let nsError = error as NSError
 144 |             // 忽略用户取消错误
 145 |             if nsError.code != Self.cancelledErrorCode {
 146 |                 onError?(error)
 147 |             }
 148 |             recognitionTask = nil
 149 |         }
 150 |     }
 151 |     
 152 |     private func cleanup() {
 153 |         recognitionRequest = nil
 154 |         recognitionTask = nil
 155 |     }
 156 | }

 167 |             minOSVersion: "macOS 15.0",

 169 |         )

  90 |     func process(buffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer) throws {
  91 |         guard let continuation = inputContinuation else {
  92 |             throw TranscriptionError.engineNotReady
  93 |         }
  94 |         
  95 |         // 转换音频格式（如果需要）
  96 |         let convertedBuffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer
  97 |         if let targetFormat = targetAudioFormat, buffer.format != targetFormat {
  98 |             convertedBuffer = try convertBuffer(buffer, to: targetFormat)
  99 |         } else {
 100 |             convertedBuffer = buffer
 101 |         }
 102 |         
 103 |         // 创建 AnalyzerInput 并发送
 104 |         let input = AnalyzerInput(buffer: convertedBuffer)
 105 |         continuation.yield(input)
 106 |     }
 107 |     
 108 |     /// 转换音频缓冲区格式
 109 |     private func convertBuffer(_ buffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer, to format: AVAudioFormat) throws -> AVAudioPCMBuffer {
 110 |         // 创建或复用转换器
 111 |         if audioConverter == nil || audioConverter?.inputFormat != buffer.format || audioConverter?.outputFormat != format {
 112 |             guard let converter = AVAudioConverter(from: buffer.format, to: format) else {
 113 |                 throw TranscriptionError.processingFailed("Cannot create audio converter")
 114 |             }
 115 |             audioConverter = converter
 116 |         }
 117 |         
 118 |         guard let converter = audioConverter else {
 119 |             throw TranscriptionError.processingFailed("Audio converter not available")
 120 |         }
 121 |         
 122 |         // 计算输出帧数
 123 |         let ratio = format.sampleRate / buffer.format.sampleRate
 124 |         let outputFrameCount = AVAudioFrameCount(Double(buffer.frameLength) * ratio)
 125 |         
 126 |         guard let outputBuffer = AVAudioPCMBuffer(pcmFormat: format, frameCapacity: outputFrameCount) else {
 127 |             throw TranscriptionError.processingFailed("Cannot create output buffer")
 128 |         }
 129 |         
 130 |         var error: NSError?
 131 |         let inputBlock: AVAudioConverterInputBlock = { _, outStatus in
 132 |             outStatus.pointee = .haveData
 133 |             return buffer
 134 |         }
 135 |         
 136 |         converter.convert(to: outputBuffer, error: &error, withInputFrom: inputBlock)
 137 |         
 138 |         if let error = error {
 139 |             throw TranscriptionError.processingFailed("Conversion failed: \(error.localizedDescription)")
 140 |         }
 141 |         
 142 |         return outputBuffer
 143 |     }

 183 |     private func setupSpeechAnalyzer() async throws {
 184 |         // Step 1: 获取支持的 locale
 185 |         guard let supportedLocale = await SpeechTranscriber.supportedLocale(equivalentTo: locale) else {
 186 |             logger.error("❌ Locale not supported: \(self.locale.identifier)")
 187 |             throw TranscriptionError.unsupportedLocale(locale)
 188 |         }
 189 |         
 190 |         // Step 2: 创建 SpeechTranscriber
 191 |         // 使用 progressiveTranscription 预设支持实时转录
 192 |         let transcriber = SpeechTranscriber(
 193 |             locale: supportedLocale,
 194 |             preset: .progressiveTranscription
 195 |         )
 196 |         self.transcriber = transcriber
 197 |         
 198 |         // Step 3: 检查并安装所需资产
 199 |         try await ensureAssetsInstalled(for: transcriber)
 200 |         
 201 |         // Step 4: 获取最佳音频格式
 202 |         guard let format = await SpeechAnalyzer.bestAvailableAudioFormat(compatibleWith: [transcriber]) else {
 203 |             logger.error("❌ No compatible audio format available")
 204 |             throw TranscriptionError.processingFailed("No compatible audio format")
 205 |         }
 206 |         self.targetAudioFormat = format
 207 |         logger.info("📢 Using audio format: \(format)")
 208 |         
 209 |         // Step 5: 创建输入流
 210 |         let (inputSequence, inputBuilder) = AsyncStream.makeStream(of: AnalyzerInput.self)
 211 |         self.inputContinuation = inputBuilder
 212 |         
 213 |         // Step 6: 创建 SpeechAnalyzer
 214 |         let analyzer = SpeechAnalyzer(modules: [transcriber])
 215 |         self.analyzer = analyzer
 216 |         
 217 |         // Step 7: 预热分析器
 218 |         try await analyzer.prepareToAnalyze(in: format)
 219 |         
 220 |         // Step 8: 启动结果监听
 221 |         resultsTask = Task { [weak self] in
 222 |             await self?.listenForResults(transcriber: transcriber)
 223 |         }
 224 |         
 225 |         // Step 9: 启动分析（自主模式）
 226 |         analyzeTask = Task { [weak self] in
 227 |             do {
 228 |                 try await analyzer.start(inputSequence: inputSequence)
 229 |             } catch {
 230 |                 await MainActor.run {
 231 |                     self?.onError?(error)
 232 |                 }
 233 |             }
 234 |         }
 235 |         
 236 |         logger.info("✅ SpeechAnalyzer setup complete for locale: \(supportedLocale.identifier)")

 253 |     private func listenForResults(transcriber: SpeechTranscriber) async {
 254 |         do {
 255 |             for try await result in transcriber.results {
 256 |                 await handleResult(result)
 257 |             }
 258 |         } catch {
 259 |             await MainActor.run { [weak self] in

 261 |                 self?.onError?(error)

 266 |     private func handleResult(_ result: SpeechTranscriber.Result) async {
 267 |         // 从 AttributedString 提取纯文本
 268 |         let segmentText = String(result.text.characters)
 269 |         let isFinal = result.isFinal
 270 |         
 271 |         await MainActor.run { [weak self] in
 272 |             guard let self = self else { return }
 273 |             
 274 |             if isFinal {
 275 |                 // Final 结果：累积到 finalizedText
 276 |                 self.finalizedText += segmentText
 277 |                 self.volatileText = ""  // 清空 volatile
 278 |

 280 |                 self.logger.info("📝 Total: \(self.finalizedText)")
 281 |             } else {

 283 |                 self.volatileText = segmentText

 290 |                 finalizedText: self.finalizedText,
 291 |                 volatileText: self.volatileText,
 292 |                 type: .partial  // 录音未结束，始终是 partial
 293 |             )

  29 | @MainActor

  55 |

  66 |         
  67 |         // SFSpeechRecognizer (始终可用)

  70 |         // TODO: Whisper Local
  71 |         
  72 |         return engines
  73 |     }
  74 |     
  75 |     /// 获取当前最佳引擎类型
  76 |     func bestAvailableEngine() -> TranscriptionEngineType {
  77 |         if let forced = forceEngineType {

  79 |         }
  80 |         
  81 |         // 优先使用 SpeechAnalyzer (macOS 26+)
  82 |         if #available(macOS 26.0, *) {
  83 |             return .speechAnalyzer
  84 |         }
  85 |         
  86 |         // 回退到 SFSpeechRecognizer
  87 |         return .sfSpeech
  88 |     }
  89 |

  96 |             }
  97 |             return nil
  98 |

 101 |             
 102 |         case .whisperLocal:
 103 |             // TODO: 实现 Whisper 本地引擎

 105 |             return nil
 106 |         }

 109 |     /// 自动选择并创建最佳引擎
 110 |     func createBestProvider() -> TranscriptionProvider {
 111 |         let engineType = bestAvailableEngine()
 112 |         
 113 |         if let provider = createProvider(type: engineType) {
 114 |             currentProvider = provider
 115 |             currentEngineType = engineType
 116 |             logger.info("✅ Using engine: \(engineType.displayName)")
 117 |             return provider
 118 |         }
 119 |         
 120 |         // 强制回退到 SFSpeech
 121 |         let fallback = SFSpeechProvider(locale: preferredLocale)

 133 |                 continuation.resume(returning: granted)
 134 |             }
 135 |         }
 136 |         
 137 |         guard micGranted else {
 138 |             logger.warning("⚠️ Microphone permission denied")

 140 |         }
 141 |         
 142 |         // 语音识别权限 (通过 provider 请求)

 145 |         
 146 |         guard speechGranted else {

 149 |         }
 150 |         
 151 |         logger.info("✅ All permissions granted")

 162 |         let status = available ? "可用" : "不可用"

 164 |         return "\(type.displayName) - \(status)"

   6 | /// 转录结果类型

  26 |     
  27 |     /// 完整构造器
  28 |     init(finalizedText: String, volatileText: String, type: TranscriptionResultType, confidence: Float? = nil, timestamp: TimeInterval? = nil) {
  29 |         self.finalizedText = finalizedText
  30 |         self.volatileText = volatileText
  31 |         self.text = finalizedText + volatileText
  32 |         self.type = type
  33 |         self.confidence = confidence

  42 |         if type == .final {

  44 |             self.volatileText = ""
  45 |         } else {
  46 |             self.finalizedText = ""
  47 |             self.volatileText = text
  48 |         }
  49 |         self.type = type
  50 |         self.confidence = confidence
  51 |         self.timestamp = timestamp
  52 |     }
  53 | }
  54 | 
  55 | // MARK: - Provider Capability
  56 | 
  57 | /// 转录引擎能力
  58 | struct TranscriptionCapability: OptionSet {
  59 |     let rawValue: Int
  60 |     
  61 |     /// 支持实时转录（边说边出文字）
  62 |     static let realtime = TranscriptionCapability(rawValue: 1 << 0)
  63 |     /// 支持离线模式
  64 |     static let offline = TranscriptionCapability(rawValue: 1 << 1)
  65 |     /// 支持长时间录音（>1分钟）
  66 |     static let longForm = TranscriptionCapability(rawValue: 1 << 2)
  67 |     /// 支持自动添加标点
  68 |     static let punctuation = TranscriptionCapability(rawValue: 1 << 3)
  69 |     /// 支持多语言
  70 |     static let multilingual = TranscriptionCapability(rawValue: 1 << 4)
  71 | }
  72 | 
  73 | // MARK: - Provider Protocol
  74 | 
  75 | /// 转录引擎协议
  76 | /// 所有语音转文字引擎必须实现此协议
  77 | @MainActor
  78 | protocol TranscriptionProvider: AnyObject {
  79 |     
  80 |     /// 引擎唯一标识符
  81 |     var identifier: String { get }
  82 |     
  83 |     /// 引擎显示名称
  84 |     var displayName: String { get }
  85 |     
  86 |     /// 引擎能力
  87 |     var capabilities: TranscriptionCapability { get }
  88 |     
  89 |     /// 当前是否可用（权限、网络等）
  90 |     var isAvailable: Bool { get }
  91 |     
  92 |     /// 当前语言
  93 |     var locale: Locale { get set }
  94 |     
  95 |     /// 支持的语言列表
  96 |     var supportedLocales: [Locale] { get }
  97 |     
  98 |     // MARK: - Callbacks
  99 |     
 100 |     /// 转录结果回调
 101 |     var onResult: ((TranscriptionResult) -> Void)? { get set }
 102 |     
 103 |     /// 错误回调
 104 |     var onError: ((Error) -> Void)? { get set }
 105 |     
 106 |     // MARK: - Lifecycle
 107 |     
 108 |     /// 请求必要权限
 109 |     func requestAuthorization() async -> Bool
 110 |     
 111 |     /// 准备引擎（预热、加载模型等）
 112 |     func prepare() async throws
 113 |     
 114 |     /// 处理音频缓冲区
 115 |     func process(buffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer) throws
 116 |     
 117 |     /// 结束音频输入（等待最终结果）
 118 |     func finishProcessing() async throws
 119 |     
 120 |     /// 取消当前转录
 121 |     func cancel()
 122 |     
 123 |     /// 重置状态
 124 |     func reset()
 125 | }
 126 | 
 127 | // MARK: - Provider Info
 128 | 
 129 | /// 引擎信息（用于 UI 展示）
 130 | struct TranscriptionProviderInfo {
 131 |     let identifier: String
 132 |     let displayName: String
 133 |     let description: String
 134 |     let capabilities: TranscriptionCapability
 135 |     let minOSVersion: String
 136 |     let isAvailable: Bool
 137 | }
 138 | 
 139 | // MARK: - Provider Error
 140 | 
 141 | enum TranscriptionError: LocalizedError {
 142 |     case notAvailable
 143 |     case notAuthorized
 144 |     case engineNotReady
 145 |     case processingFailed(String)
 146 |     case unsupportedLocale(Locale)
 147 |     case modelNotInstalled
 148 |     case cancelled
 149 |     
 150 |     var errorDescription: String? {
 151 |         switch self {
 152 |         case .notAvailable:
 153 |             return "转录引擎不可用"
 154 |         case .notAuthorized:
 155 |             return "未授权使用语音识别"
 156 |         case .engineNotReady:
 157 |             return "引擎未就绪"
 158 |         case .processingFailed(let reason):
 159 |             return "处理失败: \(reason)"
 160 |         case .unsupportedLocale(let locale):
 161 |             return "不支持的语言: \(locale.identifier)"
 162 |         case .modelNotInstalled:
 163 |             return "语言模型未安装"
 164 |         case .cancelled:
 165 |             return "已取消"
 166 |         }
 167 |     }
 168 | }

   7 | enum KeyComboFormatter {
   8 |     /// 将 keyCode 和 modifiers 格式化为可读字符串
   9 |     static func format(keyCode: Int, modifiers: Int) -> String {
  10 |         var parts: [String] = []
  11 |         let flags = NSEvent.ModifierFlags(rawValue: UInt(modifiers))
  12 |         
  13 |         if flags.contains(.control) { parts.append("⌃") }
  14 |         if flags.contains(.option) { parts.append("⌥") }
  15 |         if flags.contains(.shift) { parts.append("⇧") }
  16 |         if flags.contains(.command) { parts.append("⌘") }
  17 |         
  18 |         if let keyName = keyCodeToString(keyCode) {
  19 |             parts.append(keyName)
  20 |         }
  21 |         
  22 |         return parts.joined(separator: " + ")
  23 |     }

   1 | import Foundation
   2 | import AVFoundation
   3 | import CoreAudio
   4 | 
   5 | @MainActor
   6 | class AudioDeviceManager: ObservableObject {
   7 |     @Published var devices: [AudioDevice] = []
   8 |     @Published var currentInputDeviceId: String? {
   9 |         didSet {
  10 |             if let id = currentInputDeviceId {
  11 |                 UserDefaults.standard.set(id, forKey: "SelectedMicrophoneId")
  12 |             }
  13 |         }
  14 |     }
  15 |     
  16 |     struct AudioDevice: Identifiable, Hashable {
  17 |         let id: String
  18 |         let name: String
  19 |     }
  20 |     
  21 |     init() {
  22 |         self.currentInputDeviceId = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: "SelectedMicrophoneId")
  23 |         refreshDevices()
  24 |         
  25 |         // 监听设备变化
  26 |         // 在实际应用中，应该监听 CoreAudio 的属性变化，这里简化为每次出现 Settings 时刷新
  27 |     }
  28 |     
  29 |     func refreshDevices() {
  30 |         var newDevices: [AudioDevice] = []
  31 |         
  32 |         let discoverySession = AVCaptureDevice.DiscoverySession(
  33 |             deviceTypes: [.microphone, .external],
  34 |             mediaType: .audio,
  35 |             position: .unspecified
  36 |         )
  37 |         
  38 |         for device in discoverySession.devices {
  39 |             newDevices.append(AudioDevice(id: device.uniqueID, name: device.localizedName))
  40 |         }
  41 |         
  42 |         self.devices = newDevices
  43 |         
  44 |         // 如果没有选中的设备，或者选中的设备不存在了，选择第一个
  45 |         if currentInputDeviceId == nil || !newDevices.contains(where: { $0.id == currentInputDeviceId }) {
  46 |             currentInputDeviceId = newDevices.first?.id
  47 |         }
  48 |     }
  49 | }

```swift
   1 | import AVFoundation
   2 | import Combine
   3 | import os
   4 | 
   5 | /// 音频播放服务
   6 | /// 负责历史记录中音频的播放、暂停、进度控制
   7 | @MainActor
   8 | final class AudioPlayerService: NSObject, ObservableObject {
   9 |     
  10 |     // MARK: - Singleton
  11 |     
  12 |     static let shared = AudioPlayerService()
  13 |     
  14 |     private let logger = Logger(subsystem: "com.spokeanywhere", category: "AudioPlayer")
  15 |     
  16 |     // MARK: - Published Properties
  17 |     
  18 |     @Published private(set) var isPlaying: Bool = false
  19 |     @Published private(set) var progress: Double = 0  // 0.0 ~ 1.0
  20 |     @Published private(set) var duration: TimeInterval = 0
  21 |     @Published private(set) var currentTime: TimeInterval = 0
  22 |     @Published private(set) var currentURL: URL?
  23 |     
  24 |     // MARK: - Private Properties
  25 |     
  26 |     private var player: AVAudioPlayer?
  27 |     private var progressTimer: Timer?
  28 |     
  29 |     // MARK: - Init
  30 |     
  31 |     private override init() {
  32 |         super.init()
  33 |     }
  34 |     
  35 |     // MARK: - Public API
  36 |     
  37 |     /// 播放音频
  38 |     /// - Parameter url: 音频文件 URL
  39 |     func play(_ url: URL) throws {
  40 |         // 如果正在播放其他音频，先停止
  41 |         if isPlaying {
  42 |             stop()
  43 |         }
  44 |         
  45 |         // 创建播放器
  46 |         player = try AVAudioPlayer(contentsOf: url)
  47 |         player?.delegate = self
  48 |         
  49 |         guard let player = player else {
  50 |             throw AudioPlayerError.playerCreationFailed
  51 |         }
  52 |         
  53 |         // 更新状态
  54 |         currentURL = url
  55 |         duration = player.duration
  56 |         currentTime = 0
  57 |         progress = 0
  58 |         
  59 |         // 开始播放
  60 |         player.play()
  61 |         isPlaying = true
  62 |         startProgressTimer()
  63 |         
  64 |         logger.info("▶️ Playing: \(url.lastPathComponent)")
  65 |     }
  66 |     
  67 |     /// 暂停播放
  68 |     func pause() {
  69 |         player?.pause()
  70 |         isPlaying = false
  71 |         stopProgressTimer()
  72 |         logger.info("⏸️ Paused")
  73 |     }
  74 |     
  75 |     /// 继续播放
  76 |     func resume() {
  77 |         player?.play()
  78 |         isPlaying = true
  79 |         startProgressTimer()
  80 |         logger.info("▶️ Resumed")
  81 |     }
  82 |     
  83 |     /// 停止播放
  84 |     func stop() {
  85 |         player?.stop()
  86 |         player = nil
  87 |         isPlaying = false
  88 |         currentURL = nil
  89 |         currentTime = 0
  90 |         progress = 0
  91 |         duration = 0
  92 |         stopProgressTimer()
  93 |         logger.info("⏹️ Stopped")
  94 |     }
  95 |     
  96 |     /// 跳转到指定时间
  97 |     /// - Parameter time: 目标时间（秒）
  98 |     func seek(to time: TimeInterval) {
  99 |         guard let player = player else { return }
 100 |         
 101 |         let clampedTime = max(0, min(time, duration))
 102 |         player.currentTime = clampedTime
 103 |         currentTime = clampedTime
 104 |         progress = duration > 0 ? clampedTime / duration : 0
 105 |     }
 106 |     
 107 |     /// 跳转到指定进度
 108 |     /// - Parameter progress: 目标进度（0.0 ~ 1.0）
 109 |     func seek(toProgress newProgress: Double) {
 110 |         let targetTime = duration * max(0, min(newProgress, 1))
 111 |         seek(to: targetTime)
 112 |     }
 113 |     
 114 |     /// 切换播放/暂停
 115 |     func togglePlayPause() {
 116 |         if isPlaying {
 117 |             pause()
 118 |         } else {
 119 |             resume()
 120 |         }
 121 |     }
 122 |     
 123 |     /// 检查是否正在播放指定 URL
 124 |     func isPlaying(url: URL) -> Bool {
 125 |         return isPlaying && currentURL == url
 126 |     }
 127 |     
 128 |     // MARK: - Private Methods
 129 |     
 130 |     private func startProgressTimer() {
 131 |         stopProgressTimer()
 132 |         
 133 |         progressTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: 0.1, repeats: true) { [weak self] _ in
 134 |             Task { @MainActor in
 135 |                 self?.updateProgress()
 136 |             }
 137 |         }
 138 |     }
 139 |     
 140 |     private func stopProgressTimer() {
 141 |         progressTimer?.invalidate()
 142 |         progressTimer = nil
 143 |     }
 144 |     
 145 |     private func updateProgress() {
 146 |         guard let player = player else { return }
 147 |         
 148 |         currentTime = player.currentTime
 149 |         progress = duration > 0 ? currentTime / duration : 0
 150 |     }
 151 | }
 152 | 
 153 | // MARK: - AVAudioPlayerDelegate
 154 | 
 155 | extension AudioPlayerService: AVAudioPlayerDelegate {
 156 |     nonisolated func audioPlayerDidFinishPlaying(_ player: AVAudioPlayer, successfully flag: Bool) {
 157 |         Task { @MainActor in
 158 |             self.isPlaying = false
 159 |             self.progress = 1.0
 160 |             self.currentTime = self.duration
 161 |             self.stopProgressTimer()
 162 |             self.logger.info("✅ Playback finished")
 163 |         }
 164 |     }
 165 |     
 166 |     nonisolated func audioPlayerDecodeErrorDidOccur(_ player: AVAudioPlayer, error: Error?) {
 167 |         Task { @MainActor in
 168 |             self.logger.error("❌ Decode error: \(error?.localizedDescription ?? "Unknown")")
 169 |             self.stop()
 170 |         }
 171 |     }
 172 | }
 173 |

 108 |     // MARK: - Private
 109 |     
 110 |     private func checkClipboard() {
 111 |         let currentCount = NSPasteboard.general.changeCount
 112 |         guard currentCount != lastChangeCount else { return }
 113 |         lastChangeCount = currentCount
 114 |         
 115 |         // 获取剪贴板文本
 116 |         guard let content = NSPasteboard.general.string(forType: .string),
 117 |               !content.isEmpty else { return }
 118 |         
 119 |         // 过滤敏感内容
 120 |         if isSensitive(content) {
 121 |             logger.debug("📋 Skipped sensitive content")
 122 |             return
 123 |         }
 124 |         
 125 |         // 过滤垃圾内容（调试日志、CSV、太短）
 126 |         if shouldIgnore(content) {
 127 |             logger.debug("📋 Skipped ignored content")
 128 |             return
 129 |         }
 130 |         
 131 |         // 截断过长内容
 132 |         let truncated = content.count > Self.maxItemLength
 133 |             ? String(content.prefix(Self.maxItemLength))
 134 |             : content
 135 |         
 136 |         // 去重：如果最近一条相同则跳过（只过滤完全一致的连续内容）
 137 |         if let lastItem = history.first, lastItem.content == truncated {
 138 |             return
 139 |         }
 140 |         
 141 |         // 添加到历史
 142 |         let item = ClipboardItem(content: truncated, timestamp: Date())
 143 |         history.insert(item, at: 0)
 144 |         
 145 |         // 限制条数
 146 |         let limit = AppSettings.shared.clipboardHistoryLimit
 147 |         if history.count > limit {
 148 |             history = Array(history.prefix(limit))
 149 |         }
 150 |         
 151 |         // 持久化
 152 |         saveHistory()
 153 |         
 154 |         logger.info("📋 Added to history: \(truncated.prefix(80))...")
 155 |         print("📋 Clipboard history count: \(history.count), latest: \(truncated.prefix(80))...")
 156 |     }
 157 |     
 158 |     /// 检测是否应忽略（垃圾过滤）
 159 |     private func shouldIgnore(_ content: String) -> Bool {
 160 |         // 长度检查 (忽略 < 2 字符)
 161 |         if content.count < 2 { return true }
 162 |         
 163 |         // 包含特定关键词的调试日志
 164 |         let ignoredKeywords = [
 165 |             "DEBUG",
 166 |             "Clipboard history count",
 167 |             "timestamp,scope,file", // CSV Header
 168 |             "SpokenAnyWhere", // Log app name
 169 |             "LLM PROMPT",
 170 |             "System Prompt",
 171 |             "User Message",
 172 |             "Audio files cannot be non-interleaved", // CoreAudio log
 173 |             "Building for debugging", // Swift build log
 174 |             "Emitting module"
 175 |         ]
 176 |         
 177 |         for keyword in ignoredKeywords {
 178 |             if content.contains(keyword) { return true }
 179 |         }
 180 |         
 181 |         return false
 182 |     }
 183 |     
 184 |     /// 检测敏感内容
 185 |     private func isSensitive(_ content: String) -> Bool {
 186 |         let lowercased = content.lowercased()
 187 |         
 188 |         // 密码模式
 189 |         if lowercased.contains("password") || lowercased.contains("passwd") {
 190 |             return true
 191 |         }
 192 |         
 193 |         // API Key 模式
 194 |         if lowercased.contains("api_key") || lowercased.contains("apikey") ||
 195 |            lowercased.contains("secret") || lowercased.contains("token") {
 196 |             return true
 197 |         }
 198 |         
 199 |         // 看起来像密钥的长字符串（全是字母数字，无空格，超过 30 字符）
 200 |         if content.count > 30 &&
 201 |            !content.contains(" ") &&
 202 |            content.allSatisfy({ $0.isLetter || $0.isNumber || $0 == "-" || $0 == "_" }) {
 203 |             return true
 204 |         }
 205 |         
 206 |         return false
 207 |     }
 208 |     
 209 |     // MARK: - Persistence
 210 |     
 211 |     private func saveHistory() {
 212 |         do {
 213 |             let data = try JSONEncoder().encode(history)
 214 |             UserDefaults.standard.set(data, forKey: Self.storageKey)
 215 |         } catch {
 216 |             logger.error("❌ Failed to save history: \(error)")
 217 |         }
 218 |     }
 219 |     
 220 |     private func loadHistory() {
 221 |         guard let data = UserDefaults.standard.data(forKey: Self.storageKey) else { return }
 222 |         do {
 223 |             let loaded = try JSONDecoder().decode([ClipboardItem].self, from: data)
 224 |             // 启动时清洗脏数据：应用 shouldIgnore 规则
 225 |             history = loaded.filter { !shouldIgnore($0.content) }
 226 |             logger.info("📋 Loaded \(self.history.count) history items (cleaned from \(loaded.count))")
 227 |         } catch {
 228 |             logger.error("❌ Failed to load history: \(error)")
 229 |         }
 230 |     }
 231 | }

   1 | import AppKit
