   3 | 
   4 | /// 上下文感知服务
   5 | /// 监听当前活动 App，提供 Prompt 拼接
   6 | @MainActor
   7 | final class ContextService {
   8 |     
   9 |     // MARK: - Singleton
  10 |     
  11 |     static let shared = ContextService()
  12 |     
  13 |     // MARK: - Properties
  14 |     
  15 |     /// 当前活动 App
  16 |     private(set) var currentApp: TargetAppInfo?
  17 |     
  18 |     /// App 切换通知
  19 |     private var cancellables = Set<AnyCancellable>()
  20 |     
  21 |     // MARK: - Init
  22 |     
  23 |     private init() {
  24 |         setupObservers()
  25 |         updateCurrentApp()
  26 |     }
  27 |     
  28 |     // MARK: - Public API
  29 |     
  30 |     /// 获取当前活动 App 信息
  31 |     func getCurrentTargetApp() -> TargetAppInfo? {
  32 |         return currentApp
  33 |     }
  34 |     
  35 |     /// 根据当前 App 拼接 Prompt
  36 |     /// - Parameter globalPrompt: 全局 Prompt
  37 |     /// - Parameter appRules: App 规则列表（从 SwiftData 查询）
  38 |     /// - Returns: 拼接后的完整 Prompt
  39 |     func assemblePrompt(globalPrompt: String, appRules: [AppRule]) -> String {
  40 |         guard let currentApp = currentApp else {
  41 |             return globalPrompt
  42 |         }
  43 |         
  44 |         // 查找匹配的 App 规则
  45 |         let matchedRule = appRules.first { rule in
  46 |             rule.bundleId == currentApp.bundleIdentifier && rule.isEnabled
  47 |         }
  48 |         
  49 |         if let rule = matchedRule {
  50 |             return """
  51 |             \(globalPrompt)
  52 |             
  53 |             [当前应用: \(currentApp.name)]
  54 |             \(rule.extraPrompt)
  55 |             """
  56 |         }
  57 |         
  58 |         return globalPrompt
  59 |     }
  60 |     
  61 |     // MARK: - Private
  62 |     
  63 |     private func setupObservers() {
  64 |         // 监听 App 激活通知
  65 |         NSWorkspace.shared.notificationCenter
  66 |             .publisher(for: NSWorkspace.didActivateApplicationNotification)
  67 |             .receive(on: DispatchQueue.main)
  68 |             .sink { [weak self] notification in
  69 |                 self?.handleAppActivation(notification)
  70 |             }
  71 |             .store(in: &cancellables)
  72 |     }
  73 |     
  74 |     private func handleAppActivation(_ notification: Notification) {
  75 |         updateCurrentApp()
  76 |     }
  77 |     
  78 |     private func updateCurrentApp() {
  79 |         guard let frontApp = NSWorkspace.shared.frontmostApplication else {
  80 |             currentApp = nil
  81 |             return
  82 |         }
  83 |         
  84 |         // 排除自身
  85 |         if frontApp.bundleIdentifier == Bundle.main.bundleIdentifier {
  86 |             return
  87 |         }
  88 |         
  89 |         currentApp = TargetAppInfo.from(frontApp)
  90 |     }
  91 | }

   1 | import Foundation
   2 | import AVFoundation
   3 | import CryptoKit
   4 | 
   5 | // MARK: - Edge TTS 常量
   6 | 
   7 | private enum EdgeTTSConstants {
   8 |     static let chromiumVersion = "130.0.2849.68"
   9 |     static let trustedClientToken = "6A5AA1D4EAFF4E9FB37E23D68491D6F4"
  10 |     static let windowsFileTimeEpoch: Int64 = 11_644_473_600
  11 | }
  12 | 
  13 | // MARK: - DRM Helper
  14 | 
  15 | private enum DRMHelper {
  16 |     /// 生成 Sec-MS-GEC Token (DRM 验证)
  17 |     static func generateSecMsGecToken() -> String {
  18 |         let currentTime = Int64(Date().timeIntervalSince1970)
  19 |         let ticks = (currentTime + EdgeTTSConstants.windowsFileTimeEpoch) * 10_000_000
  20 |         let roundedTicks = ticks - (ticks % 3_000_000_000)
  21 |         
  22 |         let strToHash = "\(roundedTicks)\(EdgeTTSConstants.trustedClientToken)"
  23 |         guard let data = strToHash.data(using: .ascii) else { return "" }
  24 |         
  25 |         let hash = SHA256.hash(data: data)
  26 |         return hash.map { String(format: "%02X", $0) }.joined()
  27 |     }
  28 | }
  29 | 
  30 | // MARK: - Edge TTS 错误
  31 | 
  32 | enum EdgeTTSError: Error, LocalizedError {
  33 |     case invalidURL
  34 |     case connectionFailed
  35 |     case noAudioData
  36 |     case synthesizeFailed(String)
  37 |     
  38 |     var errorDescription: String? {
  39 |         switch self {
  40 |         case .invalidURL: return "无效的 URL"
  41 |         case .connectionFailed: return "连接失败"
  42 |         case .noAudioData: return "没有音频数据"
  43 |         case .synthesizeFailed(let msg): return "合成失败: \(msg)"
  44 |         }
  45 |     }
  46 | }
  47 | 
  48 | // MARK: - Edge TTS WebSocket 客户端
  49 | 
  50 | actor EdgeTTSClient {
  51 |     
  52 |     private var webSocketTask: URLSessionWebSocketTask?
  53 |     private var audioData = Data()
  54 |     
  55 |     /// 合成语音
  56 |     func synthesize(text: String, voice: EdgeVoice, rate: Int, pitch: Int) async throws -> Data {
  57 |         audioData = Data()
  58 |         
  59 |         // 构建带 DRM Token 的 URL
  60 |         let secMsGec = DRMHelper.generateSecMsGecToken()
  61 |         let urlString = "wss://speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/speech/synthesize/readaloud/edge/v1?TrustedClientToken=\(EdgeTTSConstants.trustedClientToken)&Sec-MS-GEC=\(secMsGec)&Sec-MS-GEC-Version=1-\(EdgeTTSConstants.chromiumVersion)"
  62 |         
  63 |         guard let url = URL(string: urlString) else {
  64 |             throw EdgeTTSError.invalidURL
  65 |         }
  66 |         
  67 |         print("[EdgeTTS] Connecting...")
  68 |         
  69 |         // 创建 WebSocket 请求
  70 |         var request = URLRequest(url: url)
  71 |         request.setValue("chrome-extension://jdiccldimpdaibmpdkjnbmckianbfold", forHTTPHeaderField: "Origin")
  72 |         request.setValue("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/\(EdgeTTSConstants.chromiumVersion) Safari/537.36 Edg/\(EdgeTTSConstants.chromiumVersion)", forHTTPHeaderField: "User-Agent")
  73 |         
  74 |         // 使用 delegate 模式连接
  75 |         let delegate = WebSocketDelegate()
  76 |         let session = URLSession(configuration: .default, delegate: delegate, delegateQueue: nil)
  77 |         webSocketTask = session.webSocketTask(with: request)
  78 |         webSocketTask?.resume()
  79 |         
  80 |         // 等待连接建立
  81 |         try await delegate.waitForConnection()
  82 |         print("[EdgeTTS] Connected!")
  83 |         
  84 |         // 发送配置消息
  85 |         let configMessage = "Content-Type:application/json; charset=utf-8\r\nPath:speech.config\r\n\r\n{\"context\":{\"synthesis\":{\"audio\":{\"metadataoptions\":{\"sentenceBoundaryEnabled\":\"false\",\"wordBoundaryEnabled\":\"false\"},\"outputFormat\":\"audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3\"}}}}"
  86 |         try await webSocketTask?.send(.string(configMessage))
  87 |         print("[EdgeTTS] Config sent")
  88 |         
  89 |         // 构建 SSML
  90 |         let rateStr = rate >= 0 ? "+\(rate)%" : "\(rate)%"
  91 |         let pitchStr = pitch >= 0 ? "+\(pitch)Hz" : "\(pitch)Hz"
  92 |         
  93 |         let ssml = """
  94 |         <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="\(voice.language)">
  95 |             <voice name="\(voice.rawValue)">
  96 |                 <prosody rate="\(rateStr)" pitch="\(pitchStr)" volume="+0%">
  97 |                     \(escapeXML(text))
  98 |                 </prosody>
  99 |             </voice>
 100 |         </speak>
 101 |         """
 102 |         
 103 |         let requestId = UUID().uuidString
 104 |         let ssmlMessage = "X-RequestId:\(requestId)\r\nContent-Type:application/ssml+xml\r\nPath:ssml\r\n\r\n\(ssml)"
 105 |         try await webSocketTask?.send(.string(ssmlMessage))
 106 |         print("[EdgeTTS] SSML sent, waiting for audio...")
 107 |         
 108 |         // 接收音频数据
 109 |         try await receiveMessages()
 110 |         
 111 |         print("[EdgeTTS] Received \(audioData.count) bytes")
 112 |         
 113 |         guard !audioData.isEmpty else {
 114 |             throw EdgeTTSError.noAudioData
 115 |         }
 116 |         
 117 |         return audioData
 118 |     }
 119 |     
 120 |     /// 接收消息
 121 |     private func receiveMessages() async throws {
 122 |         guard let ws = webSocketTask else { return }
 123 |         
 124 |         while true {
 125 |             do {
 126 |                 let message = try await ws.receive()
 127 |                 
 128 |                 switch message {
 129 |                 case .data(let data):
 130 |                     // 尝试解析为字符串看是否包含 Path:audio
 131 |                     if let dataStr = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8),
 132 |                        dataStr.contains("Path:audio\r\n") {
 133 |                         // 找到音频分隔符后的数据
 134 |                         let separator = "Path:audio\r\n"
 135 |                         if let range = dataStr.range(of: separator) {
 136 |                             let audioStartIndex = data.startIndex + range.upperBound.utf16Offset(in: dataStr)
 137 |                             let audioSubData = data[audioStartIndex...]
 138 |                             audioData.append(audioSubData)
 139 |                         }
 140 |                     } else {
 141 |                         // 纯二进制音频数据
 142 |                         audioData.append(data)
 143 |                     }
 144 |                     
 145 |                 case .string(let text):
 146 |                     if text.contains("Path:turn.end") {
 147 |                         print("[EdgeTTS] Turn ended")
 148 |                         return
 149 |                     }
 150 |                     
 151 |                 @unknown default:
 152 |                     break
 153 |                 }
 154 |             } catch {
 155 |                 print("[EdgeTTS] Error: \(error)")
 156 |                 return
 157 |             }
 158 |         }
 159 |     }
 160 |     
 161 |     /// 转义 XML 特殊字符
 162 |     private func escapeXML(_ text: String) -> String {
 163 |         text.replacingOccurrences(of: "&", with: "&amp;")
 164 |             .replacingOccurrences(of: "<", with: "&lt;")
 165 |             .replacingOccurrences(of: ">", with: "&gt;")
 166 |             .replacingOccurrences(of: "\"", with: "&quot;")
 167 |             .replacingOccurrences(of: "'", with: "&apos;")
 168 |     }
 169 |     
 170 |     /// 取消
 171 |     func cancel() {
 172 |         webSocketTask?.cancel(with: .goingAway, reason: nil)
 173 |         webSocketTask = nil
 174 |     }
 175 | }

 181 |     
 182 |     func waitForConnection() async throws {

 186 |     }

 277 |         // 移除代码块
 278 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "```[^`]*```", with: "", options: .regularExpression)
 279 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "`[^`]+`", with: "", options: .regularExpression)
 280 |         
 281 |         // 移除标题符号 # 
 282 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "^#{1,6}\\s*", with: "", options: .regularExpression)
 283 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "\n#{1,6}\\s*", with: "\n", options: .regularExpression)
 284 |         
 285 |         // 移除加粗/斜体 *、**、***、_、__
 286 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "\\*{1,3}([^*]+)\\*{1,3}", with: "$1", options: .regularExpression)
 287 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "_{1,2}([^_]+)_{1,2}", with: "$1", options: .regularExpression)
 288 |         
 289 |         // 移除链接 [text](url) -> text
 290 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "\\[([^\\]]+)\\]\\([^)]+\\)", with: "$1", options: .regularExpression)
 291 |         
 292 |         // 移除图片 ![alt](url)
 293 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "!\\[[^\\]]*\\]\\([^)]+\\)", with: "", options: .regularExpression)
 294 |         
 295 |         // 移除列表符号 - 、* 、+ 、数字.
 296 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "^[\\-\\*\\+]\\s+", with: "", options: .regularExpression)
 297 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "\n[\\-\\*\\+]\\s+", with: "\n", options: .regularExpression)
 298 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "^\\d+\\.\\s+", with: "", options: .regularExpression)
 299 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "\n\\d+\\.\\s+", with: "\n", options: .regularExpression)
 300 |         
 301 |         // 移除引用符号 >
 302 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "^>\\s*", with: "", options: .regularExpression)
 303 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "\n>\\s*", with: "\n", options: .regularExpression)
 304 |         
 305 |         // 移除分隔线 ---、***、___
 306 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "^[\\-\\*_]{3,}$", with: "", options: .regularExpression)
 307 |         
 308 |         // 清理多余空行
 309 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "\n{3,}", with: "\n\n", options: .regularExpression)
 310 |         
 311 |         return result.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
 312 |     }
 313 |     
 314 |     /// 停止朗读
 315 |     func stop() {
 316 |         speakTask?.cancel()
 317 |         speakTask = nil
 318 |         synthesizer.stopSpeaking(at: .immediate)
 319 |         audioPlayer?.stop()
 320 |         audioPlayer = nil
 321 |         Task { await edgeClient.cancel() }
 322 |         chunks = []
 323 |         isPlaying = false
 324 |         isSynthesizing = false
 325 |         currentChunkIndex = 0
 326 |         totalChunks = 0
 327 |     }
 328 |     
 329 |     // MARK: - Chunk Processing
 330 |     
 331 |     /// 将文本分割成块（按句子分割）
 332 |     private func splitTextIntoChunks(_ text: String) -> [String] {
 333 |         let chunkSize = settings.chunkSize
 334 |         
 335 |         // 如果 chunkSize 为 0 或文本较短，不分块
 336 |         if chunkSize == 0 || text.count <= chunkSize {
 337 |             return [text]
 338 |         }
 339 |         
 340 |         var chunks: [String] = []
 341 |         var currentChunk = ""
 342 |         
 343 |         // 按句子分割符分割
 344 |         let sentenceDelimiters = CharacterSet(charactersIn: "。！？.!?\n")
 345 |         let sentences = text.components(separatedBy: sentenceDelimiters)
 346 |             .map { $0.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces) }
 347 |             .filter { !$0.isEmpty }
 348 |         
 349 |         for sentence in sentences {
 350 |             // 找回分隔符
 351 |             let range = text.range(of: sentence)
 352 |             var fullSentence = sentence
 353 |             if let range = range {
 354 |                 let endIndex = range.upperBound
 355 |                 if endIndex < text.endIndex {
 356 |                     let delimiter = text[endIndex]
 357 |                     if sentenceDelimiters.contains(delimiter.unicodeScalars.first!) {
 358 |                         fullSentence += String(delimiter)
 359 |                     }
 360 |                 }
 361 |             }
 362 |             
 363 |             // 如果当前块加上新句子超过限制，保存当前块
 364 |             if currentChunk.count + fullSentence.count > chunkSize && !currentChunk.isEmpty {
 365 |                 chunks.append(currentChunk)
 366 |                 currentChunk = fullSentence
 367 |             } else {
 368 |                 currentChunk += fullSentence
 369 |             }
 370 |         }
 371 |         
 372 |         // 保存最后一块
 373 |         if !currentChunk.isEmpty {
 374 |             chunks.append(currentChunk)
 375 |         }
 376 |         
 377 |         return chunks.isEmpty ? [text] : chunks
 378 |     }
 379 |     
 380 |     /// 逐块朗读
 381 |     private func speakChunks() async {
 382 |         for (index, chunk) in chunks.enumerated() {
 383 |             guard !Task.isCancelled else { break }
 384 |             
 385 |             currentChunkIndex = index
 386 |             
 387 |             switch settings.provider {
 388 |             case .system:
 389 |                 await speakChunkWithSystem(chunk)
 390 |             case .edge:
 391 |                 await speakChunkWithEdge(chunk)
 392 |             }
 393 |             
 394 |             guard !Task.isCancelled else { break }
 395 |         }
 396 |         
 397 |         isPlaying = false
 398 |         isSynthesizing = false
 399 |     }
 400 |     
 401 |     // MARK: - System TTS
 402 |     
 403 |     private func speakChunkWithSystem(_ text: String) async {
 404 |         let utterance = AVSpeechUtterance(string: text)
 405 |         utterance.voice = AVSpeechSynthesisVoice(language: settings.systemVoice)
 406 |         utterance.rate = settings.systemRate
 407 |         
 408 |         await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in
 409 |             systemContinuation = continuation
 410 |             synthesizer.speak(utterance)
 411 |         }
 412 |     }
 413 |     
 414 |     private var systemContinuation: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>?
 415 |     
 416 |     // MARK: - Edge TTS
 417 |     
 418 |     private func speakChunkWithEdge(_ text: String) async {
 419 |         isSynthesizing = true
 420 |         
 421 |         do {
 422 |             let audioData = try await edgeClient.synthesize(
 423 |                 text: text,
 424 |                 voice: settings.edgeVoice,
 425 |                 rate: settings.edgeRate,
 426 |                 pitch: settings.edgePitch
 427 |             )
 428 |             
 429 |             isSynthesizing = false
 430 |             
 431 |             // 播放音频
 432 |             await playAudio(data: audioData)
 433 |             
 434 |         } catch {
 435 |             self.error = error.localizedDescription
 436 |             print("❌ EdgeTTS Error: \(error)")
 437 |             isSynthesizing = false
 438 |         }
 439 |     }
 440 |     
 441 |     /// 播放音频数据
 442 |     private func playAudio(data: Data) async {
 443 |         do {
 444 |             // 保存到临时文件（AVAudioPlayer 对带 header 的数据解析更可靠）
 445 |             let tempURL = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("edge_tts_\(UUID().uuidString).mp3")
 446 |             try data.write(to: tempURL)
 447 |             
 448 |             audioPlayer = try AVAudioPlayer(contentsOf: tempURL)
 449 |             audioPlayer?.delegate = self
 450 |             audioPlayer?.play()
 451 |             
 452 |             // 等待播放完成
 453 |             await withCheckedContinuation { (continuation: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>) in
 454 |                 audioContinuation = continuation
 455 |             }
 456 |             
 457 |             // 清理临时文件
 458 |             try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tempURL)
 459 |         } catch {
 460 |             print("❌ Audio playback error: \(error)")
 461 |         }
 462 |     }
 463 |     
 464 |     private var audioContinuation: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>?
 465 | }
 466 | 
 467 | // MARK: - AVSpeechSynthesizerDelegate
 468 | 
 469 | extension TTSService: AVSpeechSynthesizerDelegate {
 470 |     nonisolated func speechSynthesizer(_ synthesizer: AVSpeechSynthesizer, didFinish utterance: AVSpeechUtterance) {
 471 |         Task { @MainActor in
 472 |             systemContinuation?.resume()
 473 |             systemContinuation = nil
 474 |         }
 475 |     }
 476 |     
 477 |     nonisolated func speechSynthesizer(_ synthesizer: AVSpeechSynthesizer, didCancel utterance: AVSpeechUtterance) {
 478 |         Task { @MainActor in
 479 |             systemContinuation?.resume()
 480 |             systemContinuation = nil
 481 |             isPlaying = false
 482 |         }
 483 |     }
 484 | }
 485 | 
 486 | // MARK: - AVAudioPlayerDelegate
 487 | 
 488 | extension TTSService: AVAudioPlayerDelegate {
 489 |     nonisolated func audioPlayerDidFinishPlaying(_ player: AVAudioPlayer, successfully flag: Bool) {
 490 |         Task { @MainActor in
 491 |             audioContinuation?.resume()
 492 |             audioContinuation = nil
 493 |         }
 494 |     }
 495 | }
 496 | 
 497 | // MARK: - Legacy Alias (兼容旧代码)
 498 | 
 499 | typealias EdgeTTSService = TTSService

 109 |     private func createPanelIfNeeded() {

 111 |

 113 |         contentView.onComplete = { [weak self] in

 115 |         }
 116 |         contentView.onCancel = { [weak self] in
 117 |             self?.onCancel?()
 118 |         }
 119 |         contentView.onHoverChange = { _ in }
 120 |         
 121 |         // 固定宽度，内容从底部向上扩展
 122 |         let framedView = contentView
 123 |             .frame(width: Self.fixedWindowWidth, height: Self.fixedWindowHeight, alignment: .bottom)
 124 |         
 125 |         let hostingView = NSHostingView(rootView: framedView)
 126 |         
 127 |         // 固定窗口大小
 128 |         let frame = NSRect(
 129 |             origin: .zero,
 130 |             size: NSSize(width: Self.fixedWindowWidth, height: Self.fixedWindowHeight)
 131 |         )
 132 |         
 133 |         let newPanel = FloatingPanel(contentRect: frame)
 134 |         newPanel.contentView = hostingView
 135 |         
 136 |         self.panel = newPanel
 137 |     }
 138 |     
 139 |     private func scheduleHide(after delay: TimeInterval) {
 140 |         hideTimer?.invalidate()
 141 |         hideTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: delay, repeats: false) { [weak self] _ in
 142 |             Task { @MainActor in
 143 |                 self?.hide()
 144 |             }
 145 |         }
 146 |     }
 147 | }

 153 |     
 154 |     // MARK: - Auto Cleanup
 155 |     
 156 |     /// 清理策略
 157 |     enum CleanupPolicy {
 158 |         case keepDays(Int)      // 保留最近 N 天
 159 |         case keepCount(Int)     // 保留最近 N 条
 160 |         case keepSize(Int)      // 保留最大 N MB
 161 |     }
 162 |     
 163 |     /// 执行自动清理
 164 |     /// - Parameter policy: 清理策略
 165 |     func performCleanup(policy: CleanupPolicy) async {
 166 |         guard let context = modelContext else {
 167 |             logger.error("❌ ModelContext not configured for cleanup")
 168 |             return
 169 |         }
 170 |         
 171 |         let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<HistoryItem>(sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\.createdAt, order: .reverse)])
 172 |         
 173 |         do {
 174 |             let allItems = try context.fetch(descriptor)
 175 |             var itemsToDelete: [HistoryItem] = []
 176 |             
 177 |             switch policy {
 178 |             case .keepDays(let days):
 179 |                 let cutoffDate = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: -days, to: Date()) ?? Date()
 180 |                 itemsToDelete = allItems.filter { $0.createdAt < cutoffDate }
 181 |                 
 182 |             case .keepCount(let count):
 183 |                 if allItems.count > count {
 184 |                     itemsToDelete = Array(allItems.dropFirst(count))
 185 |                 }
 186 |                 
 187 |             case .keepSize(let megabytes):
 188 |                 let maxBytes = megabytes * 1024 * 1024
 189 |                 var totalSize = 0
 190 |                 
 191 |                 for item in allItems {
 192 |                     if let audioPath = item.audioPath {
 193 |                         let url = audioStorageURL.appendingPathComponent(audioPath)
 194 |                         if let attrs = try? FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath: url.path),
 195 |                            let size = attrs[.size] as? Int {
 196 |                             totalSize += size
 197 |                         }
 198 |                     }
 199 |                     
 200 |                     if totalSize > maxBytes {
 201 |                         itemsToDelete.append(item)
 202 |                     }
 203 |                 }
 204 |             }
 205 |             
 206 |             // 执行删除
 207 |             for item in itemsToDelete {
 208 |                 deleteItem(item)
 209 |             }
 210 |             
 211 |             if !itemsToDelete.isEmpty {
 212 |                 logger.info("🧹 Cleanup completed: \(itemsToDelete.count) items deleted")
 213 |             }
 214 |             
 215 |         } catch {
 216 |             logger.error("❌ Cleanup failed: \(error.localizedDescription)")
 217 |         }
 218 |     }
 219 |     
 220 |     /// 获取存储统计信息
 221 |     func getStorageStats() async -> (count: Int, totalSize: Int64) {
 222 |         guard let context = modelContext else { return (0, 0) }
 223 |         
 224 |         let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<HistoryItem>()
 225 |         
 226 |         do {
 227 |             let items = try context.fetch(descriptor)
 228 |             var totalSize: Int64 = 0
 229 |             
 230 |             for item in items {
 231 |                 if let audioPath = item.audioPath {
 232 |                     let url = audioStorageURL.appendingPathComponent(audioPath)
 233 |                     if let attrs = try? FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath: url.path),
 234 |                        let size = attrs[.size] as? Int64 {
 235 |                         totalSize += size
 236 |                     }
 237 |                 }
 238 |             }
 239 |             
 240 |             return (items.count, totalSize)
 241 |         } catch {
 242 |             return (0, 0)
 243 |         }
 244 |     }
 245 |     
 246 |     // MARK: - Private
 247 |     
 248 |     private func getAudioDuration(url: URL) async -> TimeInterval? {
 249 |         await Task.detached(priority: .utility) {
 250 |             let asset = AVURLAsset(url: url)
 251 |             do {
 252 |                 let duration = try await asset.load(.duration)
 253 |                 return duration.seconds.isNaN ? nil : duration.seconds
 254 |             } catch {
 255 |                 return nil
 256 |             }
 257 |         }.value
 258 |     }
 259 | }

 161 |             tap: .cgSessionEventTap,

 163 |             options: .defaultTap,

 167 |                 let service = Unmanaged<HotKeyService>.fromOpaque(refcon).takeUnretainedValue()
 168 |                 return service.handleEvent(proxy: proxy, type: type, event: event)
 169 |             },
 170 |             userInfo: Unmanaged.passUnretained(self).toOpaque()
 171 |         ) else {

 173 |             return

 331 |     /// 检查当前按下的修饰键是否匹配目标配置（严格匹配）
 332 |     private func checkModifiersMatch(flags: CGEventFlags, target: NSEvent.ModifierFlags) -> Bool {
 333 |         // 提取当前按下的所有修饰键
 334 |         var currentFlags: NSEvent.ModifierFlags = []
 335 |         
 336 |         if flags.contains(.maskAlternate) { currentFlags.insert(.option) }
 337 |         if flags.contains(.maskCommand) { currentFlags.insert(.command) }
 338 |         if flags.contains(.maskControl) { currentFlags.insert(.control) }
 339 |         if flags.contains(.maskShift) { currentFlags.insert(.shift) }
 340 |         
 341 |         // 提取目标修饰键（只关心主要的四个：opt, cmd, ctrl, shift）
 342 |         let targetFlags = target.intersection([.option, .command, .control, .shift])
 343 |         
 344 |         // 必须完全相等（不能多按，也不能少按）
 345 |         return currentFlags == targetFlags
 346 |     }

 386 |     /// flags 转字符串（调试用）
 387 |     private func flagsToString(_ flags: CGEventFlags) -> String {
 388 |         var parts: [String] = []
 389 |         if flags.contains(.maskCommand) { parts.append("⌘") }
 390 |         if flags.contains(.maskAlternate) { parts.append("⌥") }
 391 |         if flags.contains(.maskControl) { parts.append("⌃") }
 392 |         if flags.contains(.maskShift) { parts.append("⇧") }
 393 |         return parts.isEmpty ? "none" : parts.joined()

 396 |     // MARK: - Modifier Release Check (Multi-Display Fix)
 397 |     
 398 |     /// 延迟检查修饰键是否真的松开（修复多屏切换时的虚假事件）
 399 |     private func scheduleModifierReleaseCheck() {
 400 |         // 取消之前的检查（防抖）
 401 |         flagsDebounceWorkItem?.cancel()
 402 |         
 403 |         let workItem = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in
 404 |             guard let self = self else { return }
 405 |             
 406 |             // 100ms 后再次检查当前修饰键状态
 407 |             let currentFlags = NSEvent.modifierFlags
 408 |             let targetFlags = self.currentModifiers.intersection([.option, .command, .control, .shift])
 409 |             
 410 |             var actualFlags: NSEvent.ModifierFlags = []
 411 |             if currentFlags.contains(.option) { actualFlags.insert(.option) }
 412 |             if currentFlags.contains(.command) { actualFlags.insert(.command) }
 413 |             if currentFlags.contains(.control) { actualFlags.insert(.control) }
 414 |             if currentFlags.contains(.shift) { actualFlags.insert(.shift) }
 415 |             
 416 |             // 如果修饰键确实已松开，才停止录音
 417 |             if actualFlags != targetFlags {
 418 |                 self.logger.info("🔍 Modifier release confirmed after delay check")
 419 |                 self.handleRelease()
 420 |             } else {
 421 |                 self.logger.info("🔍 Modifier still held, ignoring false flagsChanged event (multi-display fix)")
 422 |             }
 423 |         }
 424 |         
 425 |         flagsDebounceWorkItem = workItem
 426 |         DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.1, execute: workItem)
 427 |     }

 540 |         // CGEvent 回调不在主线程，所有状态访问需要在主线程进行
 541 |         DispatchQueue.main.async { [weak self] in
 542 |             guard let self = self else { return }
 543 |             guard self.isRecording else { return }
 544 |             
 545 |             if self.isToggleSession {
 546 |                 // Toggle 模式下，松开键不停止录音
 547 |                 return
 548 |             }
 549 |             
 550 |             // 检查按压时长
 551 |             guard let startTime = self.recordingStartTime else { return }
 552 |             let duration = Date().timeIntervalSince(startTime)
 553 |             
 554 |             if duration < self.holdThreshold {
 555 |                 // 短按：切换到 Toggle 模式，继续录音
 556 |                 self.isToggleSession = true
 557 |                 self.logger.info("👆 Short press (\(String(format: "%.2f", duration))s) detected. Switched to Toggle mode.")
 558 |             } else {
 559 |                 // 长按：松手即停止
 560 |                 self.logger.info("✋ Long press (\(String(format: "%.2f", duration))s) released. Stopping.")
 561 |                 self.isRecording = false
 562 |                 self.isToggleSession = false
 563 |                 self.recordingStartTime = nil
 564 |                 self.onRecordingStop?()
 565 |             }
 566 |         }
 567 |     }
 568 |     
 569 |     
 570 |     /// 强制重置状态（用于异常恢复）
 571 |     func resetState() {
 572 |         isRecording = false
 573 |         isToggleSession = false
 574 |         recordingStartTime = nil
 575 |         logger.info("🔄 HotKey state reset")
 576 |     }
 577 | }

   1 | import Foundation

   6 | /// 键盘输入模拟服务
   7 | /// 用于实现"边说边打字"功能
   8 | @MainActor
   9 | final class InputService {
  10 |     
  11 |     static let shared = InputService()
  12 |     
  13 |     private let logger = Logger(subsystem: "com.spokeanywhere", category: "InputService")
  14 |     
  15 |     /// 上一次输入的文本（用于增量输入）
  16 |     private var lastTypedText: String = ""
  17 |     
  18 |     /// 上一次看到的文本（用于稳定性检测）
  19 |     private var lastSeenText: String = ""
  20 |     
  21 |     /// 待输入的文本（等待稳定）
  22 |     private var pendingText: String = ""
  23 |     
  24 |     /// 稳定性检测计时器
  25 |     private var stabilityTimer: Task<Void, Never>?
  26 |     
  27 |     /// 稳定延迟（毫秒）
  28 |     private let stabilityDelayMs: UInt64 = 500
  29 |     
  30 |     private init() {}
  31 |     
  32 |     // MARK: - Public API
  33 |     
  34 |     /// 重置状态（开始新的录音会话时调用）
  35 |     func reset() {
  36 |         lastTypedText = ""
  37 |         lastSeenText = ""
  38 |         pendingText = ""
  39 |         stabilityTimer?.cancel()
  40 |         stabilityTimer = nil
  41 |     }
  42 |     
  43 |     /// 输入文本（全量替换模式）
  44 |     /// - Parameter text: 要输入的完整文本
  45 |     func typeText(_ text: String) {
  46 |         guard !text.isEmpty else { return }
  47 |         
  48 |         // 使用 CGEvent 模拟键盘输入
  49 |         postUnicodeString(text)
  50 |         
  51 |         logger.debug("⌨️ Typed: \(text)")
  52 |     }
  53 |     
  54 |     /// 增量输入文本（只输入新增的部分）
  55 |     /// - Parameter fullText: 当前完整的文本
  56 |     /// - Returns: 实际输入的新增文本
  57 |     @discardableResult
  58 |     func typeIncremental(_ fullText: String) -> String {
  59 |         // 计算新增的部分
  60 |         let newText: String
  61 |         
  62 |         if fullText.hasPrefix(lastTypedText) {
  63 |             // 正常情况：新文本以旧文本为前缀，只输入差异部分
  64 |             newText = String(fullText.dropFirst(lastTypedText.count))
  65 |         } else {
  66 |             // 异常情况：文本发生了变化（可能是纠错）
  67 |             // 为了安全，我们不做任何操作
  68 |             // 因为回删用户已有的文本风险太大
  69 |             logger.warning("⚠️ Text changed unexpectedly, skipping: '\(self.lastTypedText)' -> '\(fullText)'")
  70 |             lastTypedText = fullText
  71 |             return ""
  72 |         }
  73 |         
  74 |         if !newText.isEmpty {
  75 |             postUnicodeString(newText)
  76 |             lastTypedText = fullText
  77 |             logger.debug("⌨️ Incremental: +\(newText)")
  78 |         }
  79 |         
  80 |         return newText
  81 |     }
  82 |     
  83 |     /// 延迟输入：等待文本稳定 500ms 后才输入
  84 |     /// - Parameters:
  85 |     ///   - finalizedText: 已确认的文本（引擎认为稳定的）
  86 |     ///   - volatileText: 预览文本（可能变化）
  87 |     func typeWithStabilityDetection(finalizedText: String, volatileText: String) {
  88 |         let fullText = finalizedText + volatileText
  89 |         
  90 |         // 如果文本没变化，不做任何事（等计时器触发）
  91 |         if fullText == lastSeenText {
  92 |             return
  93 |         }
  94 |         
  95 |         // 文本变化了，取消之前的计时器
  96 |         stabilityTimer?.cancel()
  97 |         
  98 |         // 更新待输入的文本
  99 |         pendingText = fullText
 100 |         lastSeenText = fullText
 101 |         
 102 |         // 启动新的延迟计时器
 103 |         stabilityTimer = Task { [weak self] in
 104 |             do {
 105 |                 // 等待 500ms
 106 |                 try await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: (self?.stabilityDelayMs ?? 500) * 1_000_000)
 107 |                 
 108 |                 // 检查是否被取消
 109 |                 if Task.isCancelled { return }
 110 |                 
 111 |                 // 500ms 过去了，文本稳定，可以输入
 112 |                 self?.flushPendingText()
 113 |                 
 114 |             } catch {
 115 |                 // Task 被取消，正常情况
 116 |             }
 117 |         }
 118 |     }
 119 |     
 120 |     /// 强制刷新待输入的文本（录音结束时调用）
 121 |     func flushPendingText() {
 122 |         guard !pendingText.isEmpty else { return }
 123 |         
 124 |         // 取消计时器
 125 |         stabilityTimer?.cancel()
 126 |         stabilityTimer = nil
 127 |         
 128 |         // 简单策略：只输入超出已输入长度的新内容
 129 |         // 这样可以避免重复输入，但可能在纠正时漏掉中间变化的部分
 130 |         // 权衡：宁可漏掉，不要重复
 131 |         
 132 |         if lastTypedText.isEmpty {
 133 |             // 第一次输入
 134 |             postUnicodeString(pendingText)
 135 |             logger.info("⌨️ First input: \(self.pendingText)")
 136 |         } else if pendingText.count > lastTypedText.count {
 137 |             // 有新增内容：只输入超出已输入长度的部分
 138 |             let newLength = pendingText.count - lastTypedText.count
 139 |             let newContent = String(pendingText.suffix(newLength))
 140 |             
 141 |             if !newContent.isEmpty {
 142 |                 postUnicodeString(newContent)
 143 |                 logger.info("⌨️ Delayed input: +\(newContent)")
 144 |             }
 145 |         } else {
 146 |             // 文本变短或长度相同但内容变了（纠正）
 147 |             // 不输入任何内容，避免重复
 148 |             logger.debug("⌨️ Text corrected/shortened, skipping to avoid duplicates")
 149 |         }
 150 |         
 151 |         lastTypedText = pendingText
 152 |         pendingText = ""
 153 |     }
 154 |     
 155 |     /// 找到两个字符串的公共前缀长度
 156 |     private func findCommonPrefixLength(_ a: String, _ b: String) -> Int {
 157 |         let aChars = Array(a)
 158 |         let bChars = Array(b)
 159 |         let minLen = min(aChars.count, bChars.count)
 160 |         
 161 |         for i in 0..<minLen {
 162 |             if aChars[i] != bChars[i] {
 163 |                 return i
 164 |             }
 165 |         }
 166 |         return minLen
 167 |     }
 168 |     
 169 |     /// 检查辅助功能权限
 170 |     static func checkAccessibilityPermission() -> Bool {
 171 |         // 检查是否有辅助功能权限（CGEvent 需要）
 172 |         let trusted = AXIsProcessTrusted()
 173 |         return trusted
 174 |     }
 175 |     
 176 |     /// 请求辅助功能权限
 177 |     static func requestAccessibilityPermission() {
 178 |         let options = [kAXTrustedCheckOptionPrompt.takeUnretainedValue() as String: true] as CFDictionary
 179 |         AXIsProcessTrustedWithOptions(options)
 180 |     }
 181 |     
 182 |     // MARK: - Private
 183 |     
 184 |     /// 使用 CGEvent 发送 Unicode 字符串
 185 |     private func postUnicodeString(_ string: String) {
 186 |         guard !string.isEmpty else { return }
 187 |         
 188 |         let source = CGEventSource(stateID: .hidSystemState)
 189 |         
 190 |         // 将字符串转换为 UTF-16 数组
 191 |         var chars = Array(string.utf16)
 192 |         
 193 |         // 创建 Key Down 事件
 194 |         guard let keyDown = CGEvent(keyboardEventSource: source, virtualKey: 0, keyDown: true) else {
 195 |             logger.error("❌ Failed to create key down event")
 196 |             return
 197 |         }
 198 |         
 199 |         // 设置 Unicode 字符串
 200 |         keyDown.keyboardSetUnicodeString(stringLength: chars.count, unicodeString: &chars)
 201 |         
 202 |         // 发送事件
 203 |         keyDown.post(tap: .cghidEventTap)
 204 |         
 205 |         // 创建 Key Up 事件
 206 |         if let keyUp = CGEvent(keyboardEventSource: source, virtualKey: 0, keyDown: false) {
 207 |             keyUp.post(tap: .cghidEventTap)
 208 |         }
 209 |     }
 210 |     
 211 |     /// 模拟按下退格键（危险操作，暂不使用）
 212 |     /// - Parameter count: 退格次数
 213 |     private func postBackspace(count: Int) {
 214 |         guard count > 0 else { return }
 215 |         
 216 |         let source = CGEventSource(stateID: .hidSystemState)
 217 |         let backspaceKeyCode: CGKeyCode = 51  // kVK_Delete
 218 |         
 219 |         for _ in 0..<count {
 220 |             if let keyDown = CGEvent(keyboardEventSource: source, virtualKey: backspaceKeyCode, keyDown: true) {
 221 |                 keyDown.post(tap: .cghidEventTap)
 222 |             }
 223 |             if let keyUp = CGEvent(keyboardEventSource: source, virtualKey: backspaceKeyCode, keyDown: false) {
 224 |                 keyUp.post(tap: .cghidEventTap)
 225 |             }
 226 |             
 227 |             // 小延迟避免按键丢失
 228 |             usleep(1000)  // 1ms
 229 |         }
 230 |     }
 231 | }

  44 |

  49 |         // 动画结束后隐藏窗口
  50 |         DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.4) { [weak self] in
  51 |             self?.panel?.orderOut(nil)
  52 |         }
  53 |         
  54 |         logger.info("📋 Message Panel hidden")
  55 |     }
  56 |     
  57 |     /// 切换显示/隐藏

  88 |     private func createPanelIfNeeded() {
  89 |         guard panel == nil else { return }
  90 |         
  91 |         let contentView = MessagePanelView(state: state)
  92 |         let hostingView = NSHostingView(rootView: contentView)
  93 |         
  94 |         // 获取屏幕尺寸
  95 |         let screen = screenWithMouse() ?? NSScreen.main ?? NSScreen.screens.first!
  96 |         let screenFrame = screen.visibleFrame
  97 |         
  98 |         // 面板高度占满屏幕
  99 |         let panelHeight = screenFrame.height
 100 |         let panelWidth = MessagePanelState.panelWidth + 40  // 额外空间用于阴影
 101 |         
 102 |         let frame = NSRect(
 103 |             origin: .zero,
 104 |             size: NSSize(width: panelWidth, height: panelHeight)
 105 |         )
 106 |         
 107 |         let newPanel = MessagePanelWindow(contentRect: frame)

 110 |         self.panel = newPanel

 114 |     /// 定位面板到屏幕左侧
 115 |     private func positionPanel() {
 116 |         guard let panel = panel else { return }
 117 |         
 118 |         // 获取鼠标所在屏幕
 119 |         let screen = screenWithMouse() ?? NSScreen.main ?? NSScreen.screens.first!
 120 |         let screenFrame = screen.visibleFrame
 121 |         
 122 |         // 更新面板高度以适应屏幕
 123 |         let panelWidth = panel.frame.width
 124 |         let panelHeight = screenFrame.height
 125 |         
 126 |         // 左边缘，垂直居中
 127 |         let x = screenFrame.minX
 128 |         let y = screenFrame.minY
 129 |         
 130 |         panel.setFrame(NSRect(x: x, y: y, width: panelWidth, height: panelHeight), display: true)
 131 |     }
 132 |     
 133 |     /// 获取鼠标所在屏幕
 134 |     private func screenWithMouse() -> NSScreen? {
 135 |         let mouseLocation = NSEvent.mouseLocation
 136 |         return NSScreen.screens.first { screen in
 137 |             NSMouseInRect(mouseLocation, screen.frame, false)
 138 |         }
 139 |     }
 140 | }

 216 |     /// 构建发送给 LLM 的 prompt
 217 |     private func buildPrompt() -> String {
 218 |         var parts: [String] = []
 219 |         
 220 |         // 用户输入
 221 |         let userInput = state.userInput.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
 222 |         if !userInput.isEmpty {
 223 |             parts.append("## 用户输入\n\(userInput)")
 224 |         }
 225 |         
 226 |         // 语音转写
 227 |         let voiceText = state.voiceTranscription.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
 228 |         if !voiceText.isEmpty {
 229 |             parts.append("## 语音转写\n\(voiceText)")
 230 |             
 231 |             // 如果同时有用户输入和语音，添加提示
 232 |             if !userInput.isEmpty {
 233 |                 parts.append("> 注意：语音转写可能存在偏差（如专业术语、人名等），请结合用户输入理解真实意图。")
 234 |             }
 235 |         }
 236 |         
 237 |         // 附件说明
 238 |         if !state.attachments.isEmpty {
 239 |             var attachmentParts: [String] = []
 240 |             var textBundleContents: [String] = []
 241 |             
 242 |             for attachment in state.attachments {
 243 |                 switch attachment {
 244 |                 case .image:
 245 |                     attachmentParts.append("[图片]")
 246 |                 case .screenshot:
 247 |                     attachmentParts.append("[截图]")
 248 |                 case .file(let url, _):
 249 |                     attachmentParts.append("[文件: \(url.lastPathComponent)]")
 250 |                 case .textBundle(let content, let source, let count, _):
 251 |                     attachmentParts.append("[代码包: \(source) (\(count) 文件)]")
 252 |                     textBundleContents.append("### \(source)\n\(content)")
 253 |                 }
 254 |             }
 255 |             
 256 |             parts.append("## 附件\n\(attachmentParts.joined(separator: ", "))")
 257 |             
 258 |             // 添加文本包内容
 259 |             if !textBundleContents.isEmpty {
 260 |                 parts.append("## 代码/文档内容\n\(textBundleContents.joined(separator: "\n\n---\n\n"))")
 261 |             }
 262 |         }
 263 |         
 264 |         return parts.joined(separator: "\n\n")
 265 |     }
 266 | }

 315 |     // MARK: - Public API
 316 |     
 317 |     func show(targetApp: TargetAppInfo?) {
 318 |         print("📱 QuickAskService.show() called")
 319 |         createPanelIfNeeded()
 320 |         
 321 |         // 🔥 第一步：禁用 event tap，避免干扰输入法（必须在窗口激活前执行）
 322 |         HotKeyService.shared.setQuickAskActive(true)
 323 |         
 324 |         // 启用按键调试日志
 325 |         HotKeyService.shared.debugKeyEvents = true
 326 |         
 327 |         // 🔥 第二步：切换到普通应用模式以支持输入法
 328 |         NSApp.setActivationPolicy(.regular)
 329 |         print("📱 Activation policy set to .regular")
 330 |         
 331 |         state.startSession(targetApp: targetApp)
 332 |         
 333 |         panel?.positionAtBottomCenter()
 334 |         
 335 |         // 🔥 第三步：先显示窗口
 336 |         panel?.orderFront(nil)
 337 |         
 338 |         // 🔥 第四步：延迟一帧再激活（等待窗口完全显示）
 339 |         DispatchQueue.main.async { [weak self] in
 340 |             guard let panel = self?.panel else { return }
 341 |             
 342 |             // 激活应用（强制激活，忽略其他应用）
 343 |             NSApp.activate(ignoringOtherApps: true)
 344 |             
 345 |             // 让窗口成为 key window 和 main window
 346 |             panel.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
 347 |             panel.makeMain()
 348 |             
 349 |             print("📱 QuickAskService.show() activated, isKeyWindow: \(panel.isKeyWindow), isMainWindow: \(panel.isMainWindow)")
 350 |         }
 351 |     }
 352 |     
 353 |     func hide() {
 354 |         // 关闭按键调试日志
 355 |         HotKeyService.shared.debugKeyEvents = false
 356 |         
 357 |         // 🔥 重新启用 event tap
 358 |         HotKeyService.shared.setQuickAskActive(false)
 359 |         
 360 |         NSAnimationContext.runAnimationGroup { context in
 361 |             context.duration = 0.3
 362 |             panel?.animator().alphaValue = 0
 363 |         } completionHandler: { [weak self] in
 364 |             Task { @MainActor in
 365 |                 self?.panel?.orderOut(nil)
 366 |                 self?.panel?.alphaValue = 1
 367 |                 // 恢复为辅助应用模式
 368 |                 NSApp.setActivationPolicy(.accessory)
 369 |             }
 370 |         }
 371 |     }
 372 |     
 373 |     func fail(with message: String) {
 374 |         state.fail(with: message)
 375 |         DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 2.0) { [weak self] in
 376 |             self?.hide()
 377 |             self?.state.reset()
 378 |         }
 379 |     }
 380 |     
 381 |     // MARK: - Private
 382 |     
 383 |     private func createPanelIfNeeded() {
 384 |         guard panel == nil else { return }
 385 |         
 386 |         var contentView = QuickAskCapsuleView(state: state)
 387 |         contentView.onSend = { [weak self] in
 388 |             self?.onSend?()
 389 |         }
 390 |         contentView.onCancel = { [weak self] in
 391 |             self?.onCancel?()
 392 |         }
 393 |         
 394 |         let framedView = contentView
 395 |             .frame(width: Self.fixedWindowWidth, height: Self.fixedWindowHeight, alignment: .bottom)
 396 |         
 397 |         let hostingView = NSHostingView(rootView: framedView)
 398 |         
 399 |         let frame = NSRect(
 400 |             origin: .zero,
 401 |             size: NSSize(width: Self.fixedWindowWidth, height: Self.fixedWindowHeight)
 402 |         )
 403 |         
 404 |         let newPanel = QuickAskPanel(contentRect: frame)
 405 |         newPanel.contentView = hostingView
 406 |         
 407 |         self.panel = newPanel
 408 |     }
 409 | }

 282 |     // MARK: - Processing
 283 |     
 284 |     private func processTranscription() {
 285 |         Task {
 286 |             // 等待最终结果（最多等待 2 秒，每 100ms 检查一次）
 287 |             var waitTime = 0
 288 |             while waitTime < Self.maxWaitForFinalResult {
 289 |                 try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(Self.checkInterval))
 290 |                 waitTime += Self.checkInterval
 291 |                 // 如果处理已完成，提前退出
 292 |                 if !audioService.isProcessing { break }
 293 |             }
 294 |             
 295 |             let transcribedText = lastTranscription
 296 |             
 297 |             if transcribedText.isEmpty {
 298 |                 hudManager.fail(with: "未检测到语音")
 299 |                 hotKeyService.resetState()
 300 |                 return
 301 |             }
 302 |             
 303 |             // 第一次写入剪贴板（原始转写文本）
 304 |             copyToClipboard(transcribedText)
 305 |             logger.info("📋 Clipboard #1: transcribed text")
 306 |             
 307 |             // 发送 ASR 结果到 Message Panel
 308 |             MessagePanelManager.shared.addASRResult(
 309 |                 model: "Apple Speech",
 310 |                 content: transcribedText
 311 |             )
 312 |             
 313 |             // 获取临时音频文件 URL
 314 |             let tempAudioURL = audioService.tempAudioFileURL
 315 |             let appBundleId = contextService.getCurrentTargetApp()?.bundleIdentifier
 316 |             
 317 |             // 检查是否需要 LLM 处理
 318 |             guard llmPipeline.shouldProcess else {
 319 |                 // 不需要 LLM，直接完成
 320 |                 hudManager.complete(with: transcribedText)
 321 |                 
 322 |                 // 保存到历史记录
 323 |                 await historyManager.saveRecording(
 324 |                     rawText: transcribedText,
 325 |                     processedText: nil,
 326 |                     tempAudioURL: tempAudioURL,
 327 |                     appBundleId: appBundleId
 328 |                 )
 329 |                 
 330 |                 hotKeyService.resetState()
 331 |                 logger.info("✅ Transcription complete (no LLM): \(transcribedText)")
 332 |                 return
 333 |             }
 334 |             
 335 |             // 已经在 thinking 状态了（stopRecordingSession 时已切换）
 336 |             // 调用 LLM 精炼
 337 |             let result = await llmPipeline.refine(transcribedText)
 338 |             
 339 |             var processedText: String?
 340 |             
 341 |             switch result {
 342 |             case .success(let refinedText):
 343 |                 // 第二次写入剪贴板（精炼后文本）
 344 |                 copyToClipboard(refinedText)
 345 |                 logger.info("📋 Clipboard #2: refined text")
 346 |                 
 347 |                 // 发送 LLM 结果到 Message Panel
 348 |                 MessagePanelManager.shared.addLLMResult(
 349 |                     model: llmPipeline.currentProviderName,
 350 |                     content: refinedText
 351 |                 )
 352 |                 
 353 |                 // 完成
 354 |                 hudManager.complete(with: refinedText)
 355 |                 processedText = refinedText
 356 |                 logger.info("✅ LLM refinement complete: \(refinedText)")
 357 |                 
 358 |             case .failure(let error):
 359 |                 // LLM 失败，保留原始文本
 360 |                 logger.error("❌ LLM failed: \(error.localizedDescription)")
 361 |                 hudManager.complete(with: transcribedText)
 362 |                 logger.info("⚠️ Fallback to transcribed text")
 363 |             }
 364 |             
 365 |             // 保存到历史记录（替代临时文件清理）
 366 |             await historyManager.saveRecording(
 367 |                 rawText: transcribedText,
 368 |                 processedText: processedText,
 369 |                 tempAudioURL: tempAudioURL,
 370 |                 appBundleId: appBundleId
 371 |             )
 372 |             
 373 |             // 确保热键状态已重置（防止异常情况）
 374 |             hotKeyService.resetState()
 375 |         }
 376 |     }
 377 |     
 378 |     private func copyToClipboard(_ text: String) {
 379 |         NSPasteboard.general.clearContents()
 380 |         NSPasteboard.general.setString(text, forType: .string)
 381 |     }
 382 | }

 174 | // MARK: - Attachment Type (简化版，用于测试)
 175 | 
 176 | import UniformTypeIdentifiers
 177 | 
 178 | enum Attachment: Identifiable, Equatable {
 179 |     case image(NSImage, NSImage?, UUID)
 180 |     case screenshot(NSImage, NSImage?, UUID)
 181 |     case file(URL, UUID)
 182 |     case textBundle(String, String, Int, UUID)
 183 |     
 184 |     var id: UUID {
 185 |         switch self {
 186 |         case .image(_, _, let id), .screenshot(_, _, let id),
 187 |              .file(_, let id), .textBundle(_, _, _, let id):
 188 |             return id
 189 |         }
 190 |     }
 191 |     
 192 |     var thumbnail: NSImage? {
 193 |         switch self {
 194 |         case .image(_, let thumb, _), .screenshot(_, let thumb, _): return thumb
 195 |         default: return nil
 196 |         }
 197 |     }
 198 |     
 199 |     var originalImage: NSImage? {
 200 |         switch self {
 201 |         case .image(let img, _, _), .screenshot(let img, _, _): return img
 202 |         default: return nil
 203 |         }
 204 |     }
 205 |     
 206 |     var fileName: String? {
 207 |         switch self {
 208 |         case .file(let url, _): return url.lastPathComponent
 209 |         case .textBundle(_, let source, _, _): return source
 210 |         default: return nil
 211 |         }
 212 |     }
 213 |     
 214 |     var displayTitle: String {
 215 |         switch self {
 216 |         case .image: return "图片"
 217 |         case .screenshot: return "截图"
 218 |         case .file(let url, _): return url.lastPathComponent
 219 |         case .textBundle(_, let source, let count, _): return "\(source) (\(count) 文件)"
 220 |         }
 221 |     }
 222 |     
 223 |     var isVideo: Bool {
 224 |         if case .file(let url, _) = self,
 225 |            let uti = UTType(filenameExtension: url.pathExtension) {
 226 |             return uti.conforms(to: .movie) || uti.conforms(to: .video)
 227 |         }
 228 |         return false
 229 |     }
 230 |     
 231 |     var isTextBundle: Bool {
 232 |         if case .textBundle = self { return true }
 233 |         return false
 234 |     }
 235 |     
 236 |     var textContent: String? {
 237 |         if case .textBundle(let content, _, _, _) = self { return content }
 238 |         return nil
 239 |     }
 240 |     
 241 |     static func == (lhs: Attachment, rhs: Attachment) -> Bool { lhs.id == rhs.id }
 242 |     
 243 |     static func makeThumbnail(from image: NSImage, maxSize: CGFloat = 256) -> NSImage {
 244 |         let size = image.size
 245 |         guard size.width > 0 && size.height > 0 else { return image }
 246 |         
 247 |         let scale = min(maxSize / size.width, maxSize / size.height, 1.0)
 248 |         let newSize = NSSize(width: size.width * scale, height: size.height * scale)
 249 |         
 250 |         let thumbnail = NSImage(size: newSize)
 251 |         thumbnail.lockFocus()
 252 |         image.draw(in: NSRect(origin: .zero, size: newSize),
 253 |                    from: NSRect(origin: .zero, size: size),
 254 |                    operation: .copy, fraction: 1.0)
 255 |         thumbnail.unlockFocus()
 256 |         return thumbnail
 257 |     }
 258 | }

 260 | // MARK: - Assertion Helpers
 261 | 
 262 | struct TestError: Error, CustomStringConvertible {
 263 |     let message: String
 264 |     init(_ message: String) { self.message = message }
 265 |     var description: String { message }
 266 | }
 267 | 
 268 | func assertEqual<T: Equatable>(_ actual: T, _ expected: T, _ name: String) throws {
 269 |     if actual != expected {
 270 |         throw TestError("\(name): 期望 \(expected), 实际 \(actual)")
 271 |     }
 272 | }
 273 | 
 274 | func assertTrue(_ condition: Bool, _ message: String) throws {
 275 |     if !condition { throw TestError(message) }
 276 | }
 277 | 
 278 | func assertFalse(_ condition: Bool, _ message: String) throws {
 279 |     if condition { throw TestError(message) }
 280 | }
 281 | 
 282 | func assertNil<T>(_ value: T?, _ message: String) throws {
 283 |     if value != nil { throw TestError("\(message) 应该是 nil") }
 284 | }
 285 | 
 286 | func assertNotNil<T>(_ value: T?, _ message: String) throws {
 287 |     if value == nil { throw TestError("\(message) 不应该是 nil") }
 288 | }
 289 | 
 290 | extension String {
 291 |     static func * (string: String, count: Int) -> String {
 292 |         String(repeating: string, count: count)
 293 |     }
 294 | }

  15 |     /// 测试合成并播放
  16 |     static func testSynthesizeAndPlay() async {
  17 |         print("\n📝 测试: 合成并播放")
  18 |         
  19 |         let text = "你好，这是语音合成测试。"
  20 |         let voice = "zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural"
  21 |         
  22 |         do {
  23 |             // 1. 合成音频
  24 |             print("   正在合成...")
  25 |             let audioData = try await synthesize(text: text, voice: voice)
  26 |             print("   ✅ 合成完成: \(audioData.count) bytes")
  27 |             
  28 |             // 2. 检查音频头
  29 |             print("   音频头部: \(audioData.prefix(16).map { String(format: "%02X", $0) }.joined(separator: " "))")
  30 |             
  31 |             // 3. 保存到文件测试
  32 |             let tempPath = "/tmp/edge_tts_test.mp3"
  33 |             try audioData.write(to: URL(fileURLWithPath: tempPath))
  34 |             print("   ✅ 已保存到: \(tempPath)")
  35 |             
  36 |             // 4. 用 AVAudioPlayer 播放
  37 |             print("   正在播放...")
  38 |             let player = try AVAudioPlayer(contentsOf: URL(fileURLWithPath: tempPath))
  39 |             player.prepareToPlay()
  40 |             player.play()
  41 |             
  42 |             // 等待播放完成
  43 |             while player.isPlaying {
  44 |                 try await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 100_000_000)
  45 |             }
  46 |             print("   ✅ 播放完成!")
  47 |             
  48 |         } catch {
  49 |             print("   ❌ 错误: \(error)")
  50 |         }
  51 |     }
  52 |     
  53 |     /// 合成音频
  54 |     static func synthesize(text: String, voice: String) async throws -> Data {
  55 |         // DRM Token
  56 |         let trustedClientToken = "6A5AA1D4EAFF4E9FB37E23D68491D6F4"
  57 |         let chromiumVersion = "130.0.2849.68"
  58 |         let windowsFileTimeEpoch: Int64 = 11_644_473_600
  59 |         
  60 |         let currentTime = Int64(Date().timeIntervalSince1970)
  61 |         let ticks = (currentTime + windowsFileTimeEpoch) * 10_000_000
  62 |         let roundedTicks = ticks - (ticks % 3_000_000_000)
  63 |         let strToHash = "\(roundedTicks)\(trustedClientToken)"
  64 |         
  65 |         // SHA256
  66 |         import CryptoKit
  67 |         let hash = SHA256.hash(data: strToHash.data(using: .ascii)!)
  68 |         let secMsGec = hash.map { String(format: "%02X", $0) }.joined()
  69 |         
  70 |         // URL
  71 |         let urlString = "wss://speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/speech/synthesize/readaloud/edge/v1?TrustedClientToken=\(trustedClientToken)&Sec-MS-GEC=\(secMsGec)&Sec-MS-GEC-Version=1-\(chromiumVersion)"
  72 |         let url = URL(string: urlString)!
  73 |         
  74 |         // WebSocket
  75 |         var request = URLRequest(url: url)
  76 |         request.setValue("chrome-extension://jdiccldimpdaibmpdkjnbmckianbfold", forHTTPHeaderField: "Origin")
  77 |         request.setValue("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/\(chromiumVersion) Edg/\(chromiumVersion)", forHTTPHeaderField: "User-Agent")
  78 |         
  79 |         let session = URLSession.shared
  80 |         let ws = session.webSocketTask(with: request)
  81 |         ws.resume()
  82 |         
  83 |         // 等待连接
  84 |         try await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 500_000_000)
  85 |         
  86 |         // 发送配置
  87 |         let configMessage = "Content-Type:application/json; charset=utf-8\r\nPath:speech.config\r\n\r\n{\"context\":{\"synthesis\":{\"audio\":{\"metadataoptions\":{\"sentenceBoundaryEnabled\":\"false\",\"wordBoundaryEnabled\":\"false\"},\"outputFormat\":\"audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3\"}}}}"
  88 |         try await ws.send(.string(configMessage))
  89 |         
  90 |         // 发送 SSML
  91 |         let ssml = "<speak version=\"1.0\" xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis\" xml:lang=\"zh-CN\"><voice name=\"\(voice)\"><prosody rate=\"+0%\" pitch=\"+0Hz\">\(text)</prosody></voice></speak>"
  92 |         let ssmlMessage = "X-RequestId:\(UUID().uuidString)\r\nContent-Type:application/ssml+xml\r\nPath:ssml\r\n\r\n\(ssml)"
  93 |         try await ws.send(.string(ssmlMessage))
  94 |         
  95 |         // 接收音频
  96 |         var audioData = Data()
  97 |         
  98 |         while true {
  99 |             let message = try await ws.receive()
 100 |             
 101 |             switch message {
 102 |             case .data(let data):
 103 |                 // 检查是否包含 Path:audio
 104 |                 if let str = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8), str.contains("Path:audio\r\n") {
 105 |                     if let range = str.range(of: "Path:audio\r\n") {
 106 |                         let offset = range.upperBound.utf16Offset(in: str)
 107 |                         audioData.append(data[offset...])
 108 |                     }
 109 |                 } else {
 110 |                     audioData.append(data)
 111 |                 }
 112 |                 
 113 |             case .string(let str):
 114 |                 if str.contains("Path:turn.end") {
 115 |                     ws.cancel(with: .goingAway, reason: nil)
 116 |                     return audioData
 117 |                 }
 118 |                 
 119 |             @unknown default:
 120 |                 break
 121 |             }
 122 |         }
 123 |     }
 124 | }

 301 | // MARK: - TextExtractionService (简化版，用于测试)
 302 | 
 303 | struct TextBundle {
 304 |     let content: String
 305 |     let fileCount: Int
 306 |     let sourcePath: String
 307 |     let files: [String]
 308 | }
 309 | 
 310 | enum TextExtractionError: Error, Equatable {
 311 |     case folderNotFound
 312 |     case zipExtractionFailed(String)
 313 |     case noTextFilesFound
 314 |     case accessDenied
 315 | }
 316 | 
 317 | func extractFromFolder(_ folderURL: URL) async -> Result<TextBundle, TextExtractionError> {
 318 |     let codeExtensions: Set<String> = [
 319 |         "js", "jsx", "ts", "tsx", "mjs", "cjs",
 320 |         "html", "htm", "css", "scss", "less", "vue", "svelte",
 321 |         "py", "pyw", "pyi",
 322 |         "java", "kt", "kts", "scala",
 323 |         "c", "cpp", "cc", "cxx", "h", "hpp", "hxx",
 324 |         "rs", "go", "rb", "erb", "php", "swift",
 325 |         "sh", "bash", "zsh", "fish",
 326 |         "json", "yaml", "yml", "toml", "xml", "ini", "cfg", "conf",
 327 |         "md", "mdx", "txt", "rst", "asciidoc",
 328 |         "sql", "graphql", "proto", "dockerfile"
 329 |     ]
 330 |     
 331 |     let excludedDirs: Set<String> = [
 332 |         "node_modules", ".git", ".svn", ".hg",
 333 |         "dist", "build", "target", ".next", ".nuxt",
 334 |         "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", ".tox",
 335 |         "venv", "env", ".env", ".venv",
 336 |         "vendor", "Pods", "Carthage",
 337 |         ".idea", ".vscode", ".vs"
 338 |     ]
 339 |     
 340 |     let excludedFiles: Set<String> = [
 341 |         ".DS_Store", "Thumbs.db", ".gitignore", ".gitattributes",
 342 |         "package-lock.json", "yarn.lock", "pnpm-lock.yaml",
 343 |         "Podfile.lock", "Gemfile.lock", "Cargo.lock"
 344 |     ]
 345 |     
 346 |     // 递归收集文件
 347 |     func collectFiles(in directory: URL) -> [URL] {
 348 |         var result: [URL] = []
 349 |         let fm = FileManager.default
 350 |         
 351 |         guard let contents = try? fm.contentsOfDirectory(
 352 |             at: directory,
 353 |             includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isRegularFileKey, .isDirectoryKey],
 354 |             options: [.skipsHiddenFiles]
 355 |         ) else { return [] }
 356 |         
 357 |         for url in contents {
 358 |             let fileName = url.lastPathComponent
 359 |             if excludedFiles.contains(fileName) { continue }
 360 |             
 361 |             let values = try? url.resourceValues(forKeys: [.isRegularFileKey, .isDirectoryKey])
 362 |             
 363 |             if values?.isDirectory == true {
 364 |                 if !excludedDirs.contains(fileName) {
 365 |                     result.append(contentsOf: collectFiles(in: url))
 366 |                 }
 367 |             } else if values?.isRegularFile == true {
 368 |                 let ext = url.pathExtension.lowercased()
 369 |                 if codeExtensions.contains(ext) {
 370 |                     result.append(url)
 371 |                 }
 372 |             }
 373 |         }
 374 |         return result.sorted { $0.path < $1.path }
 375 |     }
 376 |     
 377 |     let files = collectFiles(in: folderURL)
 378 |     guard !files.isEmpty else {
 379 |         return .failure(.noTextFilesFound)
 380 |     }
 381 |     
 382 |     // 合并内容
 383 |     var parts: [String] = ["# 目录结构\n```"]
 384 |     for file in files {
 385 |         let rel = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: folderURL.path + "/", with: "")
 386 |         parts.append(rel)
 387 |     }
 388 |     parts.append("```\n\n# 文件内容\n")
 389 |     
 390 |     for file in files {
 391 |         let rel = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: folderURL.path + "/", with: "")
 392 |         let ext = file.pathExtension
 393 |         if let content = try? String(contentsOf: file, encoding: .utf8) {
 394 |             let numbered = content.components(separatedBy: .newlines).enumerated()
 395 |                 .map { "\($0.offset + 1)│ \($0.element)" }.joined(separator: "\n")
 396 |             parts.append("## \(rel)\n```\(ext)\n\(numbered)\n```\n")
 397 |         }
 398 |     }
 399 |     
 400 |     return .success(TextBundle(
 401 |         content: parts.joined(separator: "\n"),
 402 |         fileCount: files.count,
 403 |         sourcePath: folderURL.path,
 404 |         files: files.map { $0.path }
 405 |     ))
 406 | }
 407 | 
 408 | func extractFromZIP(_ zipURL: URL) async -> Result<TextBundle, TextExtractionError> {
 409 |     let tempDir = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("zip-\(UUID().uuidString)")
 410 |     try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: tempDir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
 411 |     defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tempDir) }
 412 |     
 413 |     let process = Process()
 414 |     process.executableURL = URL(fileURLWithPath: "/usr/bin/unzip")
 415 |     process.arguments = ["-q", "-o", zipURL.path, "-d", tempDir.path]
 416 |     process.standardOutput = FileHandle.nullDevice
 417 |     process.standardError = FileHandle.nullDevice
 418 |     
 419 |     do {
 420 |         try process.run()
 421 |         process.waitUntilExit()
 422 |         
 423 |         guard process.terminationStatus == 0 else {
 424 |             return .failure(.zipExtractionFailed("Exit code: \(process.terminationStatus)"))
 425 |         }
 426 |         
 427 |         return await extractFromFolder(tempDir)
 428 |     } catch {
 429 |         return .failure(.zipExtractionFailed(error.localizedDescription))
 430 |     }
 431 | }
 432 | 
 433 | // MARK: - Helpers
 434 | 
 435 | struct TestError: Error, CustomStringConvertible {
 436 |     let message: String
 437 |     init(_ message: String) { self.message = message }
 438 |     var description: String { message }
 439 | }
 440 | 
 441 | extension String {
 442 |     static func * (string: String, count: Int) -> String {
 443 |         String(repeating: string, count: count)
 444 |     }
 445 | }

   6 | 
   7 | // MARK: - Edge TTS 测试脚本

   9 | print("🧪 Edge TTS 测试")
  10 | print(String(repeating: "=", count: 50))
  11 | 
  12 | // 配置
  13 | let text = "你好，这是语音合成测试。Hello, this is a test."
  14 | let voice = "zh-CN-XiaoxiaoNeural"
  15 | let trustedClientToken = "6A5AA1D4EAFF4E9FB37E23D68491D6F4"
  16 | let chromiumVersion = "130.0.2849.68"
  17 | let windowsFileTimeEpoch: Int64 = 11_644_473_600
  18 | 
  19 | // 生成 DRM Token
  20 | func generateSecMsGecToken() -> String {
  21 |     let currentTime = Int64(Date().timeIntervalSince1970)
  22 |     let ticks = (currentTime + windowsFileTimeEpoch) * 10_000_000
  23 |     let roundedTicks = ticks - (ticks % 3_000_000_000)
  24 |     let strToHash = "\(roundedTicks)\(trustedClientToken)"
  25 |     let hash = SHA256.hash(data: strToHash.data(using: .ascii)!)
  26 |     return hash.map { String(format: "%02X", $0) }.joined()
  27 | }
  28 | 
  29 | // WebSocket Delegate
  30 | class WSDelegate: NSObject, URLSessionWebSocketDelegate {
  31 |     var onOpen: (() -> Void)?
  32 |     
  33 |     func urlSession(_ session: URLSession, webSocketTask: URLSessionWebSocketTask, didOpenWithProtocol protocol: String?) {
  34 |         print("   ✅ WebSocket 已连接")
  35 |         onOpen?()
  36 |     }
  37 | }
  38 | 
  39 | // 主测试
  40 | func runTest() async {
  41 |     print("\n📝 测试文本: \(text)")
  42 |     print("🎤 语音: \(voice)")
  43 |     
  44 |     // 构建 URL
  45 |     let secMsGec = generateSecMsGecToken()
  46 |     let urlString = "wss://speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/speech/synthesize/readaloud/edge/v1?TrustedClientToken=\(trustedClientToken)&Sec-MS-GEC=\(secMsGec)&Sec-MS-GEC-Version=1-\(chromiumVersion)"
  47 |     
  48 |     guard let url = URL(string: urlString) else {
  49 |         print("❌ URL 无效")
  50 |         return
  51 |     }
  52 |     
  53 |     // 创建 WebSocket
  54 |     print("\n🔗 正在连接...")
  55 |     var request = URLRequest(url: url)
  56 |     request.setValue("chrome-extension://jdiccldimpdaibmpdkjnbmckianbfold", forHTTPHeaderField: "Origin")
  57 |     request.setValue("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/\(chromiumVersion) Edg/\(chromiumVersion)", forHTTPHeaderField: "User-Agent")
  58 |     
  59 |     let delegate = WSDelegate()
  60 |     let session = URLSession(configuration: .default, delegate: delegate, delegateQueue: nil)
  61 |     let ws = session.webSocketTask(with: request)
  62 |     
  63 |     // 等待连接
  64 |     await withCheckedContinuation { (cont: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>) in
  65 |         delegate.onOpen = { cont.resume() }
  66 |         ws.resume()
  67 |     }
  68 |     
  69 |     // 发送配置
  70 |     print("📤 发送配置...")
  71 |     let configMessage = "Content-Type:application/json; charset=utf-8\r\nPath:speech.config\r\n\r\n{\"context\":{\"synthesis\":{\"audio\":{\"metadataoptions\":{\"sentenceBoundaryEnabled\":\"false\",\"wordBoundaryEnabled\":\"false\"},\"outputFormat\":\"audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3\"}}}}"
  72 |     do {
  73 |         try await ws.send(.string(configMessage))
  74 |         print("   ✅ 配置已发送")
  75 |     } catch {
  76 |         print("   ❌ 发送配置失败: \(error)")
  77 |         return
  78 |     }
  79 |     
  80 |     // 发送 SSML
  81 |     print("📤 发送 SSML...")
  82 |     let ssml = "<speak version=\"1.0\" xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis\" xml:lang=\"zh-CN\"><voice name=\"\(voice)\"><prosody rate=\"+0%\" pitch=\"+0Hz\">\(text)</prosody></voice></speak>"
  83 |     let ssmlMessage = "X-RequestId:\(UUID().uuidString)\r\nContent-Type:application/ssml+xml\r\nPath:ssml\r\n\r\n\(ssml)"
  84 |     do {
  85 |         try await ws.send(.string(ssmlMessage))
  86 |         print("   ✅ SSML 已发送")
  87 |     } catch {
  88 |         print("   ❌ 发送 SSML 失败: \(error)")
  89 |         return
  90 |     }
  91 |     
  92 |     // 接收音频
  93 |     print("\n📥 接收音频数据...")
  94 |     var audioData = Data()
  95 |     var messageCount = 0
  96 |     
  97 |     while true {
  98 |         do {
  99 |             let message = try await ws.receive()
 100 |             messageCount += 1
 101 |             
 102 |             switch message {
 103 |             case .data(let data):
 104 |                 // 尝试解析为字符串查看内容
 105 |                 if let str = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8), str.contains("Path:audio\r\n") {
 106 |                     // 找到音频分隔符后的数据
 107 |                     if let range = str.range(of: "Path:audio\r\n") {
 108 |                         let offset = range.upperBound.utf16Offset(in: str)
 109 |                         let audioChunk = data.suffix(from: offset)
 110 |                         audioData.append(audioChunk)
 111 |                         print("   收到音频块 #\(messageCount): \(audioChunk.count) bytes (有 header)")
 112 |                     }
 113 |                 } else {
 114 |                     // 纯二进制音频
 115 |                     audioData.append(data)
 116 |                     print("   收到音频块 #\(messageCount): \(data.count) bytes")
 117 |                 }
 118 |                 
 119 |             case .string(let str):
 120 |                 if str.contains("Path:turn.end") {
 121 |                     print("   ✅ 收到结束信号")
 122 |                     break
 123 |                 } else if str.contains("Path:audio.metadata") {
 124 |                     print("   收到元数据")
 125 |                 } else {
 126 |                     print("   收到文本: \(str.prefix(50))...")
 127 |                 }
 128 |                 continue
 129 |                 
 130 |             @unknown default:
 131 |                 continue
 132 |             }
 133 |             
 134 |             if messageCount > 100 { break } // 防止死循环
 135 |             
 136 |         } catch {
 137 |             print("   ⚠️ 接收错误: \(error)")
 138 |             break
 139 |         }
 140 |     }
 141 |     
 142 |     ws.cancel(with: .goingAway, reason: nil)
 143 |     
 144 |     print("\n📊 结果:")
 145 |     print("   总消息数: \(messageCount)")
 146 |     print("   音频大小: \(audioData.count) bytes")
 147 |     
 148 |     if audioData.isEmpty {
 149 |         print("   ❌ 没有收到音频数据")
 150 |         return
 151 |     }
 152 |     
 153 |     // 检查音频头
 154 |     let header = audioData.prefix(16)
 155 |     print("   音频头: \(header.map { String(format: "%02X", $0) }.joined(separator: " "))")
 156 |     
 157 |     // MP3 文件应该以 FF FB 或 ID3 开头
 158 |     if header.first == 0xFF || (header.prefix(3) == Data([0x49, 0x44, 0x33])) {
 159 |         print("   ✅ 看起来是有效的 MP3 格式")
 160 |     } else {
 161 |         print("   ⚠️ 可能不是标准 MP3 格式")
 162 |     }
 163 |     
 164 |     // 保存到文件
 165 |     let tempPath = "/tmp/edge_tts_test.mp3"
 166 |     do {
 167 |         try audioData.write(to: URL(fileURLWithPath: tempPath))
 168 |         print("\n💾 已保存到: \(tempPath)")
 169 |     } catch {
 170 |         print("   ❌ 保存失败: \(error)")
 171 |         return
 172 |     }
 173 |     
 174 |     // 播放测试
 175 |     print("\n🔊 播放测试...")
 176 |     do {
 177 |         let player = try AVAudioPlayer(contentsOf: URL(fileURLWithPath: tempPath))
 178 |         player.prepareToPlay()
 179 |         
 180 |         if player.play() {
 181 |             print("   ▶️ 正在播放 (时长: \(String(format: "%.1f", player.duration))秒)")
 182 |             
 183 |             // 等待播放完成
 184 |             while player.isPlaying {
 185 |                 try await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 100_000_000)
 186 |             }
 187 |             print("   ✅ 播放完成!")
 188 |         } else {
 189 |             print("   ❌ 播放启动失败")
 190 |         }
 191 |     } catch {
 192 |         print("   ❌ 播放错误: \(error)")
 193 |         
 194 |         // 尝试用 afplay 播放
 195 |         print("\n🔧 尝试用 afplay 播放...")
 196 |         let process = Process()
 197 |         process.executableURL = URL(fileURLWithPath: "/usr/bin/afplay")
 198 |         process.arguments = [tempPath]
 199 |         try? process.run()
 200 |         process.waitUntilExit()
 201 |         
 202 |         if process.terminationStatus == 0 {
 203 |             print("   ✅ afplay 播放成功!")
 204 |         } else {
 205 |             print("   ❌ afplay 也失败了")
 206 |         }
 207 |     }
 208 | }
 209 | 
 210 | // 运行测试
 211 | Task {
 212 |     await runTest()
 213 |     exit(0)
 214 | }
 215 | 
 216 | // 保持运行
 217 | RunLoop.main.run()

  37 |                         .font(.system(size: 16, weight: .medium))
  38 |                         .foregroundStyle(Color.blue)
  39 |

  41 |                         .font(.system(size: 12))

  44 |             }
  45 |             .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
  46 |             .transition(.opacity)
  47 |         }
  48 |     }
  49 | }
  50 | 
  51 | // MARK: - Drop Handler Modifier
  52 | 
  53 | /// 通用拖拽处理修饰符
  54 | struct AttachmentDropHandler: ViewModifier {
  55 |     /// 添加附件的回调
  56 |     let onAdd: (Attachment) -> Void
  57 |     
  58 |     /// 圆角半径（用于蒙版）
  59 |     var cornerRadius: CGFloat = 16
  60 |     
  61 |     @State private var isDragOver = false
  62 |     
  63 |     private let attachmentManager = AttachmentManager.shared
  64 |     
  65 |     func body(content: Content) -> some View {
  66 |         content
  67 |             .overlay {
  68 |                 AttachmentDropOverlay(
  69 |                     cornerRadius: cornerRadius,
  70 |                     isVisible: isDragOver
  71 |                 )
  72 |             }
  73 |             .onDrop(of: supportedTypes, isTargeted: $isDragOver) { providers in
  74 |                 handleDrop(providers: providers)
  75 |                 return true
  76 |             }
  77 |     }
  78 |     
  79 |     /// 支持的拖拽类型
  80 |     private var supportedTypes: [UTType] {
  81 |         [.image, .fileURL, .folder, .zip]
  82 |     }
  83 |     
  84 |     private func handleDrop(providers: [NSItemProvider]) {
  85 |         attachmentManager.handleDrop(providers: providers, onAdd: onAdd)
  86 |     }
  87 | }
  88 | 
  89 | // MARK: - View Extension
  90 | 
  91 | extension View {
  92 |     /// 添加通用拖拽处理
  93 |     func attachmentDropHandler(
  94 |         cornerRadius: CGFloat = 16,
  95 |         onAdd: @escaping (Attachment) -> Void
  96 |     ) -> some View {
  97 |         modifier(AttachmentDropHandler(onAdd: onAdd, cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
  98 |     }
  99 | }

 330 | // MARK: - Scrolling Waveform
 331 | 
 332 | struct ScrollingWaveform: View {
 333 |     let levels: [Float]
 334 |     
 335 |     var body: some View {
 336 |         HStack(alignment: .center, spacing: 2) {
 337 |             ForEach(Array(levels.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { index, level in
 338 |                 Capsule()
 339 |                     .fill(barColor(for: index))
 340 |                     // 动态高度：即使音量很小，也给一个基础波动
 341 |                     .frame(width: 2, height: barHeight(for: level))
 342 |             }
 343 |         }
 344 |     }
 345 |     
 346 |     private func barHeight(for level: Float) -> CGFloat {
 347 |         let minH: CGFloat = 4
 348 |         let maxH: CGFloat = 20 // 增加最大高度
 349 |         
 350 |         // 非线性映射：让小音量也能有明显的高度
 351 |         // pow(level, 0.7) 会提升小数值的权重
 352 |         let adjustedLevel = CGFloat(pow(Double(level), 0.7))
 353 |         
 354 |         return minH + adjustedLevel * (maxH - minH)
 355 |     }
 356 |     
 357 |     private func barColor(for index: Int) -> Color {
 358 |         let count = levels.count
 359 |         // 让右侧（最新）的波纹更亮更红
 360 |         let progress = Double(index) / Double(count - 1)
 361 |         // 增加一点不透明度
 362 |         return Color.red.opacity(0.4 + 0.6 * progress)
 363 |     }
 364 | }

 368 | struct StatusIndicator: View {
 369 |     /// 当前状态：true = thinking (spinner), false = success (checkmark)
 370 |     let isThinking: Bool
 371 |     
 372 |     @State private var checkmarkScale: CGFloat = 0
 373 |     @State private var rotation: Double = 0
 374 |     
 375 |     // 彩色点的颜色
 376 |     private let dotColors: [Color] = [
 377 |         Color(red: 0.3, green: 0.5, blue: 1.0),   // 蓝
 378 |         Color(red: 0.5, green: 0.3, blue: 1.0),   // 紫蓝
