2063 |  317 | func extractFromFolder(_ folderURL: URL) async -> Result<TextBundle, TextExtractionError> {
2064 |  318 |     let codeExtensions: Set<String> = [
2065 |  319 |         "js", "jsx", "ts", "tsx", "mjs", "cjs",
2066 |  320 |         "html", "htm", "css", "scss", "less", "vue", "svelte",
2067 |  321 |         "py", "pyw", "pyi",
2068 |  322 |         "java", "kt", "kts", "scala",
2069 |  323 |         "c", "cpp", "cc", "cxx", "h", "hpp", "hxx",
2070 |  324 |         "rs", "go", "rb", "erb", "php", "swift",
2071 |  325 |         "sh", "bash", "zsh", "fish",
2072 |  326 |         "json", "yaml", "yml", "toml", "xml", "ini", "cfg", "conf",
2073 |  327 |         "md", "mdx", "txt", "rst", "asciidoc",
2074 |  328 |         "sql", "graphql", "proto", "dockerfile"
2075 |  329 |     ]
2076 |  330 |     
2077 |  331 |     let excludedDirs: Set<String> = [
2078 |  332 |         "node_modules", ".git", ".svn", ".hg",
2079 |  333 |         "dist", "build", "target", ".next", ".nuxt",
2080 |  334 |         "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", ".tox",
2081 |  335 |         "venv", "env", ".env", ".venv",
2082 |  336 |         "vendor", "Pods", "Carthage",
2083 |  337 |         ".idea", ".vscode", ".vs"
2084 |  338 |     ]
2085 |  339 |     
2086 |  340 |     let excludedFiles: Set<String> = [
2087 |  341 |         ".DS_Store", "Thumbs.db", ".gitignore", ".gitattributes",
2088 |  342 |         "package-lock.json", "yarn.lock", "pnpm-lock.yaml",
2089 |  343 |         "Podfile.lock", "Gemfile.lock", "Cargo.lock"
2090 |  344 |     ]
2091 |  345 |     
2092 |  346 |     // 递归收集文件
2093 |  347 |     func collectFiles(in directory: URL) -> [URL] {
2094 |  348 |         var result: [URL] = []
2095 |  349 |         let fm = FileManager.default
2096 |  350 |         
2097 |  351 |         guard let contents = try? fm.contentsOfDirectory(
2098 |  352 |             at: directory,
2099 |  353 |             includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isRegularFileKey, .isDirectoryKey],
2100 |  354 |             options: [.skipsHiddenFiles]
2101 |  355 |         ) else { return [] }
2102 |  356 |         
2103 |  357 |         for url in contents {
2104 |  358 |             let fileName = url.lastPathComponent
2105 |  359 |             if excludedFiles.contains(fileName) { continue }
2106 |  360 |             
2107 |  361 |             let values = try? url.resourceValues(forKeys: [.isRegularFileKey, .isDirectoryKey])
2108 |  362 |             
2109 |  363 |             if values?.isDirectory == true {
2110 |  364 |                 if !excludedDirs.contains(fileName) {
2111 |  365 |                     result.append(contentsOf: collectFiles(in: url))
2112 |  366 |                 }
2113 |  367 |             } else if values?.isRegularFile == true {
2114 |  368 |                 let ext = url.pathExtension.lowercased()
2115 |  369 |                 if codeExtensions.contains(ext) {
2116 |  370 |                     result.append(url)
2117 |  371 |                 }
2118 |  372 |             }
2119 |  373 |         }
2120 |  374 |         return result.sorted { $0.path < $1.path }
2121 |  375 |     }
2122 |  376 |     
2123 |  377 |     let files = collectFiles(in: folderURL)
2124 |  378 |     guard !files.isEmpty else {
2125 |  379 |         return .failure(.noTextFilesFound)
2126 |  380 |     }
2127 |  381 |     
2128 |  382 |     // 合并内容
2129 |  383 |     var parts: [String] = ["# 目录结构\n```"]
2130 |  384 |     for file in files {
2131 |  385 |         let rel = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: folderURL.path + "/", with: "")
2132 |  386 |         parts.append(rel)
2133 |  387 |     }
2134 |  388 |     parts.append("```\n\n# 文件内容\n")
2135 |  389 |     
2136 |  390 |     for file in files {
2137 |  391 |         let rel = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: folderURL.path + "/", with: "")
2138 |  392 |         let ext = file.pathExtension
2139 |  393 |         if let content = try? String(contentsOf: file, encoding: .utf8) {
2140 |  394 |             let numbered = content.components(separatedBy: .newlines).enumerated()
2141 |  395 |                 .map { "\($0.offset + 1)│ \($0.element)" }.joined(separator: "\n")
2142 |  396 |             parts.append("## \(rel)\n```\(ext)\n\(numbered)\n```\n")
2143 |  397 |         }
2144 |  398 |     }
2145 |  399 |     
2146 |  400 |     return .success(TextBundle(
2147 |  401 |         content: parts.joined(separator: "\n"),
2148 |  402 |         fileCount: files.count,
2149 |  403 |         sourcePath: folderURL.path,
2150 |  404 |         files: files.map { $0.path }
2151 |  405 |     ))
2152 |  406 | }

 306 |  220 |         }

 313 |  227 |         }

 329 |  243 |     static func makeThumbnail(from image: NSImage, maxSize: CGFloat = 256) -> NSImage {
 330 |  244 |         let size = image.size
 331 |  245 |         guard size.width > 0 && size.height > 0 else { return image }
 332 |  246 |         
 333 |  247 |         let scale = min(maxSize / size.width, maxSize / size.height, 1.0)
 334 |  248 |         let newSize = NSSize(width: size.width * scale, height: size.height * scale)
 335 |  249 |         
 336 |  250 |         let thumbnail = NSImage(size: newSize)
 337 |  251 |         thumbnail.lockFocus()
 338 |  252 |         image.draw(in: NSRect(origin: .zero, size: newSize),
 339 |  253 |                    from: NSRect(origin: .zero, size: size),
 340 |  254 |                    operation: .copy, fraction: 1.0)
 341 |  255 |         thumbnail.unlockFocus()
 342 |  256 |         return thumbnail
 343 |  257 |     }
 344 |  258 | }

 823 |  301 | // MARK: - TextExtractionService (简化版，用于测试)
 824 |  302 | 
 825 |  303 | struct TextBundle {
 826 |  304 |     let content: String
 827 |  305 |     let fileCount: Int
 828 |  306 |     let sourcePath: String
 829 |  307 |     let files: [String]
 830 |  308 | }

 832 |  310 | enum TextExtractionError: Error, Equatable {
 833 |  311 |     case folderNotFound
 834 |  312 |     case zipExtractionFailed(String)
 835 |  313 |     case noTextFilesFound
 836 |  314 |     case accessDenied
 837 |  315 | }

 839 |  317 | func extractFromFolder(_ folderURL: URL) async -> Result<TextBundle, TextExtractionError> {
 840 |  318 |     let codeExtensions: Set<String> = [
 841 |  319 |         "js", "jsx", "ts", "tsx", "mjs", "cjs",
 842 |  320 |         "html", "htm", "css", "scss", "less", "vue", "svelte",
 843 |  321 |         "py", "pyw", "pyi",
 844 |  322 |         "java", "kt", "kts", "scala",
 845 |  323 |         "c", "cpp", "cc", "cxx", "h", "hpp", "hxx",
 846 |  324 |         "rs", "go", "rb", "erb", "php", "swift",
 847 |  325 |         "sh", "bash", "zsh", "fish",
 848 |  326 |         "json", "yaml", "yml", "toml", "xml", "ini", "cfg", "conf",
 849 |  327 |         "md", "mdx", "txt", "rst", "asciidoc",
 850 |  328 |         "sql", "graphql", "proto", "dockerfile"
 851 |  329 |     ]
 852 |  330 |     
 853 |  331 |     let excludedDirs: Set<String> = [
 854 |  332 |         "node_modules", ".git", ".svn", ".hg",
 855 |  333 |         "dist", "build", "target", ".next", ".nuxt",
 856 |  334 |         "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", ".tox",
 857 |  335 |         "venv", "env", ".env", ".venv",
 858 |  336 |         "vendor", "Pods", "Carthage",
 859 |  337 |         ".idea", ".vscode", ".vs"
 860 |  338 |     ]
 861 |  339 |     
 862 |  340 |     let excludedFiles: Set<String> = [
 863 |  341 |         ".DS_Store", "Thumbs.db", ".gitignore", ".gitattributes",
 864 |  342 |         "package-lock.json", "yarn.lock", "pnpm-lock.yaml",
 865 |  343 |         "Podfile.lock", "Gemfile.lock", "Cargo.lock"
 866 |  344 |     ]
 867 |  345 |     
 868 |  346 |     // 递归收集文件
 869 |  347 |     func collectFiles(in directory: URL) -> [URL] {
 870 |  348 |         var result: [URL] = []
 871 |  349 |         let fm = FileManager.default
 872 |  350 |         
 873 |  351 |         guard let contents = try? fm.contentsOfDirectory(
 874 |  352 |             at: directory,
 875 |  353 |             includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isRegularFileKey, .isDirectoryKey],
 876 |  354 |             options: [.skipsHiddenFiles]
 877 |  355 |         ) else { return [] }
 878 |  356 |         
 879 |  357 |         for url in contents {
 880 |  358 |             let fileName = url.lastPathComponent
 881 |  359 |             if excludedFiles.contains(fileName) { continue }
 882 |  360 |             
 883 |  361 |             let values = try? url.resourceValues(forKeys: [.isRegularFileKey, .isDirectoryKey])
 884 |  362 |             
 885 |  363 |             if values?.isDirectory == true {
 886 |  364 |                 if !excludedDirs.contains(fileName) {
 887 |  365 |                     result.append(contentsOf: collectFiles(in: url))
 888 |  366 |                 }
 889 |  367 |             } else if values?.isRegularFile == true {
 890 |  368 |                 let ext = url.pathExtension.lowercased()
 891 |  369 |                 if codeExtensions.contains(ext) {
 892 |  370 |                     result.append(url)
 893 |  371 |                 }
 894 |  372 |             }
 895 |  373 |         }
 896 |  374 |         return result.sorted { $0.path < $1.path }
 897 |  375 |     }
 898 |  376 |     
 899 |  377 |     let files = collectFiles(in: folderURL)
 900 |  378 |     guard !files.isEmpty else {
 901 |  379 |         return .failure(.noTextFilesFound)
 902 |  380 |     }
 903 |  381 |     
 904 |  382 |     // 合并内容
 905 |  383 |     var parts: [String] = ["# 目录结构\n```"]
 906 |  384 |     for file in files {
 907 |  385 |         let rel = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: folderURL.path + "/", with: "")
 908 |  386 |         parts.append(rel)
 909 |  387 |     }
 910 |  388 |     parts.append("```\n\n# 文件内容\n")
 911 |  389 |     
 912 |  390 |     for file in files {
 913 |  391 |         let rel = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: folderURL.path + "/", with: "")
 914 |  392 |         let ext = file.pathExtension
 915 |  393 |         if let content = try? String(contentsOf: file, encoding: .utf8) {
 916 |  394 |             let numbered = content.components(separatedBy: .newlines).enumerated()
 917 |  395 |                 .map { "\($0.offset + 1)│ \($0.element)" }.joined(separator: "\n")
 918 |  396 |             parts.append("## \(rel)\n```\(ext)\n\(numbered)\n```\n")
 919 |  397 |         }
 920 |  398 |     }
 921 |  399 |     
 922 |  400 |     return .success(TextBundle(
 923 |  401 |         content: parts.joined(separator: "\n"),
 924 |  402 |         fileCount: files.count,
 925 |  403 |         sourcePath: folderURL.path,
 926 |  404 |         files: files.map { $0.path }
 927 |  405 |     ))
 928 |  406 | }

 930 |  408 | func extractFromZIP(_ zipURL: URL) async -> Result<TextBundle, TextExtractionError> {
 931 |  409 |     let tempDir = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("zip-\(UUID().uuidString)")
 932 |  410 |     try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: tempDir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
 933 |  411 |     defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tempDir) }
 934 |  412 |     
 935 |  413 |     let process = Process()
 936 |  414 |     process.executableURL = URL(fileURLWithPath: "/usr/bin/unzip")
 937 |  415 |     process.arguments = ["-q", "-o", zipURL.path, "-d", tempDir.path]
 938 |  416 |     process.standardOutput = FileHandle.nullDevice
 939 |  417 |     process.standardError = FileHandle.nullDevice
 940 |  418 |     
 941 |  419 |     do {
 942 |  420 |         try process.run()
 943 |  421 |         process.waitUntilExit()
 944 |  422 |         
 945 |  423 |         guard process.terminationStatus == 0 else {
 946 |  424 |             return .failure(.zipExtractionFailed("Exit code: \(process.terminationStatus)"))
 947 |  425 |         }
 948 |  426 |         
 949 |  427 |         return await extractFromFolder(tempDir)
 950 |  428 |     } catch {
 951 |  429 |         return .failure(.zipExtractionFailed(error.localizedDescription))
 952 |  430 |     }
 953 |  431 | }

 191 |  174 | // MARK: - Attachment Type (简化版，用于测试)
 192 |  175 | 
 193 |  176 | import UniformTypeIdentifiers
 194 |  177 | 
 195 |  178 | enum Attachment: Identifiable, Equatable {
 196 |  179 |     case image(NSImage, NSImage?, UUID)
 197 |  180 |     case screenshot(NSImage, NSImage?, UUID)
 198 |  181 |     case file(URL, UUID)
 199 |  182 |     case textBundle(String, String, Int, UUID)
 200 |  183 |     
 201 |  184 |     var id: UUID {
 202 |  185 |         switch self {
 203 |  186 |         case .image(_, _, let id), .screenshot(_, _, let id),
 204 |  187 |              .file(_, let id), .textBundle(_, _, _, let id):
 205 |  188 |             return id
 206 |  189 |         }
 207 |  190 |     }
 208 |  191 |     
 209 |  192 |     var thumbnail: NSImage? {
 210 |  193 |         switch self {
 211 |  194 |         case .image(_, let thumb, _), .screenshot(_, let thumb, _): return thumb
 212 |  195 |         default: return nil
 213 |  196 |         }
 214 |  197 |     }
 215 |  198 |     
 216 |  199 |     var originalImage: NSImage? {
 217 |  200 |         switch self {
 218 |  201 |         case .image(let img, _, _), .screenshot(let img, _, _): return img
 219 |  202 |         default: return nil
 220 |  203 |         }
 221 |  204 |     }
 222 |  205 |     
 223 |  206 |     var fileName: String? {
 224 |  207 |         switch self {
 225 |  208 |         case .file(let url, _): return url.lastPathComponent
 226 |  209 |         case .textBundle(_, let source, _, _): return source
 227 |  210 |         default: return nil
 228 |  211 |         }
 229 |  212 |     }
 230 |  213 |     
 231 |  214 |     var displayTitle: String {
 232 |  215 |         switch self {
 233 |  216 |         case .image: return "图片"
 234 |  217 |         case .screenshot: return "截图"
 235 |  218 |         case .file(let url, _): return url.lastPathComponent
 236 |  219 |         case .textBundle(_, let source, let count, _): return "\(source) (\(count) 文件)"
 237 |  220 |         }
 238 |  221 |     }
 239 |  222 |     
 240 |  223 |     var isVideo: Bool {
 241 |  224 |         if case .file(let url, _) = self,
 242 |  225 |            let uti = UTType(filenameExtension: url.pathExtension) {
 243 |  226 |             return uti.conforms(to: .movie) || uti.conforms(to: .video)
 244 |  227 |         }
 245 |  228 |         return false
 246 |  229 |     }
 247 |  230 |     
 248 |  231 |     var isTextBundle: Bool {
 249 |  232 |         if case .textBundle = self { return true }
 250 |  233 |         return false
 251 |  234 |     }
 252 |  235 |     
 253 |  236 |     var textContent: String? {
 254 |  237 |         if case .textBundle(let content, _, _, _) = self { return content }
 255 |  238 |         return nil
 256 |  239 |     }
 257 |  240 |     
 258 |  241 |     static func == (lhs: Attachment, rhs: Attachment) -> Bool { lhs.id == rhs.id }
 259 |  242 |     
 260 |  243 |     static func makeThumbnail(from image: NSImage, maxSize: CGFloat = 256) -> NSImage {
 261 |  244 |         let size = image.size
 262 |  245 |         guard size.width > 0 && size.height > 0 else { return image }
 263 |  246 |         
 264 |  247 |         let scale = min(maxSize / size.width, maxSize / size.height, 1.0)
 265 |  248 |         let newSize = NSSize(width: size.width * scale, height: size.height * scale)
 266 |  249 |         
 267 |  250 |         let thumbnail = NSImage(size: newSize)
 268 |  251 |         thumbnail.lockFocus()
 269 |  252 |         image.draw(in: NSRect(origin: .zero, size: newSize),
 270 |  253 |                    from: NSRect(origin: .zero, size: size),
 271 |  254 |                    operation: .copy, fraction: 1.0)
 272 |  255 |         thumbnail.unlockFocus()
 273 |  256 |         return thumbnail
 274 |  257 |     }
 275 |  258 | }

 279 |  262 | struct TestError: Error, CustomStringConvertible {
 280 |  263 |     let message: String
 281 |  264 |     init(_ message: String) { self.message = message }
 282 |  265 |     var description: String { message }
 283 |  266 | }
 284 |  267 | 
 285 |  268 | func assertEqual<T: Equatable>(_ actual: T, _ expected: T, _ name: String) throws {
 286 |  269 |     if actual != expected {
 287 |  270 |         throw TestError("\(name): 期望 \(expected), 实际 \(actual)")
 288 |  271 |     }
 289 |  272 | }
 290 |  273 | 
 291 |  274 | func assertTrue(_ condition: Bool, _ message: String) throws {
 292 |  275 |     if !condition { throw TestError(message) }
 293 |  276 | }
 294 |  277 | 
 295 |  278 | func assertFalse(_ condition: Bool, _ message: String) throws {
 296 |  279 |     if condition { throw TestError(message) }
 297 |  280 | }
 298 |  281 | 
 299 |  282 | func assertNil<T>(_ value: T?, _ message: String) throws {
 300 |  283 |     if value != nil { throw TestError("\(message) 应该是 nil") }
 301 |  284 | }
 302 |  285 | 
 303 |  286 | func assertNotNil<T>(_ value: T?, _ message: String) throws {
 304 |  287 |     if value == nil { throw TestError("\(message) 不应该是 nil") }
 305 |  288 | }

 770 |  317 | func extractFromFolder(_ folderURL: URL) async -> Result<TextBundle, TextExtractionError> {
 771 |  318 |     let codeExtensions: Set<String> = [
 772 |  319 |         "js", "jsx", "ts", "tsx", "mjs", "cjs",
 773 |  320 |         "html", "htm", "css", "scss", "less", "vue", "svelte",
 774 |  321 |         "py", "pyw", "pyi",
 775 |  322 |         "java", "kt", "kts", "scala",
 776 |  323 |         "c", "cpp", "cc", "cxx", "h", "hpp", "hxx",
 777 |  324 |         "rs", "go", "rb", "erb", "php", "swift",
 778 |  325 |         "sh", "bash", "zsh", "fish",
 779 |  326 |         "json", "yaml", "yml", "toml", "xml", "ini", "cfg", "conf",
 780 |  327 |         "md", "mdx", "txt", "rst", "asciidoc",
 781 |  328 |         "sql", "graphql", "proto", "dockerfile"
 782 |  329 |     ]
 783 |  330 |     
 784 |  331 |     let excludedDirs: Set<String> = [
 785 |  332 |         "node_modules", ".git", ".svn", ".hg",
 786 |  333 |         "dist", "build", "target", ".next", ".nuxt",
 787 |  334 |         "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", ".tox",
 788 |  335 |         "venv", "env", ".env", ".venv",
 789 |  336 |         "vendor", "Pods", "Carthage",
 790 |  337 |         ".idea", ".vscode", ".vs"
 791 |  338 |     ]
 792 |  339 |     
 793 |  340 |     let excludedFiles: Set<String> = [
 794 |  341 |         ".DS_Store", "Thumbs.db", ".gitignore", ".gitattributes",
 795 |  342 |         "package-lock.json", "yarn.lock", "pnpm-lock.yaml",
 796 |  343 |         "Podfile.lock", "Gemfile.lock", "Cargo.lock"
 797 |  344 |     ]
 798 |  345 |     
 799 |  346 |     // 递归收集文件
 800 |  347 |     func collectFiles(in directory: URL) -> [URL] {
 801 |  348 |         var result: [URL] = []
 802 |  349 |         let fm = FileManager.default
 803 |  350 |         
 804 |  351 |         guard let contents = try? fm.contentsOfDirectory(
 805 |  352 |             at: directory,
 806 |  353 |             includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isRegularFileKey, .isDirectoryKey],
 807 |  354 |             options: [.skipsHiddenFiles]
 808 |  355 |         ) else { return [] }
 809 |  356 |         
 810 |  357 |         for url in contents {
 811 |  358 |             let fileName = url.lastPathComponent
 812 |  359 |             if excludedFiles.contains(fileName) { continue }
 813 |  360 |             
 814 |  361 |             let values = try? url.resourceValues(forKeys: [.isRegularFileKey, .isDirectoryKey])
 815 |  362 |             
 816 |  363 |             if values?.isDirectory == true {
 817 |  364 |                 if !excludedDirs.contains(fileName) {
 818 |  365 |                     result.append(contentsOf: collectFiles(in: url))
 819 |  366 |                 }
 820 |  367 |             } else if values?.isRegularFile == true {
 821 |  368 |                 let ext = url.pathExtension.lowercased()
 822 |  369 |                 if codeExtensions.contains(ext) {
 823 |  370 |                     result.append(url)
 824 |  371 |                 }
 825 |  372 |             }
 826 |  373 |         }
 827 |  374 |         return result.sorted { $0.path < $1.path }
 828 |  375 |     }
 829 |  376 |     
 830 |  377 |     let files = collectFiles(in: folderURL)
 831 |  378 |     guard !files.isEmpty else {
 832 |  379 |         return .failure(.noTextFilesFound)
 833 |  380 |     }
 834 |  381 |     
 835 |  382 |     // 合并内容
 836 |  383 |     var parts: [String] = ["# 目录结构\n```"]
 837 |  384 |     for file in files {
 838 |  385 |         let rel = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: folderURL.path + "/", with: "")
 839 |  386 |         parts.append(rel)
 840 |  387 |     }
 841 |  388 |     parts.append("```\n\n# 文件内容\n")
 842 |  389 |     
 843 |  390 |     for file in files {
 844 |  391 |         let rel = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: folderURL.path + "/", with: "")
 845 |  392 |         let ext = file.pathExtension
 846 |  393 |         if let content = try? String(contentsOf: file, encoding: .utf8) {
 847 |  394 |             let numbered = content.components(separatedBy: .newlines).enumerated()
 848 |  395 |                 .map { "\($0.offset + 1)│ \($0.element)" }.joined(separator: "\n")
 849 |  396 |             parts.append("## \(rel)\n```\(ext)\n\(numbered)\n```\n")
 850 |  397 |         }
 851 |  398 |     }
 852 |  399 |     
 853 |  400 |     return .success(TextBundle(
 854 |  401 |         content: parts.joined(separator: "\n"),
 855 |  402 |         fileCount: files.count,
 856 |  403 |         sourcePath: folderURL.path,
 857 |  404 |         files: files.map { $0.path }
 858 |  405 |     ))
 859 |  406 | }

 861 |  408 | func extractFromZIP(_ zipURL: URL) async -> Result<TextBundle, TextExtractionError> {
 862 |  409 |     let tempDir = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("zip-\(UUID().uuidString)")
 863 |  410 |     try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: tempDir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
 864 |  411 |     defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tempDir) }
 865 |  412 |     
 866 |  413 |     let process = Process()
 867 |  414 |     process.executableURL = URL(fileURLWithPath: "/usr/bin/unzip")
 868 |  415 |     process.arguments = ["-q", "-o", zipURL.path, "-d", tempDir.path]
 869 |  416 |     process.standardOutput = FileHandle.nullDevice
 870 |  417 |     process.standardError = FileHandle.nullDevice
 871 |  418 |     
 872 |  419 |     do {
 873 |  420 |         try process.run()
 874 |  421 |         process.waitUntilExit()
 875 |  422 |         
 876 |  423 |         guard process.terminationStatus == 0 else {
 877 |  424 |             return .failure(.zipExtractionFailed("Exit code: \(process.terminationStatus)"))
 878 |  425 |         }
 879 |  426 |         
 880 |  427 |         return await extractFromFolder(tempDir)
 881 |  428 |     } catch {
 882 |  429 |         return .failure(.zipExtractionFailed(error.localizedDescription))
 883 |  430 |     }
 884 |  431 | }

 993 |   89 |         return
 994 |   90 |     }
 995 |   91 |     
 996 |   92 |     // 接收音频
 997 |   93 |     print("\n📥 接收音频数据...")
 998 |   94 |     var audioData = Data()
 999 |   95 |     var messageCount = 0
1000 |   96 |     
1001 |   97 |     while true {
1002 |   98 |         do {
1003 |   99 |             let message = try await ws.receive()
1004 |  100 |             messageCount += 1
1005 |  101 |             
1006 |  102 |             switch message {
1007 |  103 |             case .data(let data):
1008 |  104 |                 // 尝试解析为字符串查看内容
1009 |  105 |                 if let str = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8), str.contains("Path:audio\r\n") {
1010 |  106 |                     // 找到音频分隔符后的数据
1011 |  107 |                     if let range = str.range(of: "Path:audio\r\n") {
1012 |  108 |                         let offset = range.upperBound.utf16Offset(in: str)
1013 |  109 |                         let audioChunk = data.suffix(from: offset)
1014 |  110 |                         audioData.append(audioChunk)
1015 |  111 |                         print("   收到音频块 #\(messageCount): \(audioChunk.count) bytes (有 header)")
1016 |  112 |                     }
1017 |  113 |                 } else {
1018 |  114 |                     // 纯二进制音频
1019 |  115 |                     audioData.append(data)
1020 |  116 |                     print("   收到音频块 #\(messageCount): \(data.count) bytes")
1021 |  117 |                 }
1022 |  118 |                 
1023 |  119 |             case .string(let str):
1024 |  120 |                 if str.contains("Path:turn.end") {
1025 |  121 |                     print("   ✅ 收到结束信号")
1026 |  122 |                     break
1027 |  123 |                 } else if str.contains("Path:audio.metadata") {
1028 |  124 |                     print("   收到元数据")
1029 |  125 |                 } else {

1031 |  127 |                 }
1032 |  128 |                 continue
1033 |  129 |                 
1034 |  130 |             @unknown default:
1035 |  131 |                 continue
1036 |  132 |             }
1037 |  133 |             
1038 |  134 |             if messageCount > 100 { break } // 防止死循环
1039 |  135 |             
1040 |  136 |         } catch {
1041 |  137 |             print("   ⚠️ 接收错误: \(error)")
1042 |  138 |             break
1043 |  139 |         }
1044 |  140 |     }
1045 |  141 |     
1046 |  142 |     ws.cancel(with: .goingAway, reason: nil)
1047 |  143 |     
1048 |  144 |     print("\n📊 结果:")
1049 |  145 |     print("   总消息数: \(messageCount)")
1050 |  146 |     print("   音频大小: \(audioData.count) bytes")
1051 |  147 |     
1052 |  148 |     if audioData.isEmpty {
1053 |  149 |         print("   ❌ 没有收到音频数据")
1054 |  150 |         return
1055 |  151 |     }
1056 |  152 |     
1057 |  153 |     // 检查音频头
1058 |  154 |     let header = audioData.prefix(16)

1060 |  156 |     
1061 |  157 |     // MP3 文件应该以 FF FB 或 ID3 开头
1062 |  158 |     if header.first == 0xFF || (header.prefix(3) == Data([0x49, 0x44, 0x33])) {

```swift
   6 | class AppDelegate: NSObject, NSApplicationDelegate {

  12 |     static let sharedModelContainer: ModelContainer = {

  14 |

  17 |         let spokeDataDir = appSupport.appendingPathComponent("Spoke/Data", isDirectory: true)
  18 |

  20 |         try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: spokeDataDir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
  21 |         
  22 |         let storeURL = spokeDataDir.appendingPathComponent("SpokenAnyWhere.store")
  23 |         let config = ModelConfiguration(schema: schema, url: storeURL)
  24 |         
  25 |         do {

  27 |             print("✅ ModelContainer initialized at: \(storeURL.path)")
  28 |             return container

  39 |     func applicationDidFinishLaunching(_ notification: Notification) {
  40 |         // 设置 shared 引用
  41 |         AppDelegate.shared = self
  42 |         // 确保应用可以显示窗口（非 accessory 模式）
  43 |         NSApp.setActivationPolicy(.regular)
  44 |         
  45 |         // 配置 HistoryManager (使用共享 Container)
  46 |         HistoryManager.shared.configure(with: Self.sharedModelContainer.mainContext)
  47 |         
  48 |         print("🚀 SpokenAnyWhere started")
  49 |         
  50 |         // 检查辅助功能权限
  51 |         checkAccessibilityPermission()
  52 |         
  53 |         // 设置菜单栏图标
  54 |         setupMenuBar()
  55 |         
  56 |         // 启动剪贴板历史服务
  57 |         ClipboardHistoryService.shared.start()
  58 |         
  59 |         // 启动录音控制器
  60 |         RecordingController.shared.start()
  61 |         
  62 |         // 执行历史记录自动清理
  63 |         performHistoryCleanup()
  64 |     }
  65 |     
  66 |     private func performHistoryCleanup() {
  67 |         let settings = AppSettings.shared
  68 |         guard settings.historyAutoCleanupEnabled else { return }
  69 |         
  70 |         Task {
  71 |             // 按天数清理
  72 |             if settings.historyKeepDays > 0 {
  73 |                 await HistoryManager.shared.performCleanup(policy: .keepDays(settings.historyKeepDays))
  74 |             }
  75 |             
  76 |             // 按条数清理
  77 |             if settings.historyMaxCount > 0 {
  78 |                 await HistoryManager.shared.performCleanup(policy: .keepCount(settings.historyMaxCount))
  79 |             }
  80 |         }
  81 |     }
  82 |

  85 |     }

 118 |         menu.addItem(hotkeyItem)
 119 |

 123 |         menu.addItem(NSMenuItem.separator())
 124 |         menu.addItem(NSMenuItem(title: "退出", action: #selector(NSApplication.terminate(_:)), keyEquivalent: "q"))
 125 |

 154 |             window.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
 155 |             NSApp.activate(ignoringOtherApps: true)

 174 |

 177 |         window.titleVisibility = .hidden
 178 |         window.backgroundColor = NSColor(red: 0.08, green: 0.08, blue: 0.08, alpha: 1.0) // #141414
```

```swift
   1 | import Foundation

   5 | 
   6 | // MARK: - Attachment Type
   7 | 
   8 | /// 通用附件类型
   9 | /// 可复用于 QuickAsk、HUD、以及未来的各种输入入口
  10 | enum Attachment: Identifiable, Equatable {
  11 |     /// 图片：原图 + 缩略图 + ID
  12 |     case image(NSImage, NSImage?, UUID)
  13 |     
  14 |     /// 截图：原图 + 缩略图 + ID
  15 |     case screenshot(NSImage, NSImage?, UUID)
  16 |     
  17 |     /// 普通文件：URL + ID
  18 |     case file(URL, UUID)
  19 |     
  20 |     /// 文本包：从 ZIP/文件夹提取的合并文本
  21 |     /// 参数：合并后的文本内容、来源描述、文件数量、ID
  22 |     case textBundle(String, String, Int, UUID)
  23 |     
  24 |     var id: UUID {
  25 |         switch self {
  26 |         case .image(_, _, let id),
  27 |              .screenshot(_, _, let id),
  28 |              .file(_, let id),
  29 |              .textBundle(_, _, _, let id):
  30 |             return id
  31 |         }
  32 |     }
  33 |     
  34 |     /// 缩略图（用于显示）
  35 |     var thumbnail: NSImage? {
  36 |         switch self {
  37 |         case .image(_, let thumb, _), .screenshot(_, let thumb, _):
  38 |             return thumb
  39 |         case .file, .textBundle:
  40 |             return nil // 这些类型在 View 层单独处理图标
  41 |         }
  42 |     }
  43 |     
  44 |     /// 原图（用于发送）
  45 |     var originalImage: NSImage? {
  46 |         switch self {
  47 |         case .image(let image, _, _), .screenshot(let image, _, _):
  48 |             return image
  49 |         default:
  50 |             return nil
  51 |         }
  52 |     }
  53 |     
  54 |     /// 文件名
  55 |     var fileName: String? {
  56 |         switch self {
  57 |         case .file(let url, _):
  58 |             return url.lastPathComponent
  59 |         case .textBundle(_, let source, _, _):
  60 |             return source
  61 |         default:
  62 |             return nil
  63 |         }
  64 |     }
  65 |     
  66 |     /// 显示标题
  67 |     var displayTitle: String {
  68 |         switch self {
  69 |         case .image:
  70 |             return "图片"
  71 |         case .screenshot:
  72 |             return "截图"
  73 |         case .file(let url, _):
  74 |             return url.lastPathComponent
  75 |         case .textBundle(_, let source, let count, _):
  76 |             return "\(source) (\(count) 文件)"
  77 |         }
  78 |     }
  79 |     
  80 |     /// 是否是视频文件
  81 |     var isVideo: Bool {
  82 |         if case .file(let url, _) = self {
  83 |             if let uti = UTType(filenameExtension: url.pathExtension) {
  84 |                 return uti.conforms(to: .movie) || uti.conforms(to: .video)
  85 |             }
  86 |         }
  87 |         return false
  88 |     }
  89 |     
  90 |     /// 是否是文本包
  91 |     var isTextBundle: Bool {
  92 |         if case .textBundle = self { return true }
  93 |         return false
  94 |     }
  95 |     
  96 |     /// 文本内容（用于发送给 LLM）
  97 |     var textContent: String? {
  98 |         switch self {
  99 |         case .textBundle(let content, _, _, _):
 100 |             return content
 101 |         default:
 102 |             return nil
 103 |         }
 104 |     }
 105 |     
 106 |     static func == (lhs: Attachment, rhs: Attachment) -> Bool {
 107 |         lhs.id == rhs.id
 108 |     }

 110 | 
 111 | // MARK: - Thumbnail Generation
 112 | 
 113 | extension Attachment {
 114 |     /// 生成缩略图（同步，建议在后台线程调用）
 115 |     static func makeThumbnail(from image: NSImage, maxSize: CGFloat = 256) -> NSImage {
 116 |         let size = image.size
 117 |         guard size.width > 0 && size.height > 0 else { return image }
 118 |         
 119 |         let scale = min(maxSize / size.width, maxSize / size.height, 1.0)
 120 |         let newSize = NSSize(width: size.width * scale, height: size.height * scale)
 121 |         
 122 |         let thumbnail = NSImage(size: newSize)
 123 |         thumbnail.lockFocus()
 124 |         image.draw(in: NSRect(origin: .zero, size: newSize),
 125 |                    from: NSRect(origin: .zero, size: size),
 126 |                    operation: .copy, fraction: 1.0)
 127 |         thumbnail.unlockFocus()
 128 |         
 129 |         return thumbnail
 130 |     }
 131 |     
 132 |     /// 从视频生成缩略图
 133 |     static func makeVideoThumbnail(from url: URL, maxSize: CGFloat = 256) -> NSImage? {
 134 |         let asset = AVAsset(url: url)
 135 |         let generator = AVAssetImageGenerator(asset: asset)
 136 |         generator.appliesPreferredTrackTransform = true
 137 |         generator.maximumSize = CGSize(width: maxSize, height: maxSize)
 138 |         
 139 |         do {
 140 |             let cgImage = try generator.copyCGImage(at: .zero, actualTime: nil)
 141 |             return NSImage(cgImage: cgImage, size: NSSize(width: cgImage.width, height: cgImage.height))
 142 |         } catch {
 143 |             print("Failed to generate video thumbnail: \(error)")
 144 |             return nil
 145 |         }
 146 |     }
 147 | }
 148 | 
 149 | // MARK: - Attachment Source
 150 | 
 151 | /// 附件来源（用于区分添加方式）
 152 | enum AttachmentSource {
 153 |     case paste          // 粘贴
 154 |     case drop           // 拖拽

 156 |     case screenshot     // 屏幕截图
```

```swift
  63 |     /// 处理拖拽项目
  64 |     /// - Parameters:
  65 |     ///   - providers: 拖拽的数据提供者
  66 |     ///   - onAdd: 添加附件的回调
  67 |     func handleDrop(providers: [NSItemProvider], onAdd: @escaping (Attachment) -> Void) {
  68 |         for provider in providers {
  69 |             logger.info("📥 Processing drop provider: \(provider.registeredTypeIdentifiers)")
  70 |             
  71 |             // 优先处理文件 URL（包括文件夹、ZIP、普通文件）
  72 |             // 注意：必须先检查 fileURL，因为图片文件同时符合 image 和 fileURL
  73 |             if provider.hasItemConformingToTypeIdentifier(UTType.fileURL.identifier) {
  74 |                 provider.loadItem(forTypeIdentifier: UTType.fileURL.identifier) { data, error in
  75 |                     if let error = error {
  76 |                         self.logger.error("❌ Failed to load file URL: \(error)")
  77 |                         return
  78 |                     }
  79 |                     
  80 |                     // 尝试多种方式解析 URL
  81 |                     var url: URL?
  82 |                     
  83 |                     if let data = data as? Data {
  84 |                         url = URL(dataRepresentation: data, relativeTo: nil)
  85 |                     } else if let urlData = data as? URL {
  86 |                         url = urlData
  87 |                     } else if let string = data as? String {
  88 |                         url = URL(fileURLWithPath: string)
  89 |                     }
  90 |                     
  91 |                     guard let fileURL = url else {
  92 |                         self.logger.warning("⚠️ Could not parse URL from drop data")
  93 |                         return
  94 |                     }
  95 |                     
  96 |                     self.logger.info("📂 Handling dropped file: \(fileURL.path)")
  97 |                     
  98 |                     Task { @MainActor in
  99 |                         await self.handleFileURL(fileURL, source: .drop, onAdd: onAdd)
 100 |                     }
 101 |                 }
 102 |                 continue
 103 |             }
 104 |             
 105 |             // 处理直接拖拽的图片（如从浏览器拖拽）
 106 |             if provider.hasItemConformingToTypeIdentifier(UTType.image.identifier) {
 107 |                 provider.loadObject(ofClass: NSImage.self) { image, error in
 108 |                     if let error = error {
 109 |                         self.logger.error("❌ Failed to load image: \(error)")
 110 |                         return
 111 |                     }
 112 |                     
 113 |                     if let image = image as? NSImage {
 114 |                         Task { @MainActor in
 115 |                             self.addImage(image, source: .drop, onAdd: onAdd)
 116 |                         }
 117 |                     }
 118 |                 }
 119 |             }
 120 |         }
 121 |     }

 125 |         // 确保是文件 URL
 126 |         let fileURL = url.isFileURL ? url : URL(fileURLWithPath: url.path)
 127 |         logger.info("🔍 Processing URL: \(fileURL.path)")
 128 |         
 129 |         var isDirectory: ObjCBool = false
 130 |         guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: fileURL.path, isDirectory: &isDirectory) else {
 131 |             logger.warning("⚠️ File not found: \(fileURL.path)")
 132 |             return
 133 |         }
 134 |         
 135 |         logger.info("📁 isDirectory: \(isDirectory.boolValue), extension: \(fileURL.pathExtension)")
 136 |         
 137 |         // 文件夹
 138 |         if isDirectory.boolValue {
 139 |             logger.info("📂 Handling as folder")
 140 |             await handleFolder(fileURL, onAdd: onAdd)
 141 |             return
 142 |         }
 143 |         
 144 |         // ZIP 文件（检查多种方式）
 145 |         let ext = fileURL.pathExtension.lowercased()
 146 |         if ext == "zip" {
 147 |             logger.info("📦 Handling as ZIP (by extension)")
 148 |             await handleZIP(fileURL, onAdd: onAdd)
 149 |             return
 150 |         }
 151 |         
 152 |         if let uti = UTType(filenameExtension: ext), uti.conforms(to: .zip) {
 153 |             logger.info("📦 Handling as ZIP (by UTType)")
 154 |             await handleZIP(fileURL, onAdd: onAdd)
 155 |             return
 156 |         }
 157 |         
 158 |         // 图片文件
 159 |         if let uti = UTType(filenameExtension: ext), uti.conforms(to: .image) {
 160 |             if let image = NSImage(contentsOf: fileURL) {
 161 |                 logger.info("🖼️ Handling as image")
 162 |                 addImage(image, source: source, onAdd: onAdd)
 163 |                 return
 164 |             }
 165 |         }
 166 |         
 167 |         // 普通文件
 168 |         logger.info("📄 Handling as regular file")
 169 |         addFile(fileURL, onAdd: onAdd)
```

```swift
   6 | // MARK: - Screen Capture Service
   7 | 
   8 | /// 屏幕截图服务
   9 | /// 提供截取当前屏幕的能力
  10 | @MainActor
  11 | final class ScreenCaptureService {
  12 |     
  13 |     // MARK: - Singleton
  14 |     
  15 |     static let shared = ScreenCaptureService()
  16 |     
  17 |     private let logger = Logger(subsystem: "com.spokeanywhere", category: "ScreenCapture")
  18 |     
  19 |     // MARK: - Init
  20 |     
  21 |     private init() {}
  22 |     
  23 |     // MARK: - Capture Current Screen
  24 |     
  25 |     /// 截取当前屏幕（鼠标所在的屏幕）
  26 |     func captureCurrentScreen() async -> NSImage? {
  27 |         // 获取鼠标所在的屏幕
  28 |         let mouseLocation = NSEvent.mouseLocation
  29 |         guard let screen = NSScreen.screens.first(where: { NSMouseInRect(mouseLocation, $0.frame, false) })
  30 |               ?? NSScreen.main else {
  31 |             logger.error("❌ No screen found")
  32 |             return nil
  33 |         }
  34 |         
  35 |         return await captureScreen(screen)
  36 |     }
  37 |     
  38 |     /// 截取指定屏幕
  39 |     func captureScreen(_ screen: NSScreen) async -> NSImage? {
  40 |         // 使用 CGWindowListCreateImage 截取屏幕
  41 |         // 这是最简单可靠的方式，不需要额外权限（在已有屏幕录制权限的情况下）
  42 |         
  43 |         let screenRect = screen.frame
  44 |         
  45 |         // 转换坐标系（NSScreen 使用左下角原点，CGWindow 使用左上角原点）
  46 |         let mainScreenHeight = NSScreen.screens.first?.frame.height ?? screenRect.height
  47 |         let cgRect = CGRect(
  48 |             x: screenRect.origin.x,
  49 |             y: mainScreenHeight - screenRect.origin.y - screenRect.height,
  50 |             width: screenRect.width,
  51 |             height: screenRect.height
  52 |         )
  53 |         
  54 |         // 截取屏幕
  55 |         guard let cgImage = CGWindowListCreateImage(
  56 |             cgRect,
  57 |             .optionOnScreenOnly,
  58 |             kCGNullWindowID,
  59 |             [.bestResolution]
  60 |         ) else {
  61 |             logger.error("❌ Failed to capture screen")
  62 |             return nil
  63 |         }
  64 |         
  65 |         let image = NSImage(cgImage: cgImage, size: screenRect.size)
  66 |         logger.info("✅ Screen captured: \(Int(screenRect.width))x\(Int(screenRect.height))")
  67 |         
  68 |         return image
  69 |     }
  70 |     
  71 |     /// 截取所有屏幕
  72 |     func captureAllScreens() async -> [NSImage] {
  73 |         var images: [NSImage] = []
  74 |         
  75 |         for screen in NSScreen.screens {
  76 |             if let image = await captureScreen(screen) {
  77 |                 images.append(image)
  78 |             }
  79 |         }
  80 |         
  81 |         return images
  82 |     }

  86 |     /// 检查屏幕录制权限
  87 |     func checkPermission() async -> Bool {
  88 |         // 尝试截取一小块区域来检查权限
  89 |         let testRect = CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 1, height: 1)
  90 |         let testImage = CGWindowListCreateImage(
  91 |             testRect,
  92 |             .optionOnScreenOnly,
  93 |             kCGNullWindowID,
  94 |             []
  95 |         )
  96 |         
  97 |         return testImage != nil
  98 |     }

 100 |     /// 请求屏幕录制权限

 102 |         // 打开系统偏好设置的屏幕录制权限页面
 103 |         if let url = URL(string: "x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.preference.security?Privacy_ScreenCapture") {
 104 |             NSWorkspace.shared.open(url)
 105 |         }
```

 137 |     /// 从文件夹提取所有文本内容（带进度回调）
 138 |     func extractFromFolder(_ folderURL: URL, onProgress: ((ExtractionProgress) -> Void)?) async -> Result<TextBundle, TextExtractionError> {
 139 |         logger.info("📂 Starting folder extraction: \(folderURL.path)")
 140 |         let startTime = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent()
 141 |         
 142 |         var isDirectory: ObjCBool = false
 143 |         guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: folderURL.path, isDirectory: &isDirectory),
 144 |               isDirectory.boolValue else {
 145 |             return .failure(.folderNotFound)
 146 |         }
 147 |         
 148 |         do {
 149 |             // 收集文件列表（快速）
 150 |             let files = try collectTextFiles(in: folderURL)
 151 |             logger.info("📝 Found \(files.count) files in \(CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent() - startTime)s")
 152 |             
 153 |             guard !files.isEmpty else {
 154 |                 return .failure(.noTextFilesFound)
 155 |             }
 156 |             
 157 |             // 并行读取文件内容（带进度）
 158 |             let content = try await mergeFilesParallel(files, basePath: folderURL, onProgress: onProgress)
 159 |             
 160 |             let elapsed = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent() - startTime
 161 |             logger.info("✅ Extraction completed in \(String(format: "%.2f", elapsed))s")
 162 |             
 163 |             return .success(TextBundle(
 164 |                 content: content,
 165 |                 fileCount: files.count,
 166 |                 sourcePath: folderURL.path,
 167 |                 files: files.map { $0.path }
 168 |             ))
 169 |         } catch {
 170 |             logger.error("❌ Folder extraction failed: \(error)")
 171 |             return .failure(.accessDenied)
 172 |         }
 173 |     }
 174 |     
 175 |     // MARK: - Extract from ZIP
 176 |     
 177 |     /// 从 ZIP 提取所有文本内容
 178 |     func extractFromZIP(_ zipURL: URL) async -> Result<TextBundle, TextExtractionError> {
 179 |         logger.info("📦 Starting ZIP extraction: \(zipURL.path)")
 180 |         
 181 |         // 创建临时目录
 182 |         let tempDir = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory
 183 |             .appendingPathComponent("TextExtraction-\(UUID().uuidString)")
 184 |         
 185 |         do {
 186 |             try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: tempDir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
 187 |             
 188 |             // 使用 unzip 命令解压
 189 |             let process = Process()
 190 |             process.executableURL = URL(fileURLWithPath: "/usr/bin/unzip")
 191 |             process.arguments = ["-q", "-o", zipURL.path, "-d", tempDir.path]
 192 |             
 193 |             let pipe = Pipe()
 194 |             process.standardError = pipe
 195 |             
 196 |             try process.run()
 197 |             process.waitUntilExit()
 198 |             
 199 |             if process.terminationStatus != 0 {
 200 |                 let errorData = pipe.fileHandleForReading.readDataToEndOfFile()
 201 |                 let errorMessage = String(data: errorData, encoding: .utf8) ?? "Unknown error"
 202 |                 try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tempDir)
 203 |                 return .failure(.zipExtractionFailed(errorMessage))
 204 |             }
 205 |             
 206 |             // 提取文本
 207 |             let result = await extractFromFolder(tempDir)
 208 |             
 209 |             // 清理临时目录
 210 |             try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tempDir)
 211 |             
 212 |             // 更新来源信息
 213 |             switch result {
 214 |             case .success(let bundle):
 215 |                 return .success(TextBundle(
 216 |                     content: bundle.content,
 217 |                     fileCount: bundle.fileCount,
 218 |                     sourcePath: zipURL.path,
 219 |                     files: bundle.files
 220 |                 ))
 221 |             case .failure(let error):
 222 |                 return .failure(error)
 223 |             }
 224 |             
 225 |         } catch {
 226 |             try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tempDir)
 227 |             logger.error("❌ ZIP extraction failed: \(error)")
 228 |             return .failure(.zipExtractionFailed(error.localizedDescription))
 229 |         }
 230 |     }
 231 |     
 232 |     // MARK: - Private Helpers
 233 |     
 234 |     /// 递归收集文本文件
 235 |     private func collectTextFiles(in directory: URL) throws -> [URL] {
 236 |         var result: [URL] = []
 237 |         
 238 |         let fm = FileManager.default
 239 |         let contents = try fm.contentsOfDirectory(
 240 |             at: directory,
 241 |             includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isRegularFileKey, .isDirectoryKey, .fileSizeKey],
 242 |             options: [.skipsHiddenFiles]
 243 |         )
 244 |         
 245 |         for url in contents {
 246 |             let fileName = url.lastPathComponent
 247 |             
 248 |             // 跳过排除的文件
 249 |             if excludedFiles.contains(fileName) {
 250 |                 continue
 251 |             }
 252 |             
 253 |             let resourceValues = try url.resourceValues(forKeys: [.isRegularFileKey, .isDirectoryKey, .fileSizeKey])
 254 |             
 255 |             // 目录：递归处理
 256 |             if resourceValues.isDirectory == true {
 257 |                 if !excludedDirs.contains(fileName) {
 258 |                     let subFiles = try collectTextFiles(in: url)
 259 |                     result.append(contentsOf: subFiles)
 260 |                 }
 261 |                 continue
 262 |             }
 263 |             
 264 |             // 文件：检查是否是文本文件
 265 |             if resourceValues.isRegularFile == true {
 266 |                 let ext = url.pathExtension.lowercased()
 267 |                 
 268 |                 // 检查扩展名
 269 |                 guard codeExtensions.contains(ext) else { continue }
 270 |                 
 271 |                 // 检查文件大小
 272 |                 if let size = resourceValues.fileSize, size > maxFileSize {
 273 |                     logger.info("⏭️ Skipping large file: \(fileName) (\(size) bytes)")
 274 |                     continue
 275 |                 }
 276 |                 
 277 |                 result.append(url)
 278 |             }
 279 |         }
 280 |         
 281 |         return result.sorted { $0.path < $1.path }
 282 |     }
 283 |     
 284 |     /// 并行读取并合并文件内容
 285 |     private func mergeFilesParallel(_ files: [URL], basePath: URL, onProgress: ((ExtractionProgress) -> Void)?) async throws -> String {
 286 |         // 目录结构（快速生成）
 287 |         var header = "# 目录结构\n```\n"
 288 |         for file in files {
 289 |             let relativePath = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: basePath.path + "/", with: "")
 290 |             header += relativePath + "\n"
 291 |         }
 292 |         header += "```\n\n# 文件内容\n\n"
 293 |         
 294 |         // 并行读取文件
 295 |         let total = files.count
 296 |         var processedCount = 0
 297 |         
 298 |         // 使用 TaskGroup 并行读取
 299 |         let fileContents: [(Int, String)] = await withTaskGroup(of: (Int, String).self) { group in
 300 |             for (index, file) in files.enumerated() {
 301 |                 group.addTask {
 302 |                     let relativePath = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: basePath.path + "/", with: "")
 303 |                     let ext = file.pathExtension.lowercased()
 304 |                     
 305 |                     do {
 306 |                         let data = try Data(contentsOf: file)
 307 |                         guard let content = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else {
 308 |                             return (index, "## \(relativePath)\n```\n(无法解码文件内容)\n```\n")
 309 |                         }
 310 |                         
 311 |                         // 快速处理：直接截断而不是分割
 312 |                         var processedContent = content
 313 |                         if content.count > self.maxFileSize {
 314 |                             processedContent = String(content.prefix(self.maxFileSize)) + "\n... (truncated)"
 315 |                         }
 316 |                         
 317 |                         // 简化行号（只在文件开头添加）
 318 |                         let lineCount = processedContent.filter { $0 == "\n" }.count + 1
 319 |                         let numbered = self.addLineNumbersFast(processedContent)
 320 |                         
 321 |                         return (index, "## \(relativePath) (\(lineCount) lines)\n```\(ext)\n\(numbered)\n```\n")
 322 |                     } catch {
 323 |                         return (index, "## \(relativePath)\n```\n(无法读取文件内容)\n```\n")
 324 |                     }
 325 |                 }
 326 |             }
 327 |             
 328 |             var results: [(Int, String)] = []
 329 |             for await result in group {
 330 |                 results.append(result)
 331 |                 processedCount += 1
 332 |                 
 333 |                 // 回调进度
 334 |                 if let onProgress = onProgress {
 335 |                     let progress = ExtractionProgress(
 336 |                         current: processedCount,
 337 |                         total: total,
 338 |                         currentFile: files[result.0].lastPathComponent
 339 |                     )
 340 |                     await MainActor.run {
 341 |                         onProgress(progress)
 342 |                     }
 343 |                 }
 344 |             }
 345 |             return results
 346 |         }
 347 |         
 348 |         // 按原始顺序排序并合并
 349 |         let sorted = fileContents.sorted { $0.0 < $1.0 }.map { $0.1 }
 350 |         return header + sorted.joined(separator: "\n")
 351 |     }
 352 |     
 353 |     /// 快速添加行号（优化版，nonisolated 可在 TaskGroup 中调用）
 354 |     private nonisolated func addLineNumbersFast(_ content: String) -> String {
 355 |         var result = ""
 356 |         result.reserveCapacity(content.count + content.count / 10) // 预分配内存
 357 |         
 358 |         var lineNumber = 1
 359 |         var lineStart = content.startIndex
 360 |         
 361 |         for i in content.indices {
 362 |             if content[i] == "\n" {
 363 |                 let line = content[lineStart..<i]
 364 |                 result += "\(lineNumber)│ \(line)\n"
 365 |                 lineNumber += 1
 366 |                 lineStart = content.index(after: i)
 367 |             }
 368 |         }
 369 |         
 370 |         // 最后一行
 371 |         if lineStart < content.endIndex {
 372 |             let line = content[lineStart...]
 373 |             result += "\(lineNumber)│ \(line)"
 374 |         }
 375 |         
 376 |         return result
 377 |     }
 378 |     
 379 |     /// 合并文件内容（保留用于向后兼容）
 380 |     private func mergeFiles(_ files: [URL], basePath: URL) throws -> String {
 381 |         var parts: [String] = []
 382 |         
 383 |         // 添加目录结构
 384 |         parts.append("# 目录结构\n")
 385 |         parts.append("```")
 386 |         for file in files {
 387 |             let relativePath = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: basePath.path + "/", with: "")
 388 |             parts.append(relativePath)
 389 |         }
 390 |         parts.append("```\n")
 391 |         
 392 |         // 添加文件内容
 393 |         parts.append("# 文件内容\n")
 394 |         
 395 |         for file in files {
 396 |             let relativePath = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: basePath.path + "/", with: "")
 397 |             let ext = file.pathExtension.lowercased()
 398 |             
 399 |             do {
 400 |                 var content = try String(contentsOf: file, encoding: .utf8)
 401 |                 
 402 |                 // 限制行数
 403 |                 let lines = content.components(separatedBy: .newlines)
 404 |                 if lines.count > maxLines {
 405 |                     content = lines.prefix(maxLines).joined(separator: "\n")
 406 |                     content += "\n\n... (truncated, \(lines.count - maxLines) more lines)"
 407 |                 }
 408 |                 
 409 |                 // 添加带行号的内容
 410 |                 let numberedContent = addLineNumbers(content)
 411 |                 
 412 |                 parts.append("## \(relativePath)\n")
 413 |                 parts.append("```\(ext)")
 414 |                 parts.append(numberedContent)
 415 |                 parts.append("```\n")
 416 |                 
 417 |             } catch {
 418 |                 logger.warning("⚠️ Failed to read file: \(relativePath)")
 419 |                 parts.append("## \(relativePath)\n")
 420 |                 parts.append("```\n(无法读取文件内容)\n```\n")
 421 |             }
 422 |         }
 423 |         
 424 |         return parts.joined(separator: "\n")
 425 |     }
 426 |     
 427 |     /// 添加行号
 428 |     private func addLineNumbers(_ content: String) -> String {
 429 |         let lines = content.components(separatedBy: .newlines)
 430 |         let lineNumberWidth = String(lines.count).count
 431 |         
 432 |         return lines.enumerated().map { index, line in
 433 |             let lineNumber = String(format: "%\(lineNumberWidth)d", index + 1)
 434 |             return "\(lineNumber)│ \(line)"
 435 |         }.joined(separator: "\n")
 436 |     }
 437 | }

```swift
 176 |                 switch result.type {

 191 |             }
 192 |         }

 263 |     private func processAudioLevel(buffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer) {
 264 |         guard let channelData = buffer.floatChannelData?[0] else { return }
 265 |         
 266 |         let frameLength = Int(buffer.frameLength)
 267 |         // 使用 RMS (均方根) 计算，更能反映听感响度
 268 |         var sumSquares: Float = 0
 269 |         
 270 |         // 降采样以提高性能 (每 4 个采样点取一个)
 271 |         let strideStep = 4
 272 |         for i in stride(from: 0, to: frameLength, by: strideStep) {
 273 |             let sample = channelData[i]
 274 |             sumSquares += sample * sample
 275 |         }
 276 |         
 277 |         let rms = sqrt(sumSquares / Float(frameLength / strideStep))
 278 |         
 279 |         // 非线性放大：
 280 |         // 1. 基础放大倍数 5.0
 281 |         // 2. 加上一个非线性分量 sqrt(rms) * 2.0 提升小音量表现
 282 |         // 3. 限制在 0.01 - 1.0 之间 (保留极小值避免完全静止)
 283 |         var level = (rms * 5.0) + (sqrt(rms) * 2.0)
 284 |         
 285 |         // 添加一点随机抖动，让波形在说话时更生动
 286 |         if level > 0.1 {
 287 |             level += Float.random(in: -0.05...0.05)
 288 |         }
 289 |         
 290 |         let finalLevel = min(max(level, 0.02), 1.0)
 291 |         
 292 |         Task { @MainActor in
 293 |             onAudioLevelUpdate?(finalLevel)
 294 |         }
 295 |     }
 296 | }

 310 |         case .engineCreationFailed:

 312 |         case .requestCreationFailed:
 313 |             return "识别请求创建失败"
 314 |         case .permissionDenied:

 316 |         }
```

```swift
   1 | import Foundation
   2 | import Security
   3 | import os
   4 | 
   5 | /// Keychain 服务
   6 | /// 用于安全存储 API Key
   7 | /// 使用内存缓存减少 Keychain 访问次数（避免开发阶段频繁授权弹窗）
   8 | final class KeychainService {
   9 |     
  10 |     private static let logger = Logger(subsystem: "com.spokeanywhere", category: "Keychain")
  11 |     
  12 |     /// 服务名称前缀
  13 |     private static let servicePrefix = "com.spokeanywhere.llm"
  14 |     
  15 |     /// 内存缓存（减少 Keychain 访问）
  16 |     private static var cache: [String: String] = [:]
  17 |     private static let cacheQueue = DispatchQueue(label: "com.spokeanywhere.keychain.cache")
  18 |     
  19 |     // MARK: - Debug Mode
  20 |     
  21 |     /// ⚠️ 测试模式：使用 UserDefaults 代替 Keychain（避免每次启动输入密码）
  22 |     /// 正式发布时请设为 false
  23 |     static var useSimpleStorage: Bool = true
  24 |     
  25 |     /// UserDefaults 存储前缀（测试模式用）
  26 |     private static let simpleStoragePrefix = "debug.apikey."
  27 |     
  28 |     // MARK: - Public API
  29 |     
  30 |     /// 保存 API Key (智能更新)
  31 |     static func save(key: String, value: String) throws {
  32 |         // 测试模式：使用 UserDefaults
  33 |         if useSimpleStorage {
  34 |             UserDefaults.standard.set(value, forKey: simpleStoragePrefix + key)
  35 |             cacheQueue.sync { cache[key] = value }
  36 |             logger.info("✅ [Debug] Saved to UserDefaults: \(key)")
  37 |             return
  38 |         }
  39 |         
  40 |         // 正式模式：使用 Keychain
  41 |         let service = "\(servicePrefix).\(key)"
  42 |         
  43 |         guard let data = value.data(using: .utf8) else {
  44 |             throw KeychainError.encodingFailed
  45 |         }
  46 |         
  47 |         // 1. 尝试更新现有项目
  48 |         let query: [String: Any] = [
  49 |             kSecClass as String: kSecClassGenericPassword,
  50 |             kSecAttrService as String: service,
  51 |             kSecAttrAccount as String: key
  52 |         ]
  53 |         
  54 |         let attributes: [String: Any] = [
  55 |             kSecValueData as String: data,
  56 |             kSecAttrAccessible as String: kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlocked
  57 |         ]
  58 |         
  59 |         var status = SecItemUpdate(query as CFDictionary, attributes as CFDictionary)
  60 |         
  61 |         // 2. 如果项目不存在 (errSecItemNotFound)，则添加新项目
  62 |         if status == errSecItemNotFound {
  63 |             let addQuery: [String: Any] = [
  64 |                 kSecClass as String: kSecClassGenericPassword,
  65 |                 kSecAttrService as String: service,
  66 |                 kSecAttrAccount as String: key,
  67 |                 kSecValueData as String: data,
  68 |                 kSecAttrAccessible as String: kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlocked
  69 |             ]
  70 |             status = SecItemAdd(addQuery as CFDictionary, nil)
  71 |         }
  72 |         
  73 |         guard status == errSecSuccess else {
  74 |             logger.error("❌ Keychain save failed: \(status)")
  75 |             throw KeychainError.saveFailed(status)
  76 |         }
  77 |         
  78 |         // 更新缓存
  79 |         cacheQueue.sync { cache[key] = value }
  80 |         
  81 |         logger.info("✅ Saved to Keychain: \(key)")
  82 |     }
  83 |     
  84 |     /// 加载 API Key（优先从缓存读取）
  85 |     static func load(key: String) -> String? {
  86 |         // 先查缓存
  87 |         if let cached = cacheQueue.sync(execute: { cache[key] }) {
  88 |             return cached
  89 |         }
  90 |         
  91 |         // 测试模式：从 UserDefaults 读取
  92 |         if useSimpleStorage {
  93 |             if let value = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: simpleStoragePrefix + key) {
  94 |                 cacheQueue.sync { cache[key] = value }
  95 |                 return value
  96 |             }
  97 |             return nil
  98 |         }
  99 |         
 100 |         // 正式模式：从 Keychain 读取
 101 |         let service = "\(servicePrefix).\(key)"
 102 |         
 103 |         let query: [String: Any] = [
 104 |             kSecClass as String: kSecClassGenericPassword,
 105 |             kSecAttrService as String: service,
 106 |             kSecAttrAccount as String: key,
 107 |             kSecReturnData as String: true,
 108 |             kSecMatchLimit as String: kSecMatchLimitOne
 109 |         ]
 110 |         
 111 |         var result: AnyObject?
 112 |         let status = SecItemCopyMatching(query as CFDictionary, &result)
 113 |         
 114 |         guard status == errSecSuccess,
 115 |               let data = result as? Data,
 116 |               let value = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) else {
 117 |             return nil
 118 |         }
 119 |         
 120 |         // 写入缓存
 121 |         cacheQueue.sync { cache[key] = value }
 122 |         
 123 |         return value
 124 |     }
 125 |     
 126 |     /// 删除 API Key
 127 |     static func delete(key: String) throws {
 128 |         // 测试模式：从 UserDefaults 删除
 129 |         if useSimpleStorage {
 130 |             UserDefaults.standard.removeObject(forKey: simpleStoragePrefix + key)
 131 |             _ = cacheQueue.sync { cache.removeValue(forKey: key) }
 132 |             logger.info("🗑️ [Debug] Deleted from UserDefaults: \(key)")
 133 |             return
 134 |         }
 135 |         
 136 |         // 正式模式：从 Keychain 删除
 137 |         let service = "\(servicePrefix).\(key)"
 138 |         
 139 |         let query: [String: Any] = [
 140 |             kSecClass as String: kSecClassGenericPassword,
 141 |             kSecAttrService as String: service,
 142 |             kSecAttrAccount as String: key
 143 |         ]
 144 |         
 145 |         let status = SecItemDelete(query as CFDictionary)
 146 |         
 147 |         guard status == errSecSuccess || status == errSecItemNotFound else {
 148 |             logger.error("❌ Keychain delete failed: \(status)")
 149 |             throw KeychainError.deleteFailed(status)
 150 |         }
 151 |         
 152 |         // 清除缓存
 153 |         _ = cacheQueue.sync { cache.removeValue(forKey: key) }
 154 |         
 155 |         logger.info("🗑️ Deleted from Keychain: \(key)")
 156 |     }
 157 |     
 158 |     /// 检查是否存在（优先查缓存）
 159 |     static func exists(key: String) -> Bool {
 160 |         // 先查缓存
 161 |         if cacheQueue.sync(execute: { cache[key] }) != nil {
 162 |             return true
 163 |         }
 164 |         return load(key: key) != nil
 165 |     }
 166 |     
 167 |     /// 清除内存缓存（调试用）
 168 |     static func clearCache() {
 169 |         cacheQueue.sync { cache.removeAll() }
 170 |     }
 171 | }
 172 | 
 173 | // MARK: - Keychain Error
 174 | 
 175 | enum KeychainError: LocalizedError {
 176 |     case encodingFailed
 177 |     case saveFailed(OSStatus)
 178 |     case deleteFailed(OSStatus)
 179 |     
 180 |     var errorDescription: String? {
 181 |         switch self {
 182 |         case .encodingFailed:
 183 |             return "数据编码失败"
 184 |         case .saveFailed(let status):
 185 |             return "Keychain 保存失败: \(status)"
 186 |         case .deleteFailed(let status):
 187 |             return "Keychain 删除失败: \(status)"
 188 |         }
 189 |     }
 190 | }
```

```swift
   4 | /// LLM 处理管线
   5 | /// 负责协调转写文本的 LLM 精炼处理
   6 | @MainActor
   7 | final class LLMPipeline {
   8 |     
   9 |     // MARK: - Singleton
  10 |     
  11 |     static let shared = LLMPipeline()
  12 |     
  13 |     private let logger = Logger(subsystem: "com.spokeanywhere", category: "LLMPipeline")
  14 |     
  15 |     // MARK: - Dependencies
  16 |     
  17 |     private let settings = LLMSettings.shared
  18 |     private let contextService = ContextService.shared
  19 |     private let clipboardHistory = ClipboardHistoryService.shared
  20 |     
  21 |     // MARK: - Properties
  22 |     
  23 |     /// 当前是否正在处理
  24 |     private(set) var isProcessing = false
  25 |     
  26 |     // MARK: - Init
  27 |     
  28 |     private init() {}
  29 |     
  30 |     // MARK: - Public API
  31 |     
  32 |     /// 检查是否需要 LLM 处理
  33 |     var shouldProcess: Bool {
  34 |         settings.isFullyConfigured
  35 |     }
  36 |     
  37 |     /// 当前 Provider 名称（用于显示）
  38 |     var currentProviderName: String {
  39 |         settings.currentProviderName
  40 |     }
  41 |     
  42 |     /// 对话（Quick Ask 专用）
  43 |     /// - Parameter message: 用户消息
  44 |     /// - Returns: AI 回答
  45 |     func chat(_ message: String) async -> Result<String, LLMError> {
  46 |         guard shouldProcess else {
  47 |             logger.info("⏭️ LLM not configured")
  48 |             return .failure(.notConfigured)
  49 |         }
  50 |         
  51 |         guard let provider = settings.createCurrentProvider() else {
  52 |             logger.error("❌ Failed to create LLM provider")
  53 |             return .failure(.notConfigured)
  54 |         }
  55 |         
  56 |         isProcessing = true
  57 |         defer { isProcessing = false }
  58 |         
  59 |         // Quick Ask 专用系统提示词
  60 |         let systemPrompt = """
  61 |         你是一个友好、专业的 AI 助手。请根据用户的问题提供清晰、准确的回答。
  62 |         
  63 |         如果用户提供了语音转写内容，请注意：
  64 |         - 语音转写可能存在错误（尤其是专业术语、人名、产品名）
  65 |         - 请根据上下文推断用户的真实意图
  66 |         - 如果不确定用户的意思，可以礼貌地询问
  67 |         
  68 |         回答要求：
  69 |         - 使用简洁明了的语言
  70 |         - 适当使用列表或分段来组织内容
  71 |         - 如果是代码相关问题，请提供代码示例
  72 |         """
  73 |         
  74 |         let prompt = LLMPrompt(
  75 |             systemPrompt: systemPrompt,
  76 |             userMessage: message,
  77 |             contextAppName: contextService.getCurrentTargetApp()?.name
  78 |         )
  79 |         
  80 |         logger.info("🤖 Quick Ask: \(message.prefix(100))...")
  81 |         
  82 |         do {
  83 |             let response = try await provider.complete(prompt: prompt)
  84 |             logger.info("✅ Quick Ask complete")
  85 |             return .success(response.text)
  86 |         } catch let error as LLMError {
  87 |             logger.error("❌ Quick Ask error: \(error.localizedDescription)")
  88 |             return .failure(error)
  89 |         } catch {
  90 |             logger.error("❌ Unexpected error: \(error.localizedDescription)")
  91 |             return .failure(.networkError(error))
  92 |         }
  93 |     }
  94 |     
  95 |     /// 精炼文本
  96 |     /// - Parameters:
  97 |     ///   - text: 原始转写文本
  98 |     ///   - customSystemPrompt: 自定义系统提示词（用于历史记录重处理）
  99 |     /// - Returns: 精炼后的文本，失败时返回错误
 100 |     func refine(_ text: String, customSystemPrompt: String? = nil) async -> Result<String, LLMError> {
 101 |         guard shouldProcess else {
 102 |             logger.info("⏭️ LLM not configured, skipping")
 103 |             return .success(text)
 104 |         }
 105 |         
 106 |         guard let provider = settings.createCurrentProvider() else {
 107 |             logger.error("❌ Failed to create LLM provider")
 108 |             return .failure(.notConfigured)
 109 |         }
 110 |         
 111 |         isProcessing = true
 112 |         defer { isProcessing = false }
 113 |         
 114 |         // 构建 Prompt（支持自定义系统提示词）
 115 |         let prompt: LLMPrompt
 116 |         if let customPrompt = customSystemPrompt {
 117 |             // 使用自定义提示词（历史记录重处理场景）
 118 |             prompt = LLMPrompt(
 119 |                 systemPrompt: customPrompt,
 120 |                 userMessage: text,
 121 |                 contextAppName: nil
 122 |             )
 123 |         } else {
 124 |             // 使用默认设置构建提示词
 125 |             prompt = buildPrompt(for: text)
 126 |         }
 127 |         
 128 |         // 调试：打印完整 Prompt
 129 |         logger.info("🤖 Starting LLM refinement...")
 130 |         print("📝 === LLM PROMPT DEBUG ===")
 131 |         print("📝 System Prompt:")
 132 |         print(prompt.systemPrompt)
 133 |         print("📝 User Message: \(prompt.userMessage)")
 134 |         print("📝 === END PROMPT ===")
 135 |         
 136 |         do {
 137 |             let response = try await provider.complete(prompt: prompt)
 138 |             logger.info("✅ LLM refinement complete")
 139 |             return .success(response.text)
 140 |         } catch let error as LLMError {
 141 |             logger.error("❌ LLM error: \(error.localizedDescription)")
 142 |             return .failure(error)
 143 |         } catch {
 144 |             logger.error("❌ Unexpected error: \(error.localizedDescription)")
 145 |             return .failure(.networkError(error))
 146 |         }
 147 |     }
 148 |     
 149 |     // MARK: - Private
 150 |     
 151 |     private func buildPrompt(for text: String) -> LLMPrompt {
 152 |         var systemPrompt = settings.systemPrompt
 153 |         
 154 |         // 添加上下文信息
 155 |         if settings.includeActiveApp {
 156 |             if let appName = contextService.getCurrentTargetApp()?.name {
 157 |                 systemPrompt += "\n\n当前应用: \(appName)"
 158 |             }
 159 |         }
 160 |         
 161 |         if settings.includeClipboard {
 162 |             // 限制为最近 10 条，减少噪音并聚焦最近上下文
 163 |             let historyContext = clipboardHistory.formatForPrompt(limit: 10)
 164 |             if !historyContext.isEmpty {
 165 |                 systemPrompt += "\n\n" + historyContext
 166 |             }
 167 |         }
 168 |         
 169 |         return LLMPrompt(
 170 |             systemPrompt: systemPrompt,
 171 |             userMessage: text,
 172 |             contextAppName: contextService.getCurrentTargetApp()?.name
 173 |         )
 174 |     }
 175 | }
```

```swift
 266 |     /// 从旧版配置迁移到 Profile 系统
 267 |     private func migrateToProfiles() {
 268 |         logger.info("🔄 Migrating legacy configs to Profile system...")
 269 |         
 270 |         for (type, config) in providerConfigs {
 271 |             let profile = ProviderProfile.migrate(from: config, type: type)
 272 |             profiles.append(profile)
 273 |             
 274 |             // 如果是之前选中的 Provider，设为当前 Profile
 275 |             if type == selectedProviderType {
 276 |                 selectedProfileId = profile.id
 277 |             }
 278 |         }
 279 |         
 280 |         logger.info("✅ Migrated \(self.profiles.count) profiles")
 281 |     }

 283 |     /// 合并遗留的 API Key 到统一存储
 284 |     private func consolidateLegacyAPIKeys() {
 285 |         let defaults = UserDefaults.standard
 286 |         
 287 |         // 1. 加载统一存储
 288 |         loadAllAPIKeys()
 289 |         
 290 |         // 2. 如果已经完成迁移，直接返回（不再尝试读取遗留 Key）
 291 |         if defaults.bool(forKey: Keys.hasConsolidatedAPIKeys) {
 292 |             logger.info("🔓 API keys already consolidated, skipping migration")
 293 |             return
 294 |         }
 295 |         
 296 |         var hasChanges = false
 297 |         
 298 |         // 3. 检查所有 Profile，尝试迁移遗留 Key
 299 |         for i in profiles.indices {
 300 |             let profile = profiles[i]
 301 |             
 302 |             // 如果缓存中没有 Key，但 Profile 有遗留引用 (且不是 "unified_storage")
 303 |             if apiKeysCache[profile.id.uuidString] == nil,
 304 |                let keyRef = profile.apiKeyRef,
 305 |                keyRef != "unified_storage" {
 306 |                 
 307 |                 logger.info("📥 Consolidating legacy key for profile: \(profile.name)")
 308 |                 
 309 |                 // 尝试从旧 Keychain Item 读取
 310 |                 if let legacyKey = KeychainService.load(key: keyRef) {
 311 |                     // 存入缓存
 312 |                     apiKeysCache[profile.id.uuidString] = legacyKey
 313 |                     
 314 |                     // 更新 Profile 标记
 315 |                     profiles[i].apiKeyRef = "unified_storage"
 316 |                     profiles[i].updatedAt = Date()
 317 |                     
 318 |                     hasChanges = true
 319 |                 }
 320 |             }
 321 |         }
 322 |         
 323 |         // 4. 保存迁移结果
 324 |         if hasChanges {
 325 |             saveAllAPIKeys()
 326 |             save() // 保存 Profile 的 apiKeyRef 更新
 327 |             logger.info("✅ Consolidated legacy API keys to unified storage")
 328 |         }
 329 |         
 330 |         // 5. 标记迁移完成（即使没有任何 Key 需要迁移，也标记为完成）
 331 |         defaults.set(true, forKey: Keys.hasConsolidatedAPIKeys)
 332 |     }

 363 |         let profile = profiles[index]
```

```swift
 101 |     func complete(prompt: LLMPrompt) async throws -> LLMResponse {
 102 |         guard isConfigured else {
 103 |             throw LLMError.notConfigured
 104 |         }
 105 |         
 106 |         let request = try buildRequest(prompt: prompt)
 107 |         
 108 |         logger.info("🤖 LLM request to \(self.providerType.displayName)")
 109 |         
 110 |         do {
 111 |             let (data, response) = try await session.data(for: request)
 112 |             
 113 |             guard let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse else {
 114 |                 throw LLMError.invalidResponse
 115 |             }
 116 |             
 117 |             // 处理错误状态码
 118 |             switch httpResponse.statusCode {
 119 |             case 200...299:
 120 |                 break
 121 |             case 401:
 122 |                 throw LLMError.invalidAPIKey
 123 |             case 429:
 124 |                 throw LLMError.rateLimited
 125 |             default:
 126 |                 let message = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8)
 127 |                 throw LLMError.serverError(httpResponse.statusCode, message)
 128 |             }
 129 |             
 130 |             return try parseResponse(data: data)
 131 |             
 132 |         } catch let error as LLMError {
 133 |             throw error
 134 |         } catch let error as URLError where error.code == .timedOut {
 135 |             throw LLMError.timeout
 136 |         } catch {
 137 |             throw LLMError.networkError(error)
 138 |         }
 139 |     }

 160 |     /// 获取可用模型列表

 162 |     func fetchModels() async -> [String] {
 163 |         let urlString = baseURL.trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet(charactersIn: "/"))
 164 |         
 165 |         // 使用 providedAPIKey（由 LLMSettings 注入）
 166 |         let apiKey = providedAPIKey
 167 |         
 168 |         // 根据 provider 类型构建 URL 和请求
 169 |         let modelsURL: URL?
 170 |         var authHeader: (String, String)?
 171 |         
 172 |         switch providerType {
 173 |         case .googleGemini:
 174 |             // Gemini: GET /models?key={apiKey}
 175 |             // 响应: { models: [{ name: "models/gemini-1.5-flash" }] }
 176 |             if let key = apiKey {
 177 |                 modelsURL = URL(string: "\(urlString)/models?key=\(key)")
 178 |             } else {
 179 |                 modelsURL = URL(string: "\(urlString)/models")
 180 |             }
 181 |             
 182 |         case .anthropic:
 183 |             // Anthropic: GET /v1/models, Header: x-api-key
 184 |             // 响应: { data: [{ id: "claude-3-opus-20240229" }] }
 185 |             modelsURL = URL(string: "\(urlString)/models")
 186 |             if let key = apiKey {
 187 |                 authHeader = ("x-api-key", key)
 188 |             }
 189 |             
 190 |         case .ollama:
 191 |             // Ollama: GET /api/tags (不是 /models)
 192 |             // 响应: { models: [{ name: "llama3:latest" }] }
 193 |             modelsURL = URL(string: "\(urlString.replacingOccurrences(of: "/v1", with: ""))/api/tags")
 194 |             
 195 |         case .openRouter:
 196 |             // OpenRouter: GET /api/v1/models, Header: Authorization Bearer
 197 |             // 响应: { data: [{ id: "openai/gpt-4" }] }
 198 |             modelsURL = URL(string: "\(urlString)/models")
 199 |             if let key = apiKey {
 200 |                 authHeader = ("Authorization", "Bearer \(key)")
 201 |             }
 202 |             
 203 |         case .groq:
 204 |             // Groq: GET /openai/v1/models, Header: Authorization Bearer
 205 |             // 响应: { data: [{ id: "llama-3.1-70b-versatile" }] }
 206 |             modelsURL = URL(string: "\(urlString)/models")
 207 |             if let key = apiKey {
 208 |                 authHeader = ("Authorization", "Bearer \(key)")
 209 |             }
 210 |             
 211 |         case .openai, .openAICompatible:
 212 |             // OpenAI 标准: GET /models, Header: Authorization Bearer
 213 |             // 响应: { data: [{ id: "gpt-4" }] }
 214 |             modelsURL = URL(string: "\(urlString)/models")
 215 |             if let key = apiKey {
 216 |                 authHeader = ("Authorization", "Bearer \(key)")
 217 |             }
 218 |         }
 219 |         
 220 |         guard let url = modelsURL else {
 221 |             logger.warning("⚠️ Invalid URL for models endpoint")
 222 |             return []
 223 |         }
 224 |         
 225 |         var request = URLRequest(url: url)
 226 |         request.httpMethod = "GET"
 227 |         request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
 228 |         request.timeoutInterval = 10
 229 |         
 230 |         // 添加认证头
 231 |         if let (headerName, headerValue) = authHeader {
 232 |             request.setValue(headerValue, forHTTPHeaderField: headerName)
 233 |         }
 234 |         
 235 |         // Anthropic 需要额外的版本头
 236 |         if providerType == .anthropic {
 237 |             request.setValue("2023-06-01", forHTTPHeaderField: "anthropic-version")
 238 |         }
 239 |         
 240 |         do {
 241 |             let (data, response) = try await session.data(for: request)
 242 |             
 243 |             guard let httpResponse = response as? HTTPURLResponse,
 244 |                   (200...299).contains(httpResponse.statusCode) else {
 245 |                 let statusCode = (response as? HTTPURLResponse)?.statusCode ?? 0
 246 |                 logger.warning("⚠️ Models endpoint returned status \(statusCode)")
 247 |                 return []
 248 |             }
 249 |             
 250 |             return parseModelsResponse(data: data)

 252 |         } catch {
```
