 258 |     /// 解析不同格式的 models 响应
 259 |     private func parseModelsResponse(data: Data) -> [String] {
 260 |         guard let json = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as? [String: Any] else {
 261 |             logger.warning("⚠️ Failed to parse models response as JSON")
 262 |             return []
 263 |         }
 264 |         
 265 |         var models: [String] = []
 266 |         
 267 |         switch providerType {
 268 |         case .googleGemini:
 269 |             // Gemini: { models: [{ name: "models/gemini-1.5-flash", ... }] }
 270 |             if let modelsArray = json["models"] as? [[String: Any]] {
 271 |                 models = modelsArray.compactMap { model -> String? in
 272 |                     guard let name = model["name"] as? String else { return nil }
 273 |                     // 过滤掉 embedding 模型，只保留生成模型
 274 |                     if name.contains("embedding") { return nil }
 275 |                     return name.replacingOccurrences(of: "models/", with: "")
 276 |                 }
 277 |             }
 278 |             
 279 |         case .ollama:
 280 |             // Ollama: { models: [{ name: "llama3:latest", ... }] }
 281 |             if let modelsArray = json["models"] as? [[String: Any]] {
 282 |                 models = modelsArray.compactMap { $0["name"] as? String }
 283 |             }
 284 |             
 285 |         case .openai, .anthropic, .groq, .openRouter, .openAICompatible:
 286 |             // OpenAI 标准格式: { data: [{ id: "gpt-4", ... }] }
 287 |             if let dataArray = json["data"] as? [[String: Any]] {
 288 |                 models = dataArray.compactMap { $0["id"] as? String }
 289 |             }
 290 |         }
 291 |         
 292 |         if models.isEmpty {
 293 |             logger.warning("⚠️ No models found in response")
 294 |         } else {
 295 |             logger.info("✅ Fetched \(models.count) models from \(self.providerType.displayName)")
 296 |         }
 297 |         
 298 |         return models.sorted()
 299 |     }

 303 |     private func buildRequest(prompt: LLMPrompt) throws -> URLRequest {
 304 |         let urlString = baseURL.trimmingCharacters(in: CharacterSet(charactersIn: "/"))
 305 |         
 306 |         // 使用 providedAPIKey（由 LLMSettings 注入）
 307 |         let apiKey = providedAPIKey
 308 |         
 309 |         if providerType == .googleGemini {
 310 |             return try buildGeminiRequest(urlString: urlString, apiKey: apiKey, prompt: prompt)
 311 |         }
 312 |         
 313 |         // OpenAI Compatible Request
 314 |         guard let url = URL(string: "\(urlString)/chat/completions") else {
 315 |             throw LLMError.invalidResponse
 316 |         }
 317 |         
 318 |         var request = URLRequest(url: url)
 319 |         request.httpMethod = "POST"
 320 |         request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
 321 |         
 322 |         // 添加 API Key
 323 |         if let key = apiKey {
 324 |             request.setValue("Bearer \(key)", forHTTPHeaderField: "Authorization")
 325 |         }
 326 |         
 327 |         // Anthropic 需要额外的版本头
 328 |         if providerType == .anthropic {
 329 |             request.setValue("2023-06-01", forHTTPHeaderField: "anthropic-version")
 330 |             request.setValue(apiKey, forHTTPHeaderField: "x-api-key")
 331 |             // Anthropic 不使用 Bearer Token
 332 |             request.setValue(nil, forHTTPHeaderField: "Authorization")
 333 |         }
 334 |         
 335 |         // 构建请求体
 336 |         var messages: [[String: String]] = []
 337 |         
 338 |         // System prompt
 339 |         if !prompt.systemPrompt.isEmpty {
 340 |             messages.append([
 341 |                 "role": "system",
 342 |                 "content": prompt.systemPrompt
 343 |             ])
 344 |         }
 345 |         
 346 |         // User message
 347 |         messages.append([
 348 |             "role": "user",
 349 |             "content": prompt.userMessage
 350 |         ])
 351 |         
 352 |         let body: [String: Any] = [
 353 |             "model": modelName,
 354 |             "messages": messages,
 355 |             "temperature": temperature,
 356 |             "max_tokens": maxTokens
 357 |         ]
 358 |         
 359 |         request.httpBody = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: body)
 360 |         
 361 |         return request
 362 |     }
 363 |     
 364 |     private func buildGeminiRequest(urlString: String, apiKey: String?, prompt: LLMPrompt) throws -> URLRequest {
 365 |         // Gemini: POST /models/{model}:generateContent?key={apiKey}
 366 |         guard let key = apiKey else { throw LLMError.invalidAPIKey }
 367 |         
 368 |         let model = modelName.isEmpty ? "gemini-pro" : modelName
 369 |         // 处理可能包含 "models/" 前缀的情况
 370 |         let cleanModelName = model.replacingOccurrences(of: "models/", with: "")
 371 |         
 372 |         guard let url = URL(string: "\(urlString)/models/\(cleanModelName):generateContent?key=\(key)") else {
 373 |             throw LLMError.invalidResponse
 374 |         }
 375 |         
 376 |         var request = URLRequest(url: url)
 377 |         request.httpMethod = "POST"
 378 |         request.setValue("application/json", forHTTPHeaderField: "Content-Type")
 379 |         
 380 |         // 构建 Gemini 请求体
 381 |         // {
 382 |         //   "contents": [{ "role": "user", "parts": [{ "text": "..." }] }],
 383 |         //   "systemInstruction": { "parts": [{ "text": "..." }] },
 384 |         //   "generationConfig": { ... }
 385 |         // }
 386 |         
 387 |         var body: [String: Any] = [
 388 |             "contents": [
 389 |                 [
 390 |                     "role": "user",
 391 |                     "parts": [
 392 |                         ["text": prompt.userMessage]
 393 |                     ]
 394 |                 ]
 395 |             ],
 396 |             "generationConfig": [
 397 |                 "temperature": temperature,
 398 |                 "maxOutputTokens": maxTokens
 399 |             ]
 400 |         ]
 401 |         
 402 |         if !prompt.systemPrompt.isEmpty {
 403 |             body["systemInstruction"] = [
 404 |                 "parts": [
 405 |                     ["text": prompt.systemPrompt]
 406 |                 ]
 407 |             ]
 408 |         }
 409 |         
 410 |         request.httpBody = try JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: body)
 411 |         return request
 412 |     }
 413 |     
 414 |     private func parseResponse(data: Data) throws -> LLMResponse {
 415 |         if providerType == .googleGemini {
 416 |             return try parseGeminiResponse(data: data)
 417 |         }
 418 |         
 419 |         // 解析 OpenAI 格式响应
 420 |         guard let json = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as? [String: Any] else {
 421 |             throw LLMError.invalidResponse
 422 |         }
 423 |         
 424 |         // 检查 Anthropic 错误格式
 425 |         if let error = json["error"] as? [String: Any], let message = error["message"] as? String {
 426 |             throw LLMError.serverError(400, message)
 427 |         }
 428 |         
 429 |         // 兼容 Anthropic 响应格式 (content 是数组)
 430 |         if let contentArray = json["content"] as? [[String: Any]],
 431 |            let firstContent = contentArray.first,
 432 |            let text = firstContent["text"] as? String {
 433 |             return LLMResponse(text: text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines), usage: nil)
 434 |         }
 435 |         
 436 |         // 标准 OpenAI 格式
 437 |         if let choices = json["choices"] as? [[String: Any]],
 438 |            let firstChoice = choices.first,
 439 |            let message = firstChoice["message"] as? [String: Any],
 440 |            let content = message["content"] as? String {
 441 |             
 442 |             let trimmedContent = content.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
 443 |             if trimmedContent.isEmpty { throw LLMError.emptyResponse }
 444 |             
 445 |             // 解析 usage
 446 |             var usage: TokenUsage?
 447 |             if let usageJson = json["usage"] as? [String: Any] {
 448 |                 usage = TokenUsage(
 449 |                     promptTokens: usageJson["prompt_tokens"] as? Int,
 450 |                     completionTokens: usageJson["completion_tokens"] as? Int,
 451 |                     totalTokens: usageJson["total_tokens"] as? Int
 452 |                 )
 453 |             }
 454 |             
 455 |             logger.info("✅ LLM response received (\(trimmedContent.count) chars)")
 456 |             return LLMResponse(text: trimmedContent, usage: usage)
 457 |         }
 458 |         
 459 |         logger.error("❌ Failed to parse response: \(String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) ?? "nil")")
 460 |         throw LLMError.invalidResponse
 461 |     }
 462 |     
 463 |     private func parseGeminiResponse(data: Data) throws -> LLMResponse {
 464 |         // Gemini: { "candidates": [{ "content": { "parts": [{ "text": "..." }] } }] }
 465 |         guard let json = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: data) as? [String: Any] else {
 466 |             throw LLMError.invalidResponse
 467 |         }
 468 |         
 469 |         // 检查错误
 470 |         if let error = json["error"] as? [String: Any], let message = error["message"] as? String {
 471 |             throw LLMError.serverError(400, message)
 472 |         }
 473 |         
 474 |         guard let candidates = json["candidates"] as? [[String: Any]],
 475 |               let firstCandidate = candidates.first,
 476 |               let content = firstCandidate["content"] as? [String: Any],
 477 |               let parts = content["parts"] as? [[String: Any]],
 478 |               let firstPart = parts.first,
 479 |               let text = firstPart["text"] as? String else {
 480 |             logger.error("❌ Failed to parse Gemini response: \(String(data: data, encoding: .utf8) ?? "nil")")
 481 |             throw LLMError.invalidResponse
 482 |         }
 483 |         
 484 |         let trimmedContent = text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
 485 |         logger.info("✅ Gemini response received (\(trimmedContent.count) chars)")
 486 |         
 487 |         return LLMResponse(text: trimmedContent, usage: nil)
 488 |     }
 489 | }

  47 |         content: String,
  48 |         metadata: [String: String] = [:]
  49 |     ) {
  50 |         self.id = id
  51 |         self.timestamp = timestamp
  52 |         self.stage = stage
  53 |         self.content = content
  54 |         self.metadata = metadata
  55 |     }
  56 |

  59 |         formatter.dateFormat = "HH:mm:ss"
  60 |         return formatter.string(from: timestamp)
  61 |     }
  62 | }

  67 | @MainActor
  68 | final class MessagePanelState: ObservableObject {
  69 |     
  70 |     // MARK: - Published Properties
  71 |     
  72 |     /// 面板是否可见
  73 |     @Published var isVisible: Bool = false
  74 |     
  75 |     /// 所有消息卡片
  76 |     @Published var cards: [MessageCard] = []
  77 |     
  78 |     /// 面板滑动偏移量（用于动画）
  79 |     @Published var slideOffset: CGFloat = -400
  80 |     
  81 |     // MARK: - Constants
  82 |     
  83 |     /// 面板宽度
  84 |     static let panelWidth: CGFloat = 360
  85 |     
  86 |     /// 最大保存的卡片数量
  87 |     private let maxCards: Int = 500
  88 |     
  89 |     // MARK: - Public API
  90 |     
  91 |     /// 添加新卡片
  92 |     func addCard(_ card: MessageCard) {
  93 |         withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.8)) {
  94 |             cards.append(card)  // 新卡片在底部（时间线顺序）
  95 |         }
  96 |         
  97 |         // 限制数量（移除最旧的）
  98 |         if cards.count > maxCards {
  99 |             cards = Array(cards.suffix(maxCards))
 100 |         }
 101 |     }
 102 |     
 103 |     /// 添加 Welcome 消息
 104 |     func addWelcome(_ message: String) {
 105 |         addCard(MessageCard(stage: .welcome(message), content: message))
 106 |     }
 107 |     
 108 |     /// 添加 ASR 结果
 109 |     func addASRResult(model: String, content: String, duration: TimeInterval? = nil) {
 110 |         var metadata: [String: String] = [:]
 111 |         if let duration = duration {
 112 |             metadata["duration"] = String(format: "%.2fs", duration)
 113 |         }
 114 |         addCard(MessageCard(stage: .asr(model: model), content: content, metadata: metadata))
 115 |     }
 116 |     
 117 |     /// 添加 LLM 结果
 118 |     func addLLMResult(model: String, content: String, processingTime: TimeInterval? = nil) {
 119 |         var metadata: [String: String] = [:]
 120 |         if let time = processingTime {
 121 |             metadata["processing"] = String(format: "%.2fs", time)
 122 |         }
 123 |         addCard(MessageCard(stage: .llm(model: model), content: content, metadata: metadata))
 124 |     }
 125 |     
 126 |     /// 添加系统消息
 127 |     func addSystemMessage(_ message: String) {
 128 |         addCard(MessageCard(stage: .system(message), content: message))
 129 |     }
 130 |     
 131 |     /// 清空所有卡片
 132 |     func clearAll() {
 133 |         withAnimation {
 134 |             cards.removeAll()
 135 |         }
 136 |     }
 137 |     
 138 |     /// 显示面板
 139 |     func show() {
 140 |         isVisible = true
 141 |         withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.4, dampingFraction: 0.85)) {
 142 |             slideOffset = 0
 143 |         }
 144 |     }
 145 |     
 146 |     /// 隐藏面板
 147 |     func hide() {
 148 |         withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.3, dampingFraction: 0.9)) {
 149 |             slideOffset = -MessagePanelState.panelWidth - 20
 150 |         }
 151 |         
 152 |         // 动画结束后设置不可见
 153 |         DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.35) { [weak self] in
 154 |             self?.isVisible = false
 155 |         }
 156 |     }
 157 |     
 158 |     /// 切换面板显示/隐藏
 159 |     func toggle() {
 160 |         if isVisible {
 161 |             hide()
 162 |         } else {
 163 |             show()
 164 |         }
 165 |     }
 166 | }

 156 |

   1 | import AVFoundation

   5 | /// SFSpeechRecognizer 实现
   6 | /// 适用于 macOS 15+ / iOS 10+
   7 | /// 回退方案，当 SpeechAnalyzer 不可用时使用
   8 | @MainActor
   9 | final class SFSpeechProvider: TranscriptionProvider {
  10 |     
  11 |     // MARK: - Constants
  12 |     
  13 |     private static let cancelledErrorCode = 216
  14 |     
  15 |     // MARK: - Properties
  16 |     
  17 |     let identifier = "sf_speech_recognizer"
  18 |     let displayName = "Apple Dictation"
  19 |     
  20 |     let capabilities: TranscriptionCapability = [.realtime, .punctuation]
  21 |     
  22 |     var locale: Locale {
  23 |         didSet {
  24 |             speechRecognizer = SFSpeechRecognizer(locale: locale)
  25 |         }
  26 |     }
  27 |     
  28 |     var isAvailable: Bool {
  29 |         speechRecognizer?.isAvailable ?? false
  30 |     }
  31 |     
  32 |     var supportedLocales: [Locale] {
  33 |         SFSpeechRecognizer.supportedLocales().map { Locale(identifier: $0.identifier) }
  34 |     }
  35 |     
  36 |     var onResult: ((TranscriptionResult) -> Void)?
  37 |     var onError: ((Error) -> Void)?
  38 |     
  39 |     // MARK: - Private
  40 |     
  41 |     private let logger = Logger(subsystem: "com.spokeanywhere", category: "SFSpeechProvider")
  42 |     private var speechRecognizer: SFSpeechRecognizer?
  43 |     private var recognitionRequest: SFSpeechAudioBufferRecognitionRequest?
  44 |     private var recognitionTask: SFSpeechRecognitionTask?
  45 |     
  46 |     // MARK: - Init
  47 |     
  48 |     init(locale: Locale = Locale(identifier: "zh-CN")) {
  49 |         self.locale = locale
  50 |         self.speechRecognizer = SFSpeechRecognizer(locale: locale)
  51 |     }
  52 |     
  53 |     // MARK: - TranscriptionProvider
  54 |     
  55 |     func requestAuthorization() async -> Bool {
  56 |         await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in
  57 |             SFSpeechRecognizer.requestAuthorization { status in
  58 |                 continuation.resume(returning: status == .authorized)
  59 |             }
  60 |         }
  61 |     }
  62 |     
  63 |     func prepare() async throws {
  64 |         guard let recognizer = speechRecognizer, recognizer.isAvailable else {
  65 |             throw TranscriptionError.notAvailable
  66 |         }
  67 |         
  68 |         // 创建识别请求
  69 |         recognitionRequest = SFSpeechAudioBufferRecognitionRequest()
  70 |         guard let request = recognitionRequest else {
  71 |             throw TranscriptionError.engineNotReady
  72 |         }
  73 |         
  74 |         request.shouldReportPartialResults = true
  75 |         request.addsPunctuation = true
  76 |         request.taskHint = .dictation
  77 |         
  78 |         // 启动识别任务
  79 |         recognitionTask = recognizer.recognitionTask(with: request) { [weak self] result, error in
  80 |             Task { @MainActor in
  81 |                 self?.handleRecognitionResult(result: result, error: error)
  82 |             }
  83 |         }
  84 |         
  85 |         logger.info("✅ SFSpeechProvider prepared")
  86 |     }
  87 |     
  88 |     func process(buffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer) throws {
  89 |         guard let request = recognitionRequest else {
  90 |             throw TranscriptionError.engineNotReady
  91 |         }
  92 |         request.append(buffer)
  93 |     }
  94 |     
  95 |     func finishProcessing() async throws {
  96 |         recognitionRequest?.endAudio()
  97 |         
  98 |         // 等待最终结果
  99 |         var waitTime = 0
 100 |         let maxWait = 2000
 101 |         let interval = 100
 102 |         
 103 |         while waitTime < maxWait && recognitionTask != nil {
 104 |             try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(interval))
 105 |             waitTime += interval
 106 |         }
 107 |         
 108 |         logger.info("✅ SFSpeechProvider finished processing")
 109 |     }
 110 |     
 111 |     func cancel() {
 112 |         recognitionTask?.cancel()
 113 |         recognitionRequest?.endAudio()
 114 |         cleanup()
 115 |         logger.info("🚫 SFSpeechProvider cancelled")
 116 |     }
 117 |     
 118 |     func reset() {
 119 |         cleanup()
 120 |         logger.info("🔄 SFSpeechProvider reset")
 121 |     }
 122 |     
 123 |     // MARK: - Private
 124 |     
 125 |     private func handleRecognitionResult(result: SFSpeechRecognitionResult?, error: Error?) {
 126 |         if let result = result {
 127 |             let text = result.bestTranscription.formattedString
 128 |             let resultType: TranscriptionResultType = result.isFinal ? .final : .partial
 129 |             let confidence = result.bestTranscription.segments.last?.confidence
 130 |             
 131 |             onResult?(TranscriptionResult(
 132 |                 text: text,
 133 |                 type: resultType,
 134 |                 confidence: confidence
 135 |             ))
 136 |             
 137 |             if result.isFinal {
 138 |                 recognitionTask = nil
 139 |             }
 140 |         }
 141 |         
 142 |         if let error = error {
 143 |             let nsError = error as NSError
 144 |             // 忽略用户取消错误
 145 |             if nsError.code != Self.cancelledErrorCode {
 146 |                 onError?(error)
 147 |             }
 148 |             recognitionTask = nil
 149 |         }
 150 |     }
 151 |     
 152 |     private func cleanup() {
 153 |         recognitionRequest = nil
 154 |         recognitionTask = nil
 155 |     }
 156 | }
 157 | 
 158 | // MARK: - Provider Info
 159 | 
 160 | extension SFSpeechProvider {
 161 |     static var info: TranscriptionProviderInfo {
 162 |         TranscriptionProviderInfo(
 163 |             identifier: "sf_speech_recognizer",
 164 |             displayName: "Apple Dictation",
 165 |             description: "系统内置语音识别，需要网络，适用于 macOS 15+",
 166 |             capabilities: [.realtime, .punctuation],
 167 |             minOSVersion: "macOS 15.0",
 168 |             isAvailable: SFSpeechRecognizer()?.isAvailable ?? false
 169 |         )
 170 |     }
 171 | }

  74 |     
  75 |     func requestAuthorization() async -> Bool {
  76 |         // SpeechAnalyzer 使用设备端处理，主要需要麦克风权限
  77 |         let speechStatus = await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in
  78 |             SFSpeechRecognizer.requestAuthorization { status in
  79 |                 continuation.resume(returning: status == .authorized)
  80 |             }
  81 |         }
  82 |         return speechStatus
  83 |     }
  84 |     
  85 |     func prepare() async throws {
  86 |         try await setupSpeechAnalyzer()
  87 |         logger.info("✅ SpeechAnalyzerProvider prepared")
  88 |     }
  89 |     
  90 |     func process(buffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer) throws {
  91 |         guard let continuation = inputContinuation else {
  92 |             throw TranscriptionError.engineNotReady
  93 |         }
  94 |         
  95 |         // 转换音频格式（如果需要）
  96 |         let convertedBuffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer
  97 |         if let targetFormat = targetAudioFormat, buffer.format != targetFormat {
  98 |             convertedBuffer = try convertBuffer(buffer, to: targetFormat)
  99 |         } else {
 100 |             convertedBuffer = buffer
 101 |         }
 102 |         
 103 |         // 创建 AnalyzerInput 并发送
 104 |         let input = AnalyzerInput(buffer: convertedBuffer)
 105 |         continuation.yield(input)
 106 |     }
 107 |     
 108 |     /// 转换音频缓冲区格式
 109 |     private func convertBuffer(_ buffer: AVAudioPCMBuffer, to format: AVAudioFormat) throws -> AVAudioPCMBuffer {
 110 |         // 创建或复用转换器
 111 |         if audioConverter == nil || audioConverter?.inputFormat != buffer.format || audioConverter?.outputFormat != format {
 112 |             guard let converter = AVAudioConverter(from: buffer.format, to: format) else {
 113 |                 throw TranscriptionError.processingFailed("Cannot create audio converter")
 114 |             }
 115 |             audioConverter = converter
 116 |         }
 117 |         
 118 |         guard let converter = audioConverter else {
 119 |             throw TranscriptionError.processingFailed("Audio converter not available")
 120 |         }
 121 |         
 122 |         // 计算输出帧数
 123 |         let ratio = format.sampleRate / buffer.format.sampleRate
 124 |         let outputFrameCount = AVAudioFrameCount(Double(buffer.frameLength) * ratio)
 125 |         
 126 |         guard let outputBuffer = AVAudioPCMBuffer(pcmFormat: format, frameCapacity: outputFrameCount) else {
 127 |             throw TranscriptionError.processingFailed("Cannot create output buffer")
 128 |         }
 129 |         
 130 |         var error: NSError?
 131 |         let inputBlock: AVAudioConverterInputBlock = { _, outStatus in
 132 |             outStatus.pointee = .haveData
 133 |             return buffer
 134 |         }
 135 |         
 136 |         converter.convert(to: outputBuffer, error: &error, withInputFrom: inputBlock)
 137 |         
 138 |         if let error = error {
 139 |             throw TranscriptionError.processingFailed("Conversion failed: \(error.localizedDescription)")
 140 |         }
 141 |         
 142 |         return outputBuffer
 143 |     }
 144 |     
 145 |     func finishProcessing() async throws {
 146 |         // 结束输入流
 147 |         inputContinuation?.finish()
 148 |         
 149 |         // 等待分析完成
 150 |         if let analyzer = analyzer {
 151 |             try await analyzer.finalizeAndFinishThroughEndOfInput()
 152 |         }
 153 |         
 154 |         // 等待结果处理完成
 155 |         await resultsTask?.value
 156 |         
 157 |         logger.info("✅ SpeechAnalyzerProvider finished processing")
 158 |     }
 159 |     
 160 |     func cancel() {
 161 |         inputContinuation?.finish()
 162 |         resultsTask?.cancel()
 163 |         analyzeTask?.cancel()
 164 |         
 165 |         Task {
 166 |             await analyzer?.cancelAndFinishNow()
 167 |         }
 168 |         
 169 |         cleanup()
 170 |         logger.info("🚫 SpeechAnalyzerProvider cancelled")
 171 |     }
 172 |     
 173 |     func reset() {
 174 |         cleanup()
 175 |         finalizedText = ""
 176 |         volatileText = ""
 177 |         needsRecreate = true
 178 |         logger.info("🔄 SpeechAnalyzerProvider reset")
 179 |     }
 180 |     
 181 |     // MARK: - Private - SpeechAnalyzer Setup
 182 |     
 183 |     private func setupSpeechAnalyzer() async throws {
 184 |         // Step 1: 获取支持的 locale
 185 |         guard let supportedLocale = await SpeechTranscriber.supportedLocale(equivalentTo: locale) else {
 186 |             logger.error("❌ Locale not supported: \(self.locale.identifier)")
 187 |             throw TranscriptionError.unsupportedLocale(locale)
 188 |         }
 189 |         
 190 |         // Step 2: 创建 SpeechTranscriber
 191 |         // 使用 progressiveTranscription 预设支持实时转录
 192 |         let transcriber = SpeechTranscriber(
 193 |             locale: supportedLocale,
 194 |             preset: .progressiveTranscription
 195 |         )
 196 |         self.transcriber = transcriber
 197 |         
 198 |         // Step 3: 检查并安装所需资产
 199 |         try await ensureAssetsInstalled(for: transcriber)
 200 |         
 201 |         // Step 4: 获取最佳音频格式
 202 |         guard let format = await SpeechAnalyzer.bestAvailableAudioFormat(compatibleWith: [transcriber]) else {
 203 |             logger.error("❌ No compatible audio format available")
 204 |             throw TranscriptionError.processingFailed("No compatible audio format")
 205 |         }
 206 |         self.targetAudioFormat = format
 207 |         logger.info("📢 Using audio format: \(format)")
 208 |         
 209 |         // Step 5: 创建输入流
 210 |         let (inputSequence, inputBuilder) = AsyncStream.makeStream(of: AnalyzerInput.self)
 211 |         self.inputContinuation = inputBuilder
 212 |         
 213 |         // Step 6: 创建 SpeechAnalyzer
 214 |         let analyzer = SpeechAnalyzer(modules: [transcriber])
 215 |         self.analyzer = analyzer
 216 |         
 217 |         // Step 7: 预热分析器
 218 |         try await analyzer.prepareToAnalyze(in: format)
 219 |         
 220 |         // Step 8: 启动结果监听
 221 |         resultsTask = Task { [weak self] in
 222 |             await self?.listenForResults(transcriber: transcriber)
 223 |         }
 224 |         
 225 |         // Step 9: 启动分析（自主模式）
 226 |         analyzeTask = Task { [weak self] in
 227 |             do {
 228 |                 try await analyzer.start(inputSequence: inputSequence)
 229 |             } catch {
 230 |                 await MainActor.run {
 231 |                     self?.onError?(error)
 232 |                 }
 233 |             }
 234 |         }
 235 |         
 236 |         logger.info("✅ SpeechAnalyzer setup complete for locale: \(supportedLocale.identifier)")
 237 |     }
 238 |     
 239 |     private func ensureAssetsInstalled(for transcriber: SpeechTranscriber) async throws {
 240 |         // 检查是否需要下载资产
 241 |         if let installationRequest = try await AssetInventory.assetInstallationRequest(supporting: [transcriber]) {
 242 |             logger.info("📥 Downloading speech assets...")
 243 |             
 244 |             // 下载并安装
 245 |             try await installationRequest.downloadAndInstall()
 246 |             
 247 |             logger.info("✅ Speech assets installed")
 248 |         } else {
 249 |             logger.info("✅ Speech assets already installed")
 250 |         }
 251 |     }
 252 |     
 253 |     private func listenForResults(transcriber: SpeechTranscriber) async {
 254 |         do {
 255 |             for try await result in transcriber.results {
 256 |                 await handleResult(result)
 257 |             }
 258 |         } catch {
 259 |             await MainActor.run { [weak self] in
 260 |                 self?.logger.error("❌ Results error: \(error.localizedDescription)")
 261 |                 self?.onError?(error)
 262 |             }
 263 |         }
 264 |     }
 265 |     
 266 |     private func handleResult(_ result: SpeechTranscriber.Result) async {
 267 |         // 从 AttributedString 提取纯文本
 268 |         let segmentText = String(result.text.characters)
 269 |         let isFinal = result.isFinal
 270 |         
 271 |         await MainActor.run { [weak self] in
 272 |             guard let self = self else { return }
 273 |             
 274 |             if isFinal {
 275 |                 // Final 结果：累积到 finalizedText
 276 |                 self.finalizedText += segmentText
 277 |                 self.volatileText = ""  // 清空 volatile
 278 |                 
 279 |                 self.logger.info("📝 Finalized segment: \(segmentText)")
 280 |                 self.logger.info("📝 Total: \(self.finalizedText)")
 281 |             } else {
 282 |                 // Volatile 结果：更新预览
 283 |                 self.volatileText = segmentText
 284 |                 
 285 |                 self.logger.debug("📝 Volatile: \(segmentText)")
 286 |             }
 287 |             
 288 |             // 使用新的构造器，分离 finalized 和 volatile
 289 |             let transcriptionResult = TranscriptionResult(
 290 |                 finalizedText: self.finalizedText,
 291 |                 volatileText: self.volatileText,
 292 |                 type: .partial  // 录音未结束，始终是 partial
 293 |             )
 294 |             self.onResult?(transcriptionResult)
 295 |         }
 296 |     }
 297 |     
 298 |     private func cleanup() {
 299 |         inputContinuation = nil
 300 |         resultsTask = nil
 301 |         analyzeTask = nil
 302 |         analyzer = nil
 303 |         transcriber = nil
 304 |         targetAudioFormat = nil
 305 |         audioConverter = nil
 306 |     }
 307 | }
 308 |

 312 | extension SpeechAnalyzerProvider {
 313 |     static var info: TranscriptionProviderInfo {
 314 |         TranscriptionProviderInfo(
 315 |             identifier: "speech_analyzer",
 316 |             displayName: "Apple 语音分析器",
 317 |             description: "新一代设备端语音识别，更快更准确，完全离线，适用于 macOS 26+",
 318 |             capabilities: [.realtime, .offline, .longForm, .punctuation, .multilingual],
 319 |             minOSVersion: "macOS 26.0",

 333 |         return false

  52 |     // MARK: - Init
  53 |     
  54 |     private init() {}
  55 |     
  56 |     // MARK: - Public API
  57 |     
  58 |     /// 获取所有可用的引擎信息
  59 |     func availableEngines() -> [TranscriptionProviderInfo] {
  60 |         var engines: [TranscriptionProviderInfo] = []

  64 |             engines.append(SpeechAnalyzerProvider.info)

  66 |         
  67 |         // SFSpeechRecognizer (始终可用)

  70 |         // TODO: Whisper Local

  72 |         return engines
  73 |     }
  74 |     
  75 |     /// 获取当前最佳引擎类型
  76 |     func bestAvailableEngine() -> TranscriptionEngineType {
  77 |         if let forced = forceEngineType {
  78 |             return forced
  79 |         }
  80 |         
  81 |         // 优先使用 SpeechAnalyzer (macOS 26+)
  82 |         if #available(macOS 26.0, *) {
  83 |             return .speechAnalyzer
  84 |         }
  85 |         
  86 |         // 回退到 SFSpeechRecognizer
  87 |         return .sfSpeech
  88 |     }
  89 |     
  90 |     /// 创建指定类型的引擎
  91 |     func createProvider(type: TranscriptionEngineType) -> TranscriptionProvider? {
  92 |         switch type {

  94 |             if #available(macOS 26.0, *) {
  95 |                 return SpeechAnalyzerProvider(locale: preferredLocale)
  96 |             }
  97 |             return nil
  98 |             
  99 |         case .sfSpeech:
 100 |             return SFSpeechProvider(locale: preferredLocale)
 101 |             
 102 |         case .whisperLocal:
 103 |             // TODO: 实现 Whisper 本地引擎
 104 |             logger.warning("⚠️ Whisper Local not implemented yet")
 105 |             return nil
 106 |         }
 107 |     }
 108 |     
 109 |     /// 自动选择并创建最佳引擎
 110 |     func createBestProvider() -> TranscriptionProvider {
 111 |         let engineType = bestAvailableEngine()
 112 |         
 113 |         if let provider = createProvider(type: engineType) {
 114 |             currentProvider = provider
 115 |             currentEngineType = engineType
 116 |             logger.info("✅ Using engine: \(engineType.displayName)")
 117 |             return provider
 118 |         }
 119 |         
 120 |         // 强制回退到 SFSpeech
 121 |         let fallback = SFSpeechProvider(locale: preferredLocale)
 122 |         currentProvider = fallback
 123 |         currentEngineType = .sfSpeech
 124 |         logger.warning("⚠️ Fallback to SFSpeech")
 125 |         return fallback

 132 |             AVCaptureDevice.requestAccess(for: .audio) { granted in
 133 |                 continuation.resume(returning: granted)
 134 |             }
 135 |         }
 136 |         
 137 |         guard micGranted else {

 141 |         
 142 |         // 语音识别权限 (通过 provider 请求)
 143 |         let provider = createBestProvider()
 144 |         let speechGranted = await provider.requestAuthorization()
 145 |         
 146 |         guard speechGranted else {

 149 |         }

   8 |     /// 将 keyCode 和 modifiers 格式化为可读字符串
   9 |     static func format(keyCode: Int, modifiers: Int) -> String {
  10 |         var parts: [String] = []
  11 |         let flags = NSEvent.ModifierFlags(rawValue: UInt(modifiers))
  12 |         
  13 |         if flags.contains(.control) { parts.append("⌃") }
  14 |         if flags.contains(.option) { parts.append("⌥") }
  15 |         if flags.contains(.shift) { parts.append("⇧") }
  16 |         if flags.contains(.command) { parts.append("⌘") }
  17 |         
  18 |         if let keyName = keyCodeToString(keyCode) {
  19 |             parts.append(keyName)
  20 |         }
  21 |         
  22 |         return parts.joined(separator: " + ")
  23 |     }
  24 |     
  25 |     /// keyCode 转换为可读字符
  26 |     static func keyCodeToString(_ keyCode: Int) -> String? {
  27 |         let keyCodeMap: [Int: String] = [
  28 |             kVK_ANSI_A: "A", kVK_ANSI_B: "B", kVK_ANSI_C: "C", kVK_ANSI_D: "D",
  29 |             kVK_ANSI_E: "E", kVK_ANSI_F: "F", kVK_ANSI_G: "G", kVK_ANSI_H: "H",
  30 |             kVK_ANSI_I: "I", kVK_ANSI_J: "J", kVK_ANSI_K: "K", kVK_ANSI_L: "L",
  31 |             kVK_ANSI_M: "M", kVK_ANSI_N: "N", kVK_ANSI_O: "O", kVK_ANSI_P: "P",
  32 |             kVK_ANSI_Q: "Q", kVK_ANSI_R: "R", kVK_ANSI_S: "S", kVK_ANSI_T: "T",
  33 |             kVK_ANSI_U: "U", kVK_ANSI_V: "V", kVK_ANSI_W: "W", kVK_ANSI_X: "X",
  34 |             kVK_ANSI_Y: "Y", kVK_ANSI_Z: "Z",
  35 |             kVK_ANSI_0: "0", kVK_ANSI_1: "1", kVK_ANSI_2: "2", kVK_ANSI_3: "3",
  36 |             kVK_ANSI_4: "4", kVK_ANSI_5: "5", kVK_ANSI_6: "6", kVK_ANSI_7: "7",
  37 |             kVK_ANSI_8: "8", kVK_ANSI_9: "9",
  38 |             kVK_Space: "Space", kVK_Return: "↩", kVK_Tab: "⇥", kVK_Delete: "⌫",
  39 |             kVK_Escape: "⎋", kVK_F1: "F1", kVK_F2: "F2", kVK_F3: "F3", kVK_F4: "F4",
  40 |             kVK_F5: "F5", kVK_F6: "F6", kVK_F7: "F7", kVK_F8: "F8", kVK_F9: "F9",
  41 |             kVK_F10: "F10", kVK_F11: "F11", kVK_F12: "F12",
  42 |             kVK_LeftArrow: "←", kVK_RightArrow: "→", kVK_UpArrow: "↑", kVK_DownArrow: "↓",
  43 |             kVK_ANSI_Minus: "-", kVK_ANSI_Equal: "=",
  44 |             kVK_ANSI_LeftBracket: "[", kVK_ANSI_RightBracket: "]",
  45 |             kVK_ANSI_Semicolon: ";", kVK_ANSI_Quote: "'",
  46 |             kVK_ANSI_Comma: ",", kVK_ANSI_Period: ".", kVK_ANSI_Slash: "/",
  47 |             kVK_ANSI_Backslash: "\\", kVK_ANSI_Grave: "`"
  48 |         ]
  49 |         return keyCodeMap[keyCode]
  50 |     }
  51 | }

   5 | @MainActor
   6 | class AudioDeviceManager: ObservableObject {
   7 |     @Published var devices: [AudioDevice] = []
   8 |     @Published var currentInputDeviceId: String? {
   9 |         didSet {
  10 |             if let id = currentInputDeviceId {
  11 |                 UserDefaults.standard.set(id, forKey: "SelectedMicrophoneId")
  12 |             }
  13 |         }
  14 |     }
  15 |     
  16 |     struct AudioDevice: Identifiable, Hashable {
  17 |         let id: String
  18 |         let name: String
  19 |     }
  20 |     
  21 |     init() {
  22 |         self.currentInputDeviceId = UserDefaults.standard.string(forKey: "SelectedMicrophoneId")
  23 |         refreshDevices()
  24 |         
  25 |         // 监听设备变化
  26 |         // 在实际应用中，应该监听 CoreAudio 的属性变化，这里简化为每次出现 Settings 时刷新
  27 |     }
  28 |     
  29 |     func refreshDevices() {
  30 |         var newDevices: [AudioDevice] = []
  31 |         
  32 |         let discoverySession = AVCaptureDevice.DiscoverySession(
  33 |             deviceTypes: [.microphone, .external],
  34 |             mediaType: .audio,
  35 |             position: .unspecified
  36 |         )
  37 |         
  38 |         for device in discoverySession.devices {
  39 |             newDevices.append(AudioDevice(id: device.uniqueID, name: device.localizedName))
  40 |         }
  41 |         
  42 |         self.devices = newDevices
  43 |         
  44 |         // 如果没有选中的设备，或者选中的设备不存在了，选择第一个
  45 |         if currentInputDeviceId == nil || !newDevices.contains(where: { $0.id == currentInputDeviceId }) {
  46 |             currentInputDeviceId = newDevices.first?.id
  47 |         }
  48 |     }
  49 | }

   1 | import AVFoundation
   2 | import Combine
   3 | import os
   4 | 
   5 | /// 音频播放服务
   6 | /// 负责历史记录中音频的播放、暂停、进度控制
   7 | @MainActor
   8 | final class AudioPlayerService: NSObject, ObservableObject {
   9 |     
  10 |     // MARK: - Singleton
  11 |     
  12 |     static let shared = AudioPlayerService()
  13 |     
  14 |     private let logger = Logger(subsystem: "com.spokeanywhere", category: "AudioPlayer")
  15 |     
  16 |     // MARK: - Published Properties
  17 |     
  18 |     @Published private(set) var isPlaying: Bool = false
  19 |     @Published private(set) var progress: Double = 0  // 0.0 ~ 1.0
  20 |     @Published private(set) var duration: TimeInterval = 0
  21 |     @Published private(set) var currentTime: TimeInterval = 0
  22 |     @Published private(set) var currentURL: URL?
  23 |     
  24 |     // MARK: - Private Properties
  25 |     
  26 |     private var player: AVAudioPlayer?
  27 |     private var progressTimer: Timer?
  28 |     
  29 |     // MARK: - Init
  30 |     
  31 |     private override init() {
  32 |         super.init()
  33 |     }
  34 |     
  35 |     // MARK: - Public API
  36 |     
  37 |     /// 播放音频
  38 |     /// - Parameter url: 音频文件 URL
  39 |     func play(_ url: URL) throws {
  40 |         // 如果正在播放其他音频，先停止
  41 |         if isPlaying {
  42 |             stop()
  43 |         }
  44 |         
  45 |         // 创建播放器
  46 |         player = try AVAudioPlayer(contentsOf: url)
  47 |         player?.delegate = self
  48 |         
  49 |         guard let player = player else {
  50 |             throw AudioPlayerError.playerCreationFailed
  51 |         }
  52 |         
  53 |         // 更新状态
  54 |         currentURL = url
  55 |         duration = player.duration
  56 |         currentTime = 0
  57 |         progress = 0
  58 |         
  59 |         // 开始播放
  60 |         player.play()
  61 |         isPlaying = true
  62 |         startProgressTimer()
  63 |         
  64 |         logger.info("▶️ Playing: \(url.lastPathComponent)")
  65 |     }
  66 |     
  67 |     /// 暂停播放
  68 |     func pause() {
  69 |         player?.pause()
  70 |         isPlaying = false
  71 |         stopProgressTimer()
  72 |         logger.info("⏸️ Paused")
  73 |     }
  74 |     
  75 |     /// 继续播放
  76 |     func resume() {
  77 |         player?.play()
  78 |         isPlaying = true
  79 |         startProgressTimer()
  80 |         logger.info("▶️ Resumed")
  81 |     }
  82 |     
  83 |     /// 停止播放
  84 |     func stop() {
  85 |         player?.stop()
  86 |         player = nil
  87 |         isPlaying = false
  88 |         currentURL = nil
  89 |         currentTime = 0
  90 |         progress = 0
  91 |         duration = 0
  92 |         stopProgressTimer()
  93 |         logger.info("⏹️ Stopped")
  94 |     }
  95 |     
  96 |     /// 跳转到指定时间
  97 |     /// - Parameter time: 目标时间（秒）
  98 |     func seek(to time: TimeInterval) {
  99 |         guard let player = player else { return }
 100 |         
 101 |         let clampedTime = max(0, min(time, duration))
 102 |         player.currentTime = clampedTime
 103 |         currentTime = clampedTime
 104 |         progress = duration > 0 ? clampedTime / duration : 0
 105 |     }
 106 |     
 107 |     /// 跳转到指定进度
 108 |     /// - Parameter progress: 目标进度（0.0 ~ 1.0）
 109 |     func seek(toProgress newProgress: Double) {
 110 |         let targetTime = duration * max(0, min(newProgress, 1))
 111 |         seek(to: targetTime)
 112 |     }
 113 |     
 114 |     /// 切换播放/暂停
 115 |     func togglePlayPause() {
 116 |         if isPlaying {
 117 |             pause()
 118 |         } else {
 119 |             resume()
 120 |         }
 121 |     }
 122 |     
 123 |     /// 检查是否正在播放指定 URL
 124 |     func isPlaying(url: URL) -> Bool {
 125 |         return isPlaying && currentURL == url
 126 |     }
 127 |     
 128 |     // MARK: - Private Methods
 129 |     
 130 |     private func startProgressTimer() {
 131 |         stopProgressTimer()
 132 |         
 133 |         progressTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: 0.1, repeats: true) { [weak self] _ in
 134 |             Task { @MainActor in
 135 |                 self?.updateProgress()
 136 |             }
 137 |         }
 138 |     }
 139 |     
 140 |     private func stopProgressTimer() {
 141 |         progressTimer?.invalidate()
 142 |         progressTimer = nil
 143 |     }
 144 |     
 145 |     private func updateProgress() {
 146 |         guard let player = player else { return }
 147 |         
 148 |         currentTime = player.currentTime
 149 |         progress = duration > 0 ? currentTime / duration : 0
 150 |     }
 151 | }
 152 | 
 153 | // MARK: - AVAudioPlayerDelegate
 154 | 
 155 | extension AudioPlayerService: AVAudioPlayerDelegate {
 156 |     nonisolated func audioPlayerDidFinishPlaying(_ player: AVAudioPlayer, successfully flag: Bool) {
 157 |         Task { @MainActor in
 158 |             self.isPlaying = false
 159 |             self.progress = 1.0
 160 |             self.currentTime = self.duration
 161 |             self.stopProgressTimer()
 162 |             self.logger.info("✅ Playback finished")
 163 |         }
 164 |     }
 165 |     
 166 |     nonisolated func audioPlayerDecodeErrorDidOccur(_ player: AVAudioPlayer, error: Error?) {
 167 |         Task { @MainActor in
 168 |             self.logger.error("❌ Decode error: \(error?.localizedDescription ?? "Unknown")")
 169 |             self.stop()
 170 |         }
 171 |     }
 172 | }
 173 | 
 174 | // MARK: - Errors
 175 | 
 176 | enum AudioPlayerError: LocalizedError {
 177 |     case playerCreationFailed
 178 |     case fileNotFound
 179 |     
 180 |     var errorDescription: String? {
 181 |         switch self {
 182 |         case .playerCreationFailed:
 183 |             return "无法创建音频播放器"
 184 |         case .fileNotFound:
 185 |             return "音频文件不存在"
 186 |         }
 187 |     }
 188 | }

   1 | import AppKit

   4 | /// 剪贴板历史服务
   5 | /// 底层静默保存用户剪贴板历史，作为 LLM 上下文
   6 | @MainActor
   7 | final class ClipboardHistoryService {
   8 |     
   9 |     // MARK: - Singleton
  10 |     
  11 |     static let shared = ClipboardHistoryService()
  12 |     
  13 |     private let logger = Logger(subsystem: "com.spokeanywhere", category: "ClipboardHistory")
  14 |     
  15 |     // MARK: - Constants
  16 |     
  17 |     /// 默认保存条数
  18 |     private static let defaultLimit = 30
  19 |     /// 单条最大长度
  20 |     private static let maxItemLength = 500
  21 |     /// 检查间隔（秒）
  22 |     private static let checkInterval: TimeInterval = 1.0
  23 |     /// 存储 Key
  24 |     private static let storageKey = "ClipboardHistory"
  25 |     
  26 |     // MARK: - Properties
  27 |     
  28 |     /// 历史记录
  29 |     private(set) var history: [ClipboardItem] = []
  30 |     
  31 |     /// 上次剪贴板变化计数
  32 |     private var lastChangeCount: Int = 0
  33 |     
  34 |     /// 定时器
  35 |     private var timer: Timer?
  36 |     
  37 |     /// 是否正在运行
  38 |     private(set) var isRunning = false
  39 |     
  40 |     // MARK: - Init
  41 |     
  42 |     private init() {
  43 |         loadHistory()
  44 |     }
  45 |     
  46 |     // MARK: - Public API
  47 |     
  48 |     /// 启动监听
  49 |     func start() {
  50 |         guard !isRunning else { return }
  51 |         isRunning = true
  52 |         lastChangeCount = NSPasteboard.general.changeCount
  53 |         
  54 |         timer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: Self.checkInterval, repeats: true) { [weak self] _ in
  55 |             Task { @MainActor in
  56 |                 self?.checkClipboard()
  57 |             }
  58 |         }
  59 |         
  60 |         logger.info("📋 ClipboardHistoryService started")
  61 |     }
  62 |     
  63 |     /// 停止监听
  64 |     func stop() {
  65 |         timer?.invalidate()
  66 |         timer = nil
  67 |         isRunning = false
  68 |         logger.info("📋 ClipboardHistoryService stopped")
  69 |     }
  70 |     
  71 |     /// 获取历史文本（用于 LLM 上下文）
  72 |     func getHistoryForContext(limit: Int = 20) -> [String] {
  73 |         return history.prefix(limit).map { $0.content }
  74 |     }
  75 |     
  76 |     /// 格式化为 Prompt 上下文
  77 |     func formatForPrompt(limit: Int = 20) -> String {
  78 |         let items = getHistoryForContext(limit: limit)
  79 |         guard !items.isEmpty else { return "" }
  80 |         
  81 |         var result = "<剪贴板历史>\n"
  82 |         for (index, item) in items.enumerated() {
  83 |             // 保留更多内容，最多 500 字符
  84 |             let truncated = item.count > 500 ? String(item.prefix(500)) + "..." : item
  85 |             result += "\(index + 1). \(truncated)\n"
  86 |         }
  87 |         result += "</剪贴板历史>"
  88 |         return result
  89 |     }
  90 |     
  91 |     /// 调试：打印完整历史
  92 |     func debugPrintHistory() {
  93 |         print("📋 === CLIPBOARD HISTORY DEBUG ===")
  94 |         print("📋 Total items: \(history.count)")
  95 |         for (index, item) in history.prefix(10).enumerated() {
  96 |             print("📋 [\(index + 1)] \(item.content)")
  97 |         }
  98 |         print("📋 === END HISTORY ===")
  99 |     }
 100 |     
 101 |     /// 清空历史
 102 |     func clearHistory() {
 103 |         history.removeAll()
 104 |         saveHistory()
 105 |         logger.info("📋 History cleared")
 106 |     }
 107 |     
 108 |     // MARK: - Private
 109 |     
 110 |     private func checkClipboard() {
 111 |         let currentCount = NSPasteboard.general.changeCount
 112 |         guard currentCount != lastChangeCount else { return }
 113 |         lastChangeCount = currentCount
 114 |         
 115 |         // 获取剪贴板文本
 116 |         guard let content = NSPasteboard.general.string(forType: .string),
 117 |               !content.isEmpty else { return }
 118 |         
 119 |         // 过滤敏感内容
 120 |         if isSensitive(content) {
 121 |             logger.debug("📋 Skipped sensitive content")
 122 |             return
 123 |         }
 124 |         
 125 |         // 过滤垃圾内容（调试日志、CSV、太短）
 126 |         if shouldIgnore(content) {
 127 |             logger.debug("📋 Skipped ignored content")
 128 |             return
 129 |         }
 130 |         
 131 |         // 截断过长内容
 132 |         let truncated = content.count > Self.maxItemLength
 133 |             ? String(content.prefix(Self.maxItemLength))
 134 |             : content
 135 |         
 136 |         // 去重：如果最近一条相同则跳过（只过滤完全一致的连续内容）
 137 |         if let lastItem = history.first, lastItem.content == truncated {
 138 |             return
 139 |         }
 140 |         
 141 |         // 添加到历史
 142 |         let item = ClipboardItem(content: truncated, timestamp: Date())
 143 |         history.insert(item, at: 0)
 144 |         
 145 |         // 限制条数
 146 |         let limit = AppSettings.shared.clipboardHistoryLimit
 147 |         if history.count > limit {
 148 |             history = Array(history.prefix(limit))
 149 |         }
 150 |         
 151 |         // 持久化
 152 |         saveHistory()
 153 |         
 154 |         logger.info("📋 Added to history: \(truncated.prefix(80))...")
 155 |         print("📋 Clipboard history count: \(history.count), latest: \(truncated.prefix(80))...")
 156 |     }
 157 |     
 158 |     /// 检测是否应忽略（垃圾过滤）
 159 |     private func shouldIgnore(_ content: String) -> Bool {
 160 |         // 长度检查 (忽略 < 2 字符)
 161 |         if content.count < 2 { return true }
 162 |         
 163 |         // 包含特定关键词的调试日志
 164 |         let ignoredKeywords = [
 165 |             "DEBUG",
 166 |             "Clipboard history count",
 167 |             "timestamp,scope,file", // CSV Header
 168 |             "SpokenAnyWhere", // Log app name
 169 |             "LLM PROMPT",
 170 |             "System Prompt",
 171 |             "User Message",
 172 |             "Audio files cannot be non-interleaved", // CoreAudio log
 173 |             "Building for debugging", // Swift build log
 174 |             "Emitting module"
 175 |         ]
 176 |         
 177 |         for keyword in ignoredKeywords {
 178 |             if content.contains(keyword) { return true }
 179 |         }
 180 |         
 181 |         return false
 182 |     }
 183 |     
 184 |     /// 检测敏感内容
 185 |     private func isSensitive(_ content: String) -> Bool {
 186 |         let lowercased = content.lowercased()
 187 |         
 188 |         // 密码模式
 189 |         if lowercased.contains("password") || lowercased.contains("passwd") {
 190 |             return true
 191 |         }
 192 |         
 193 |         // API Key 模式
 194 |         if lowercased.contains("api_key") || lowercased.contains("apikey") ||
 195 |            lowercased.contains("secret") || lowercased.contains("token") {
 196 |             return true
 197 |         }
 198 |         
 199 |         // 看起来像密钥的长字符串（全是字母数字，无空格，超过 30 字符）
 200 |         if content.count > 30 &&
 201 |            !content.contains(" ") &&
 202 |            content.allSatisfy({ $0.isLetter || $0.isNumber || $0 == "-" || $0 == "_" }) {
 203 |             return true
 204 |         }
 205 |         
 206 |         return false
 207 |     }
 208 |     
 209 |     // MARK: - Persistence
 210 |     
 211 |     private func saveHistory() {
 212 |         do {
 213 |             let data = try JSONEncoder().encode(history)
 214 |             UserDefaults.standard.set(data, forKey: Self.storageKey)
 215 |         } catch {
 216 |             logger.error("❌ Failed to save history: \(error)")
 217 |         }
 218 |     }
 219 |     
 220 |     private func loadHistory() {
 221 |         guard let data = UserDefaults.standard.data(forKey: Self.storageKey) else { return }
 222 |         do {
 223 |             let loaded = try JSONDecoder().decode([ClipboardItem].self, from: data)
 224 |             // 启动时清洗脏数据：应用 shouldIgnore 规则
 225 |             history = loaded.filter { !shouldIgnore($0.content) }
 226 |             logger.info("📋 Loaded \(self.history.count) history items (cleaned from \(loaded.count))")
 227 |         } catch {
 228 |             logger.error("❌ Failed to load history: \(error)")
 229 |         }
 230 |     }
 231 | }
 232 | 
 233 | // MARK: - ClipboardItem
 234 | 
 235 | struct ClipboardItem: Codable, Identifiable {
 236 |     let id: UUID
 237 |     let content: String
 238 |     let timestamp: Date
 239 |     
 240 |     init(content: String, timestamp: Date) {
 241 |         self.id = UUID()
 242 |         self.content = content
 243 |         self.timestamp = timestamp
 244 |     }
 245 | }

   4 | /// 上下文感知服务
   5 | /// 监听当前活动 App，提供 Prompt 拼接
   6 | @MainActor
   7 | final class ContextService {
   8 |     
   9 |     // MARK: - Singleton
  10 |     
  11 |     static let shared = ContextService()
  12 |     
  13 |     // MARK: - Properties
  14 |     
  15 |     /// 当前活动 App
  16 |     private(set) var currentApp: TargetAppInfo?
  17 |     
  18 |     /// App 切换通知
  19 |     private var cancellables = Set<AnyCancellable>()
  20 |     
  21 |     // MARK: - Init
  22 |     
  23 |     private init() {
  24 |         setupObservers()
  25 |         updateCurrentApp()
  26 |     }
  27 |     
  28 |     // MARK: - Public API
  29 |     
  30 |     /// 获取当前活动 App 信息
  31 |     func getCurrentTargetApp() -> TargetAppInfo? {
  32 |         return currentApp
  33 |     }
  34 |     
  35 |     /// 根据当前 App 拼接 Prompt
  36 |     /// - Parameter globalPrompt: 全局 Prompt
  37 |     /// - Parameter appRules: App 规则列表（从 SwiftData 查询）
  38 |     /// - Returns: 拼接后的完整 Prompt
  39 |     func assemblePrompt(globalPrompt: String, appRules: [AppRule]) -> String {
  40 |         guard let currentApp = currentApp else {
  41 |             return globalPrompt
  42 |         }
  43 |         
  44 |         // 查找匹配的 App 规则
  45 |         let matchedRule = appRules.first { rule in
  46 |             rule.bundleId == currentApp.bundleIdentifier && rule.isEnabled
  47 |         }
  48 |         
  49 |         if let rule = matchedRule {
  50 |             return """
  51 |             \(globalPrompt)
  52 |             
  53 |             [当前应用: \(currentApp.name)]
  54 |             \(rule.extraPrompt)
  55 |             """
  56 |         }
  57 |         
  58 |         return globalPrompt
  59 |     }
  60 |     
  61 |     // MARK: - Private
  62 |     
  63 |     private func setupObservers() {
  64 |         // 监听 App 激活通知
  65 |         NSWorkspace.shared.notificationCenter
  66 |             .publisher(for: NSWorkspace.didActivateApplicationNotification)
  67 |             .receive(on: DispatchQueue.main)
  68 |             .sink { [weak self] notification in
  69 |                 self?.handleAppActivation(notification)
  70 |             }
  71 |             .store(in: &cancellables)
  72 |     }
  73 |     
  74 |     private func handleAppActivation(_ notification: Notification) {
  75 |         updateCurrentApp()
  76 |     }
  77 |     
  78 |     private func updateCurrentApp() {
  79 |         guard let frontApp = NSWorkspace.shared.frontmostApplication else {
  80 |             currentApp = nil
  81 |             return
  82 |         }
  83 |         
  84 |         // 排除自身
  85 |         if frontApp.bundleIdentifier == Bundle.main.bundleIdentifier {
  86 |             return
  87 |         }
  88 |         
  89 |         currentApp = TargetAppInfo.from(frontApp)
  90 |     }
  91 | }

   7 | private enum EdgeTTSConstants {

  15 | private enum DRMHelper {
  16 |     /// 生成 Sec-MS-GEC Token (DRM 验证)
  17 |     static func generateSecMsGecToken() -> String {
  18 |         let currentTime = Int64(Date().timeIntervalSince1970)
  19 |         let ticks = (currentTime + EdgeTTSConstants.windowsFileTimeEpoch) * 10_000_000
  20 |         let roundedTicks = ticks - (ticks % 3_000_000_000)
  21 |         
  22 |         let strToHash = "\(roundedTicks)\(EdgeTTSConstants.trustedClientToken)"
  23 |         guard let data = strToHash.data(using: .ascii) else { return "" }
  24 |         
  25 |         let hash = SHA256.hash(data: data)
  26 |         return hash.map { String(format: "%02X", $0) }.joined()
  27 |     }
  28 | }
  29 |

  34 |     case connectionFailed
  35 |     case noAudioData
  36 |     case synthesizeFailed(String)

  41 |         case .connectionFailed: return "连接失败"

  53 |     private var audioData = Data()
  54 |     
  55 |     /// 合成语音
  56 |     func synthesize(text: String, voice: EdgeVoice, rate: Int, pitch: Int) async throws -> Data {

  61 |         let urlString = "wss://speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/speech/synthesize/readaloud/edge/v1?TrustedClientToken=\(EdgeTTSConstants.trustedClientToken)&Sec-MS-GEC=\(secMsGec)&Sec-MS-GEC-Version=1-\(EdgeTTSConstants.chromiumVersion)"
  62 |         
  63 |         guard let url = URL(string: urlString) else {
  64 |             throw EdgeTTSError.invalidURL
  65 |         }
  66 |         
  67 |         print("[EdgeTTS] Connecting...")
  68 |         
  69 |         // 创建 WebSocket 请求
  70 |         var request = URLRequest(url: url)
  71 |         request.setValue("chrome-extension://jdiccldimpdaibmpdkjnbmckianbfold", forHTTPHeaderField: "Origin")
  72 |         request.setValue("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/\(EdgeTTSConstants.chromiumVersion) Safari/537.36 Edg/\(EdgeTTSConstants.chromiumVersion)", forHTTPHeaderField: "User-Agent")
  73 |         
  74 |         // 使用 delegate 模式连接
  75 |         let delegate = WebSocketDelegate()
  76 |         let session = URLSession(configuration: .default, delegate: delegate, delegateQueue: nil)
  77 |         webSocketTask = session.webSocketTask(with: request)
  78 |         webSocketTask?.resume()
  79 |         
  80 |         // 等待连接建立
  81 |         try await delegate.waitForConnection()
  82 |         print("[EdgeTTS] Connected!")
  83 |         
  84 |         // 发送配置消息

  86 |         try await webSocketTask?.send(.string(configMessage))

 120 |     /// 接收消息
 121 |     private func receiveMessages() async throws {
 122 |         guard let ws = webSocketTask else { return }
 123 |         
 124 |         while true {
 125 |             do {
 126 |                 let message = try await ws.receive()
 127 |                 
 128 |                 switch message {
 129 |                 case .data(let data):
 130 |                     // 尝试解析为字符串看是否包含 Path:audio
 131 |                     if let dataStr = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8),
 132 |                        dataStr.contains("Path:audio\r\n") {
 133 |                         // 找到音频分隔符后的数据
 134 |                         let separator = "Path:audio\r\n"
 135 |                         if let range = dataStr.range(of: separator) {
 136 |                             let audioStartIndex = data.startIndex + range.upperBound.utf16Offset(in: dataStr)
 137 |                             let audioSubData = data[audioStartIndex...]
 138 |                             audioData.append(audioSubData)
 139 |                         }
 140 |                     } else {
 141 |                         // 纯二进制音频数据
 142 |                         audioData.append(data)
 143 |                     }
 144 |                     
 145 |                 case .string(let text):
 146 |                     if text.contains("Path:turn.end") {
 147 |                         print("[EdgeTTS] Turn ended")
 148 |                         return
 149 |                     }
 150 |                     
 151 |                 @unknown default:
 152 |                     break
 153 |                 }
 154 |             } catch {
 155 |                 print("[EdgeTTS] Error: \(error)")
 156 |                 return
 157 |             }
 158 |         }

 201 | // MARK: - 统一 TTS 服务

 203 | /// 统一 TTS 服务

 205 | @MainActor
 206 | final class TTSService: NSObject, ObservableObject {
 207 |     
 208 |     // MARK: - Singleton
 209 |     
 210 |     static let shared = TTSService()
 211 |     
 212 |     // MARK: - Properties
 213 |     
 214 |     @Published var isPlaying: Bool = false
 215 |     @Published var isSynthesizing: Bool = false
 216 |     @Published var currentChunkIndex: Int = 0
 217 |     @Published var totalChunks: Int = 0
 218 |     @Published var error: String?
 219 |     
 220 |     private let settings = TTSSettings.shared
 221 |     private let edgeClient = EdgeTTSClient()
 222 |     
 223 |     // 系统 TTS
 224 |     private let synthesizer = AVSpeechSynthesizer()
 225 |     
 226 |     // 音频播放
 227 |     private var audioPlayer: AVAudioPlayer?
 228 |     
 229 |     // 分块朗读
 230 |     private var chunks: [String] = []
 231 |     private var speakTask: Task<Void, Never>?
 232 |     
 233 |     // MARK: - Init
 234 |     
 235 |     private override init() {
 236 |         super.init()
 237 |         synthesizer.delegate = self
 238 |     }
 239 |     
 240 |     // MARK: - Public API
 241 |     
 242 |     /// 切换播放状态
 243 |     func toggleSpeak(_ text: String) {
 244 |         if isPlaying {
 245 |             stop()
 246 |         } else {
 247 |             speak(text)
 248 |         }
 249 |     }
 250 |     
 251 |     /// 朗读文本（支持分块）
 252 |     func speak(_ text: String) {
 253 |         guard !text.isEmpty else { return }
 254 |         
 255 |         stop()
 256 |         error = nil
 257 |         
 258 |         // 清理 Markdown 符号
 259 |         let cleanText = cleanMarkdownForTTS(text)
 260 |         
 261 |         // 分块处理
 262 |         chunks = splitTextIntoChunks(cleanText)
 263 |         totalChunks = chunks.count
 264 |         currentChunkIndex = 0
 265 |         
 266 |         isPlaying = true
 267 |         
 268 |         speakTask = Task {
 269 |             await speakChunks()
 270 |         }
 271 |     }
 272 |     
 273 |     /// 清理 Markdown 符号，使文本更适合 TTS 朗读
 274 |     private func cleanMarkdownForTTS(_ text: String) -> String {
 275 |         var result = text
 276 |         
 277 |         // 移除代码块
 278 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "```[^`]*```", with: "", options: .regularExpression)
 279 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "`[^`]+`", with: "", options: .regularExpression)
 280 |         
 281 |         // 移除标题符号 # 
 282 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "^#{1,6}\\s*", with: "", options: .regularExpression)
 283 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "\n#{1,6}\\s*", with: "\n", options: .regularExpression)
 284 |         
 285 |         // 移除加粗/斜体 *、**、***、_、__
 286 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "\\*{1,3}([^*]+)\\*{1,3}", with: "$1", options: .regularExpression)
 287 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "_{1,2}([^_]+)_{1,2}", with: "$1", options: .regularExpression)
 288 |         
 289 |         // 移除链接 [text](url) -> text
 290 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "\\[([^\\]]+)\\]\\([^)]+\\)", with: "$1", options: .regularExpression)
 291 |         
 292 |         // 移除图片 ![alt](url)
 293 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "!\\[[^\\]]*\\]\\([^)]+\\)", with: "", options: .regularExpression)
 294 |         
 295 |         // 移除列表符号 - 、* 、+ 、数字.
 296 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "^[\\-\\*\\+]\\s+", with: "", options: .regularExpression)
 297 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "\n[\\-\\*\\+]\\s+", with: "\n", options: .regularExpression)
 298 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "^\\d+\\.\\s+", with: "", options: .regularExpression)
 299 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "\n\\d+\\.\\s+", with: "\n", options: .regularExpression)
 300 |         
 301 |         // 移除引用符号 >
 302 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "^>\\s*", with: "", options: .regularExpression)
 303 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "\n>\\s*", with: "\n", options: .regularExpression)
 304 |         
 305 |         // 移除分隔线 ---、***、___
 306 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "^[\\-\\*_]{3,}$", with: "", options: .regularExpression)
 307 |         
 308 |         // 清理多余空行
 309 |         result = result.replacingOccurrences(of: "\n{3,}", with: "\n\n", options: .regularExpression)
 310 |         
 311 |         return result.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
 312 |     }
 313 |     
 314 |     /// 停止朗读
 315 |     func stop() {
 316 |         speakTask?.cancel()
 317 |         speakTask = nil
 318 |         synthesizer.stopSpeaking(at: .immediate)
 319 |         audioPlayer?.stop()
 320 |         audioPlayer = nil
 321 |         Task { await edgeClient.cancel() }
 322 |         chunks = []
 323 |         isPlaying = false
 324 |         isSynthesizing = false
 325 |         currentChunkIndex = 0
 326 |         totalChunks = 0
 327 |     }
 328 |     
 329 |     // MARK: - Chunk Processing
 330 |     
 331 |     /// 将文本分割成块（按句子分割）
 332 |     private func splitTextIntoChunks(_ text: String) -> [String] {
 333 |         let chunkSize = settings.chunkSize
 334 |         
 335 |         // 如果 chunkSize 为 0 或文本较短，不分块
 336 |         if chunkSize == 0 || text.count <= chunkSize {
 337 |             return [text]
 338 |         }
 339 |         
 340 |         var chunks: [String] = []
 341 |         var currentChunk = ""
 342 |         
 343 |         // 按句子分割符分割
 344 |         let sentenceDelimiters = CharacterSet(charactersIn: "。！？.!?\n")
 345 |         let sentences = text.components(separatedBy: sentenceDelimiters)
 346 |             .map { $0.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespaces) }
 347 |             .filter { !$0.isEmpty }
 348 |         
 349 |         for sentence in sentences {
 350 |             // 找回分隔符
 351 |             let range = text.range(of: sentence)
 352 |             var fullSentence = sentence
 353 |             if let range = range {
 354 |                 let endIndex = range.upperBound
 355 |                 if endIndex < text.endIndex {
 356 |                     let delimiter = text[endIndex]
 357 |                     if sentenceDelimiters.contains(delimiter.unicodeScalars.first!) {
 358 |                         fullSentence += String(delimiter)
 359 |                     }
 360 |                 }
 361 |             }
 362 |             
 363 |             // 如果当前块加上新句子超过限制，保存当前块
 364 |             if currentChunk.count + fullSentence.count > chunkSize && !currentChunk.isEmpty {
 365 |                 chunks.append(currentChunk)
 366 |                 currentChunk = fullSentence
 367 |             } else {
 368 |                 currentChunk += fullSentence
 369 |             }
 370 |         }
 371 |         
 372 |         // 保存最后一块
 373 |         if !currentChunk.isEmpty {
 374 |             chunks.append(currentChunk)
 375 |         }
 376 |         
 377 |         return chunks.isEmpty ? [text] : chunks
 378 |     }
 379 |     
 380 |     /// 逐块朗读
 381 |     private func speakChunks() async {
 382 |         for (index, chunk) in chunks.enumerated() {
 383 |             guard !Task.isCancelled else { break }
 384 |             
 385 |             currentChunkIndex = index
 386 |             
 387 |             switch settings.provider {
 388 |             case .system:
 389 |                 await speakChunkWithSystem(chunk)
 390 |             case .edge:
 391 |                 await speakChunkWithEdge(chunk)
 392 |             }
 393 |             
 394 |             guard !Task.isCancelled else { break }
 395 |         }
 396 |         
 397 |         isPlaying = false
 398 |         isSynthesizing = false
 399 |     }
 400 |     
 401 |     // MARK: - System TTS
 402 |     
 403 |     private func speakChunkWithSystem(_ text: String) async {
 404 |         let utterance = AVSpeechUtterance(string: text)
 405 |         utterance.voice = AVSpeechSynthesisVoice(language: settings.systemVoice)
 406 |         utterance.rate = settings.systemRate
 407 |         
 408 |         await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in
 409 |             systemContinuation = continuation
 410 |             synthesizer.speak(utterance)
 411 |         }
 412 |     }
 413 |     
 414 |     private var systemContinuation: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>?
 415 |     
 416 |     // MARK: - Edge TTS
 417 |     
 418 |     private func speakChunkWithEdge(_ text: String) async {
 419 |         isSynthesizing = true
 420 |         
 421 |         do {
 422 |             let audioData = try await edgeClient.synthesize(
 423 |                 text: text,
 424 |                 voice: settings.edgeVoice,
 425 |                 rate: settings.edgeRate,
 426 |                 pitch: settings.edgePitch
 427 |             )
 428 |             
 429 |             isSynthesizing = false
 430 |             
 431 |             // 播放音频
 432 |             await playAudio(data: audioData)
 433 |             
 434 |         } catch {
 435 |             self.error = error.localizedDescription
 436 |             print("❌ EdgeTTS Error: \(error)")
 437 |             isSynthesizing = false
 438 |         }
 439 |     }
 440 |     
 441 |     /// 播放音频数据
 442 |     private func playAudio(data: Data) async {
 443 |         do {
 444 |             // 保存到临时文件（AVAudioPlayer 对带 header 的数据解析更可靠）
 445 |             let tempURL = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("edge_tts_\(UUID().uuidString).mp3")
 446 |             try data.write(to: tempURL)
 447 |             
 448 |             audioPlayer = try AVAudioPlayer(contentsOf: tempURL)
 449 |             audioPlayer?.delegate = self
 450 |             audioPlayer?.play()
 451 |             
 452 |             // 等待播放完成
 453 |             await withCheckedContinuation { (continuation: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>) in
 454 |                 audioContinuation = continuation
 455 |             }
 456 |             
 457 |             // 清理临时文件
 458 |             try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tempURL)
 459 |         } catch {
 460 |             print("❌ Audio playback error: \(error)")
 461 |         }
 462 |     }
 463 |     
 464 |     private var audioContinuation: CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>?
 465 | }
 466 | 
 467 | // MARK: - AVSpeechSynthesizerDelegate
 468 | 
 469 | extension TTSService: AVSpeechSynthesizerDelegate {
 470 |     nonisolated func speechSynthesizer(_ synthesizer: AVSpeechSynthesizer, didFinish utterance: AVSpeechUtterance) {
 471 |         Task { @MainActor in
 472 |             systemContinuation?.resume()
 473 |             systemContinuation = nil
 474 |         }
 475 |     }
 476 |     
 477 |     nonisolated func speechSynthesizer(_ synthesizer: AVSpeechSynthesizer, didCancel utterance: AVSpeechUtterance) {
 478 |         Task { @MainActor in
 479 |             systemContinuation?.resume()
 480 |             systemContinuation = nil
 481 |             isPlaying = false
 482 |         }
 483 |     }
 484 | }
 485 | 
 486 | // MARK: - AVAudioPlayerDelegate
 487 | 
 488 | extension TTSService: AVAudioPlayerDelegate {
 489 |     nonisolated func audioPlayerDidFinishPlaying(_ player: AVAudioPlayer, successfully flag: Bool) {
 490 |         Task { @MainActor in
 491 |             audioContinuation?.resume()
 492 |             audioContinuation = nil
 493 |         }
 494 |     }
 495 | }
 496 | 
 497 | // MARK: - Legacy Alias (兼容旧代码)
 498 | 
 499 | typealias EdgeTTSService = TTSService

  16 |     
  17 |     static let shared = FloatingHUDManager()
  18 |     
  19 |     // MARK: - Properties
  20 |     
  21 |     private var panel: FloatingPanel?
  22 |     private let state: RecordingState
  23 |     
  24 |     private var hideTimer: Timer?

  28 |     /// 取消录音回调（用户点击"取消录音"按钮）

  46 |         state.startRecording(targetApp: targetApp)

  61 |     
  62 |     /// 更新实时转写文本

  65 |         // 不再需要更新窗口大小，窗口是固定的
  66 |     }

  71 |     }
  72 |     
  73 |     /// 切换到思考状态（LLM 处理中）

  76 |     }
  77 |     
  78 |     /// 完成处理
  79 |     func complete(with text: String) {
  80 |         state.complete(with: text)
  81 |         scheduleHide(after: 0.75)  // 打勾后快速消失
  82 |     }
  83 |     
  84 |     /// 处理失败
  85 |     func fail(with message: String) {
  86 |         state.fail(with: message)
  87 |         scheduleHide(after: 3.0)
  88 |     }
  89 |     
  90 |     /// 隐藏胶囊
  91 |     func hide() {
  92 |         hideTimer?.invalidate()
  93 |         hideTimer = nil
  94 |         
  95 |         NSAnimationContext.runAnimationGroup { context in
  96 |             context.duration = 0.3
  97 |             panel?.animator().alphaValue = 0
  98 |         } completionHandler: { [weak self] in
  99 |             Task { @MainActor in
 100 |                 self?.panel?.orderOut(nil)
 101 |                 self?.panel?.alphaValue = 1
 102 |                 self?.state.reset()
 103 |             }
 104 |         }
 105 |     }

 107 |     // MARK: - Private
 108 |     
 109 |     private func createPanelIfNeeded() {
 110 |         guard panel == nil else { return }
 111 |         
 112 |         var contentView = FloatingCapsuleView(state: state)
 113 |         contentView.onComplete = { [weak self] in
 114 |             self?.onComplete?()
 115 |         }
 116 |         contentView.onCancel = { [weak self] in
 117 |             self?.onCancel?()
 118 |         }
 119 |         contentView.onHoverChange = { _ in }
 120 |         
 121 |         // 固定宽度，内容从底部向上扩展
 122 |         let framedView = contentView
 123 |             .frame(width: Self.fixedWindowWidth, height: Self.fixedWindowHeight, alignment: .bottom)
 124 |         
 125 |         let hostingView = NSHostingView(rootView: framedView)
 126 |         
 127 |         // 固定窗口大小
 128 |         let frame = NSRect(
 129 |             origin: .zero,
 130 |             size: NSSize(width: Self.fixedWindowWidth, height: Self.fixedWindowHeight)
 131 |         )
 132 |         
 133 |         let newPanel = FloatingPanel(contentRect: frame)
 134 |         newPanel.contentView = hostingView
 135 |         
 136 |         self.panel = newPanel
 137 |     }
 138 |     
 139 |     private func scheduleHide(after delay: TimeInterval) {
 140 |         hideTimer?.invalidate()
 141 |         hideTimer = Timer.scheduledTimer(withTimeInterval: delay, repeats: false) { [weak self] _ in
 142 |             Task { @MainActor in
 143 |                 self?.hide()
 144 |             }
 145 |         }
 146 |     }
 147 | }

   6 | /// 历史记录管理器
   7 | /// 负责录音记录的持久化、检索、重处理
   8 | @MainActor
   9 | final class HistoryManager {
  10 |     
  11 |     // MARK: - Singleton
  12 |
