  14 |     
  15 |     private let logger = Logger(subsystem: "com.spokeanywhere", category: "HistoryManager")
  16 |     
  17 |     // MARK: - Dependencies
  18 |     
  19 |     private var modelContext: ModelContext?
  20 |     private let llmPipeline = LLMPipeline.shared
  21 |     
  22 |     // MARK: - Properties
  23 |     
  24 |     /// 音频存储目录
  25 |     var audioStorageURL: URL {
  26 |         let appSupport = FileManager.default.urls(for: .applicationSupportDirectory, in: .userDomainMask).first!
  27 |         let spokeDir = appSupport.appendingPathComponent("Spoke/Audio", isDirectory: true)
  28 |         
  29 |         // 确保目录存在
  30 |         if !FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: spokeDir.path) {
  31 |             try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: spokeDir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
  32 |         }
  33 |         
  34 |         return spokeDir
  35 |     }
  36 |     
  37 |     // MARK: - Init
  38 |     
  39 |     private init() {}
  40 |     
  41 |     // MARK: - Configuration
  42 |     
  43 |     /// 配置 ModelContext（在 AppDelegate 中调用）
  44 |     func configure(with context: ModelContext) {
  45 |         self.modelContext = context
  46 |         logger.info("✅ HistoryManager configured with ModelContext")
  47 |     }
  48 |     
  49 |     // MARK: - Public API
  50 |     
  51 |     /// 保存录音记录
  52 |     /// - Parameters:
  53 |     ///   - rawText: 原始转写文本
  54 |     ///   - processedText: LLM 处理后的文本（可选）
  55 |     ///   - tempAudioURL: 临时音频文件 URL（可选）
  56 |     ///   - appBundleId: 来源应用的 Bundle ID（可选）
  57 |     func saveRecording(
  58 |         rawText: String,
  59 |         processedText: String?,
  60 |         tempAudioURL: URL?,
  61 |         appBundleId: String?
  62 |     ) async {
  63 |         guard let context = modelContext else {
  64 |             logger.error("❌ ModelContext not configured")
  65 |             return
  66 |         }
  67 |         
  68 |         var audioPath: String?
  69 |         var audioDuration: TimeInterval?
  70 |         
  71 |         // 处理音频文件
  72 |         if let tempURL = tempAudioURL, FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: tempURL.path) {
  73 |             let fileName = "\(UUID().uuidString).caf"
  74 |             let permanentURL = audioStorageURL.appendingPathComponent(fileName)
  75 |             
  76 |             do {
  77 |                 // 后台执行文件操作
  78 |                 try await Task.detached(priority: .utility) {
  79 |                     try FileManager.default.moveItem(at: tempURL, to: permanentURL)
  80 |                 }.value
  81 |                 
  82 |                 audioPath = fileName
  83 |                 audioDuration = await getAudioDuration(url: permanentURL)
  84 |                 logger.info("📁 Audio saved: \(fileName)")
  85 |             } catch {
  86 |                 logger.error("❌ Failed to save audio: \(error.localizedDescription)")
  87 |             }
  88 |         }
  89 |         
  90 |         // 创建历史记录
  91 |         let item = HistoryItem(
  92 |             rawText: rawText,
  93 |             processedText: processedText,
  94 |             audioPath: audioPath,
  95 |             appBundleId: appBundleId
  96 |         )
  97 |         item.audioDuration = audioDuration
  98 |         
  99 |         context.insert(item)
 100 |         logger.info("✅ History item saved: \(rawText.prefix(30))...")
 101 |     }
 102 |     
 103 |     /// 使用新 Prompt 重新处理历史记录
 104 |     /// - Parameters:
 105 |     ///   - item: 历史记录项
 106 |     ///   - customPrompt: 自定义系统提示词
 107 |     /// - Returns: 处理结果
 108 |     func reprocess(
 109 |         _ item: HistoryItem,
 110 |         with customPrompt: String
 111 |     ) async -> Result<String, LLMError> {
 112 |         let result = await llmPipeline.refine(item.rawText, customSystemPrompt: customPrompt)
 113 |         
 114 |         switch result {
 115 |         case .success(let text):
 116 |             item.processedText = text
 117 |             logger.info("✅ Reprocessed: \(text.prefix(30))...")
 118 |         case .failure(let error):
 119 |             logger.error("❌ Reprocess failed: \(error.localizedDescription)")
 120 |         }
 121 |         
 122 |         return result
 123 |     }
 124 |     
 125 |     /// 删除历史记录（包括音频文件）
 126 |     /// - Parameter item: 历史记录项
 127 |     func deleteItem(_ item: HistoryItem) {
 128 |         guard let context = modelContext else {
 129 |             logger.error("❌ ModelContext not configured")
 130 |             return
 131 |         }
 132 |         
 133 |         // 删除音频文件
 134 |         if let audioPath = item.audioPath {
 135 |             let audioURL = audioStorageURL.appendingPathComponent(audioPath)
 136 |             try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: audioURL)
 137 |             logger.info("🗑️ Audio deleted: \(audioPath)")
 138 |         }
 139 |         
 140 |         // 删除数据库记录
 141 |         context.delete(item)
 142 |         logger.info("🗑️ History item deleted")
 143 |     }
 144 |     
 145 |     /// 获取音频文件的完整 URL
 146 |     /// - Parameter item: 历史记录项
 147 |     /// - Returns: 音频文件 URL（如果存在）
 148 |     func audioURL(for item: HistoryItem) -> URL? {
 149 |         guard let audioPath = item.audioPath else { return nil }
 150 |         let url = audioStorageURL.appendingPathComponent(audioPath)
 151 |         return FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) ? url : nil
 152 |     }
 153 |     
 154 |     // MARK: - Auto Cleanup
 155 |     
 156 |     /// 清理策略
 157 |     enum CleanupPolicy {
 158 |         case keepDays(Int)      // 保留最近 N 天
 159 |         case keepCount(Int)     // 保留最近 N 条
 160 |         case keepSize(Int)      // 保留最大 N MB
 161 |     }
 162 |     
 163 |     /// 执行自动清理
 164 |     /// - Parameter policy: 清理策略
 165 |     func performCleanup(policy: CleanupPolicy) async {
 166 |         guard let context = modelContext else {
 167 |             logger.error("❌ ModelContext not configured for cleanup")
 168 |             return
 169 |         }
 170 |         
 171 |         let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<HistoryItem>(sortBy: [SortDescriptor(\.createdAt, order: .reverse)])
 172 |         
 173 |         do {
 174 |             let allItems = try context.fetch(descriptor)
 175 |             var itemsToDelete: [HistoryItem] = []
 176 |             
 177 |             switch policy {
 178 |             case .keepDays(let days):
 179 |                 let cutoffDate = Calendar.current.date(byAdding: .day, value: -days, to: Date()) ?? Date()
 180 |                 itemsToDelete = allItems.filter { $0.createdAt < cutoffDate }
 181 |                 
 182 |             case .keepCount(let count):
 183 |                 if allItems.count > count {
 184 |                     itemsToDelete = Array(allItems.dropFirst(count))
 185 |                 }
 186 |                 
 187 |             case .keepSize(let megabytes):
 188 |                 let maxBytes = megabytes * 1024 * 1024
 189 |                 var totalSize = 0
 190 |                 
 191 |                 for item in allItems {
 192 |                     if let audioPath = item.audioPath {
 193 |                         let url = audioStorageURL.appendingPathComponent(audioPath)
 194 |                         if let attrs = try? FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath: url.path),
 195 |                            let size = attrs[.size] as? Int {
 196 |                             totalSize += size
 197 |                         }
 198 |                     }
 199 |                     
 200 |                     if totalSize > maxBytes {
 201 |                         itemsToDelete.append(item)
 202 |                     }
 203 |                 }
 204 |             }
 205 |             
 206 |             // 执行删除
 207 |             for item in itemsToDelete {
 208 |                 deleteItem(item)
 209 |             }
 210 |             
 211 |             if !itemsToDelete.isEmpty {
 212 |                 logger.info("🧹 Cleanup completed: \(itemsToDelete.count) items deleted")
 213 |             }
 214 |             
 215 |         } catch {
 216 |             logger.error("❌ Cleanup failed: \(error.localizedDescription)")
 217 |         }
 218 |     }
 219 |     
 220 |     /// 获取存储统计信息
 221 |     func getStorageStats() async -> (count: Int, totalSize: Int64) {
 222 |         guard let context = modelContext else { return (0, 0) }
 223 |         
 224 |         let descriptor = FetchDescriptor<HistoryItem>()
 225 |         
 226 |         do {
 227 |             let items = try context.fetch(descriptor)
 228 |             var totalSize: Int64 = 0
 229 |             
 230 |             for item in items {
 231 |                 if let audioPath = item.audioPath {
 232 |                     let url = audioStorageURL.appendingPathComponent(audioPath)
 233 |                     if let attrs = try? FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath: url.path),
 234 |                        let size = attrs[.size] as? Int64 {
 235 |                         totalSize += size
 236 |                     }
 237 |                 }
 238 |             }
 239 |             
 240 |             return (items.count, totalSize)
 241 |         } catch {
 242 |             return (0, 0)
 243 |         }
 244 |     }
 245 |     
 246 |     // MARK: - Private
 247 |     
 248 |     private func getAudioDuration(url: URL) async -> TimeInterval? {
 249 |         await Task.detached(priority: .utility) {
 250 |             let asset = AVURLAsset(url: url)
 251 |             do {
 252 |                 let duration = try await asset.load(.duration)
 253 |                 return duration.seconds.isNaN ? nil : duration.seconds
 254 |             } catch {
 255 |                 return nil
 256 |             }
 257 |         }.value
 258 |     }
 259 | }

 153 |     // MARK: - Public API
 154 |     
 155 |     /// 注册全局快捷键
 156 |     func register() {
 157 |         // 创建事件监听
 158 |         let eventMask = (1 << CGEventType.keyDown.rawValue) | (1 << CGEventType.keyUp.rawValue) | (1 << CGEventType.flagsChanged.rawValue)
 159 |         
 160 |         guard let tap = CGEvent.tapCreate(
 161 |             tap: .cgSessionEventTap,
 162 |             place: .headInsertEventTap,
 163 |             options: .defaultTap,
 164 |             eventsOfInterest: CGEventMask(eventMask),
 165 |             callback: { proxy, type, event, refcon in
 166 |                 guard let refcon = refcon else { return Unmanaged.passRetained(event) }
 167 |                 let service = Unmanaged<HotKeyService>.fromOpaque(refcon).takeUnretainedValue()
 168 |                 return service.handleEvent(proxy: proxy, type: type, event: event)
 169 |             },
 170 |             userInfo: Unmanaged.passUnretained(self).toOpaque()
 171 |         ) else {
 172 |             logger.warning("⚠️ Failed to create event tap. Check Accessibility permissions.")
 173 |             return
 174 |         }
 175 |         
 176 |         eventTap = tap
 177 |         runLoopSource = CFMachPortCreateRunLoopSource(kCFAllocatorDefault, tap, 0)
 178 |         
 179 |         if let source = runLoopSource {
 180 |             CFRunLoopAddSource(CFRunLoopGetCurrent(), source, .commonModes)
 181 |             CGEvent.tapEnable(tap: tap, enable: true)
 182 |             logger.info("✅ HotKey registered: \(AppSettings.shared.shortcutDisplayString)")
 183 |         }
 184 |     }
 185 |     
 186 |     /// 注销快捷键
 187 |     func unregister() {
 188 |         if let tap = eventTap {
 189 |             CGEvent.tapEnable(tap: tap, enable: false)
 190 |         }
 191 |         if let source = runLoopSource {
 192 |             CFRunLoopRemoveSource(CFRunLoopGetCurrent(), source, .commonModes)
 193 |         }
 194 |         eventTap = nil
 195 |         runLoopSource = nil
 196 |     }

 198 |     // MARK: - Private
 199 |     
 200 |     /// 是否启用调试日志（用于排查输入法问题）
 201 |     var debugKeyEvents = false
 202 |     
 203 |     private func handleEvent(proxy: CGEventTapProxy, type: CGEventType, event: CGEvent) -> Unmanaged<CGEvent>? {
 204 |         // 处理 tap 被系统禁用的情况（超时或其他原因）
 205 |         if type == .tapDisabledByTimeout || type == .tapDisabledByUserInput {
 206 |             // 🔥 如果是 Quick Ask 主动禁用的，不要自动重新启用！
 207 |             if isQuickAskActive {
 208 |                 print("🔥 Event tap disabled event received, but Quick Ask is active - NOT re-enabling")
 209 |                 return Unmanaged.passRetained(event)
 210 |             }
 211 |             logger.warning("⚠️ Event tap was disabled by system, re-enabling...")
 212 |             if let tap = eventTap {
 213 |                 CGEvent.tapEnable(tap: tap, enable: true)
 214 |             }
 215 |             return Unmanaged.passRetained(event)
 216 |         }
 217 |         
 218 |         // 🔥🔥🔥 Quick Ask 激活时，完全不处理任何键盘事件（除了 Quick Ask 快捷键本身）
 219 |         // 这是解决输入法问题的关键：让事件完全绕过 event tap
 220 |         if isQuickAskActive {
 221 |             let keyCode = UInt32(event.getIntegerValueField(.keyboardEventKeycode))
 222 |             let flags = event.flags
 223 |             
 224 |             // 只处理 Quick Ask 快捷键（用于再次按下发送）
 225 |             let isQuickAskModifiersPressed = checkModifiersMatch(flags: flags, target: quickAskModifiers)
 226 |             let isQuickAskKey = keyCode == quickAskKeyCode
 227 |             
 228 |             if type == .keyDown && isQuickAskKey && isQuickAskModifiersPressed {
 229 |                 handleQuickAskKeyDown()
 230 |                 return nil
 231 |             }
 232 |             
 233 |             // 其他所有事件都直接放行，不做任何处理
 234 |             return Unmanaged.passRetained(event)
 235 |         }
 236 |         
 237 |         let keyCode = UInt32(event.getIntegerValueField(.keyboardEventKeycode))
 238 |         let flags = event.flags
 239 |         
 240 |         // 调试日志（直接 print 到终端，方便调试）
 241 |         if debugKeyEvents && (type == .keyDown || type == .keyUp) {
 242 |             let typeStr = type == .keyDown ? "↓" : "↑"
 243 |             let char = keyCodeToChar(keyCode)
 244 |             let modStr = flagsToString(flags)
 245 |             let qaState = self.isQuickAskActive
 246 |             let recState = self.isRecording
 247 |             // 检查 tap 是否应该被禁用
 248 |             let tapEnabled = eventTap != nil ? CGEvent.tapIsEnabled(tap: eventTap!) : false
 249 |             print("🔑 \(typeStr) key=\(keyCode)(\(char)) mod=[\(modStr)] qa=\(qaState) tap=\(tapEnabled ? "ON" : "OFF")")
 250 |         }
 251 |         
 252 |         // 检查是否是录音快捷键
 253 |         let isRecordingModifiersPressed = checkModifiersMatch(flags: flags, target: currentModifiers)
 254 |         let isRecordingKey = keyCode == currentKeyCode
 255 |         
 256 |         // 检查是否是 Quick Ask 快捷键
 257 |         let isQuickAskModifiersPressed = checkModifiersMatch(flags: flags, target: quickAskModifiers)
 258 |         let isQuickAskKey = keyCode == quickAskKeyCode
 259 |         
 260 |         // 检查是否是 Message Panel 快捷键
 261 |         let isMessagePanelModifiersPressed = checkModifiersMatch(flags: flags, target: messagePanelModifiers)
 262 |         let isMessagePanelKey = keyCode == messagePanelKeyCode
 263 |         
 264 |         // 检查是否是 Cmd+逗号 (打开设置)
 265 |         let isCommandPressed = checkModifiersMatch(flags: flags, target: .command)
 266 |         let isCommaKey = keyCode == UInt32(kVK_ANSI_Comma)
 267 |         
 268 |         switch type {
 269 |         case .keyDown:
 270 |             // Cmd+逗号 打开设置（仅当应用在前台时响应）
 271 |             if isCommaKey && isCommandPressed {
 272 |                 if NSApp.isActive {
 273 |                     handleOpenSettings()
 274 |                     return nil
 275 |                 }
 276 |                 // 应用不在前台，放行给其他应用
 277 |                 return Unmanaged.passRetained(event)
 278 |             }
 279 |             
 280 |             // Quick Ask 快捷键
 281 |             if isQuickAskKey && isQuickAskModifiersPressed {
 282 |                 handleQuickAskKeyDown()
 283 |                 return nil
 284 |             }
 285 |             
 286 |             // Message Panel 快捷键
 287 |             if isMessagePanelKey && isMessagePanelModifiersPressed {
 288 |                 handleMessagePanelToggle()
 289 |                 return nil
 290 |             }
 291 |             
 292 |             // 录音快捷键
 293 |             if isRecordingKey && isRecordingModifiersPressed {
 294 |                 handleKeyDown()
 295 |                 return nil
 296 |             }
 297 |             
 298 |             return Unmanaged.passRetained(event)
 299 |             
 300 |         case .keyUp:
 301 |             // Quick Ask keyUp - 必须同时检查修饰键，否则会吞掉普通输入的 keyUp 事件
 302 |             if isQuickAskKey && isQuickAskModifiersPressed && isQuickAskActive {
 303 |                 // Quick Ask 不响应 keyUp（只用 keyDown 触发发送）
 304 |                 return nil
 305 |             }
 306 |             
 307 |             // 录音 keyUp - 同样需要检查修饰键
 308 |             if isRecordingKey && isRecordingModifiersPressed && isRecording {
 309 |                 handleKeyUp()
 310 |                 return nil
 311 |             }
 312 |             
 313 |             return Unmanaged.passRetained(event)
 314 |             
 315 |         case .flagsChanged:
 316 |             // 监听修饰键松开（仅针对录音模式）
 317 |             // 多显示器/Space切换时 macOS 会发送虚假的 flagsChanged 事件
 318 |             // 使用延迟二次确认机制：等待 100ms 后再次检查修饰键状态
 319 |             if !isRecordingModifiersPressed && isRecording && !isQuickAskActive {
 320 |                 scheduleModifierReleaseCheck()
 321 |             }
 322 |             return Unmanaged.passRetained(event)
 323 |             
 324 |         default:
 325 |             break
 326 |         }
 327 |         
 328 |         return Unmanaged.passRetained(event)
 329 |     }
 330 |     
 331 |     /// 检查当前按下的修饰键是否匹配目标配置（严格匹配）
 332 |     private func checkModifiersMatch(flags: CGEventFlags, target: NSEvent.ModifierFlags) -> Bool {
 333 |         // 提取当前按下的所有修饰键
 334 |         var currentFlags: NSEvent.ModifierFlags = []
 335 |         
 336 |         if flags.contains(.maskAlternate) { currentFlags.insert(.option) }
 337 |         if flags.contains(.maskCommand) { currentFlags.insert(.command) }
 338 |         if flags.contains(.maskControl) { currentFlags.insert(.control) }
 339 |         if flags.contains(.maskShift) { currentFlags.insert(.shift) }
 340 |         
 341 |         // 提取目标修饰键（只关心主要的四个：opt, cmd, ctrl, shift）
 342 |         let targetFlags = target.intersection([.option, .command, .control, .shift])
 343 |         
 344 |         // 必须完全相等（不能多按，也不能少按）
 345 |         return currentFlags == targetFlags
 346 |     }

 386 |     /// flags 转字符串（调试用）
 387 |     private func flagsToString(_ flags: CGEventFlags) -> String {
 388 |         var parts: [String] = []
 389 |         if flags.contains(.maskCommand) { parts.append("⌘") }
 390 |         if flags.contains(.maskAlternate) { parts.append("⌥") }
 391 |         if flags.contains(.maskControl) { parts.append("⌃") }
 392 |         if flags.contains(.maskShift) { parts.append("⇧") }
 393 |         return parts.isEmpty ? "none" : parts.joined()
 394 |     }
 395 |     
 396 |     // MARK: - Modifier Release Check (Multi-Display Fix)
 397 |     
 398 |     /// 延迟检查修饰键是否真的松开（修复多屏切换时的虚假事件）
 399 |     private func scheduleModifierReleaseCheck() {
 400 |         // 取消之前的检查（防抖）
 401 |         flagsDebounceWorkItem?.cancel()
 402 |         
 403 |         let workItem = DispatchWorkItem { [weak self] in
 404 |             guard let self = self else { return }
 405 |             
 406 |             // 100ms 后再次检查当前修饰键状态
 407 |             let currentFlags = NSEvent.modifierFlags
 408 |             let targetFlags = self.currentModifiers.intersection([.option, .command, .control, .shift])
 409 |             
 410 |             var actualFlags: NSEvent.ModifierFlags = []
 411 |             if currentFlags.contains(.option) { actualFlags.insert(.option) }
 412 |             if currentFlags.contains(.command) { actualFlags.insert(.command) }
 413 |             if currentFlags.contains(.control) { actualFlags.insert(.control) }
 414 |             if currentFlags.contains(.shift) { actualFlags.insert(.shift) }
 415 |             
 416 |             // 如果修饰键确实已松开，才停止录音
 417 |             if actualFlags != targetFlags {
 418 |                 self.logger.info("🔍 Modifier release confirmed after delay check")
 419 |                 self.handleRelease()
 420 |             } else {
 421 |                 self.logger.info("🔍 Modifier still held, ignoring false flagsChanged event (multi-display fix)")
 422 |             }
 423 |         }
 424 |         
 425 |         flagsDebounceWorkItem = workItem
 426 |         DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.1, execute: workItem)
 427 |     }

 488 |             if actualState != shouldEnable {

 505 |     // MARK: - Recording Handlers
 506 |     
 507 |     private func handleKeyDown() {
 508 |         // CGEvent 回调不在主线程，所有状态访问需要在主线程进行
 509 |         DispatchQueue.main.async { [weak self] in
 510 |             guard let self = self else { return }
 511 |             
 512 |             if !self.isRecording {
 513 |                 // 开始录音
 514 |                 self.isRecording = true
 515 |                 self.recordingStartTime = Date()
 516 |                 self.isToggleSession = false
 517 |                 self.onRecordingStart?()
 518 |             } else {
 519 |                 // 正在录音中
 520 |                 if self.isToggleSession {
 521 |                     // 如果已经是 Toggle 模式（之前短按触发），再次按下则停止
 522 |                     self.isRecording = false
 523 |                     self.isToggleSession = false
 524 |                     self.recordingStartTime = nil
 525 |                     self.onRecordingStop?()
 526 |                 }
 527 |                 // 如果是 Hold 模式（正在按住），忽略重复的 KeyDown
 528 |             }
 529 |         }
 530 |     }
 531 |     
 532 |     private func handleKeyUp() {
 533 |         // keyUp 是明确的结束信号，取消任何待执行的防抖检查
 534 |         flagsDebounceWorkItem?.cancel()
 535 |         flagsDebounceWorkItem = nil
 536 |         handleRelease()
 537 |     }
 538 |     
 539 |     private func handleRelease() {
 540 |         // CGEvent 回调不在主线程，所有状态访问需要在主线程进行
 541 |         DispatchQueue.main.async { [weak self] in
 542 |             guard let self = self else { return }
 543 |             guard self.isRecording else { return }
 544 |             
 545 |             if self.isToggleSession {
 546 |                 // Toggle 模式下，松开键不停止录音
 547 |                 return
 548 |             }
 549 |             
 550 |             // 检查按压时长
 551 |             guard let startTime = self.recordingStartTime else { return }
 552 |             let duration = Date().timeIntervalSince(startTime)
 553 |             
 554 |             if duration < self.holdThreshold {
 555 |                 // 短按：切换到 Toggle 模式，继续录音
 556 |                 self.isToggleSession = true
 557 |                 self.logger.info("👆 Short press (\(String(format: "%.2f", duration))s) detected. Switched to Toggle mode.")
 558 |             } else {
 559 |                 // 长按：松手即停止
 560 |                 self.logger.info("✋ Long press (\(String(format: "%.2f", duration))s) released. Stopping.")
 561 |                 self.isRecording = false
 562 |                 self.isToggleSession = false
 563 |                 self.recordingStartTime = nil
 564 |                 self.onRecordingStop?()
 565 |             }
 566 |         }
 567 |     }
 568 |     
 569 |     
 570 |     /// 强制重置状态（用于异常恢复）
 571 |     func resetState() {
 572 |         isRecording = false
 573 |         isToggleSession = false
 574 |         recordingStartTime = nil
 575 |         logger.info("🔄 HotKey state reset")
 576 |     }
 577 | }

  88 |         let fullText = finalizedText + volatileText
  89 |         
  90 |         // 如果文本没变化，不做任何事（等计时器触发）
  91 |         if fullText == lastSeenText {
  92 |             return
  93 |         }
  94 |         
  95 |         // 文本变化了，取消之前的计时器
  96 |         stabilityTimer?.cancel()
  97 |         
  98 |         // 更新待输入的文本
  99 |         pendingText = fullText
 100 |         lastSeenText = fullText
 101 |         
 102 |         // 启动新的延迟计时器
 103 |         stabilityTimer = Task { [weak self] in
 104 |             do {
 105 |                 // 等待 500ms
 106 |                 try await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: (self?.stabilityDelayMs ?? 500) * 1_000_000)
 107 |                 
 108 |                 // 检查是否被取消
 109 |                 if Task.isCancelled { return }
 110 |                 
 111 |                 // 500ms 过去了，文本稳定，可以输入
 112 |                 self?.flushPendingText()
 113 |                 
 114 |             } catch {
 115 |                 // Task 被取消，正常情况
 116 |             }
 117 |         }
 118 |     }
 119 |     
 120 |     /// 强制刷新待输入的文本（录音结束时调用）
 121 |     func flushPendingText() {
 122 |         guard !pendingText.isEmpty else { return }
 123 |         
 124 |         // 取消计时器
 125 |         stabilityTimer?.cancel()
 126 |         stabilityTimer = nil
 127 |         
 128 |         // 简单策略：只输入超出已输入长度的新内容
 129 |         // 这样可以避免重复输入，但可能在纠正时漏掉中间变化的部分
 130 |         // 权衡：宁可漏掉，不要重复
 131 |         
 132 |         if lastTypedText.isEmpty {
 133 |             // 第一次输入
 134 |             postUnicodeString(pendingText)
 135 |             logger.info("⌨️ First input: \(self.pendingText)")
 136 |         } else if pendingText.count > lastTypedText.count {
 137 |             // 有新增内容：只输入超出已输入长度的部分
 138 |             let newLength = pendingText.count - lastTypedText.count
 139 |             let newContent = String(pendingText.suffix(newLength))
 140 |             
 141 |             if !newContent.isEmpty {
 142 |                 postUnicodeString(newContent)
 143 |                 logger.info("⌨️ Delayed input: +\(newContent)")
 144 |             }
 145 |         } else {
 146 |             // 文本变短或长度相同但内容变了（纠正）
 147 |             // 不输入任何内容，避免重复
 148 |             logger.debug("⌨️ Text corrected/shortened, skipping to avoid duplicates")
 149 |         }
 150 |         
 151 |         lastTypedText = pendingText
 152 |         pendingText = ""
 153 |     }
 154 |     
 155 |     /// 找到两个字符串的公共前缀长度
 156 |     private func findCommonPrefixLength(_ a: String, _ b: String) -> Int {
 157 |         let aChars = Array(a)
 158 |         let bChars = Array(b)
 159 |         let minLen = min(aChars.count, bChars.count)
 160 |         
 161 |         for i in 0..<minLen {
 162 |             if aChars[i] != bChars[i] {
 163 |                 return i
 164 |             }
 165 |         }
 166 |         return minLen
 167 |     }
 168 |     
 169 |     /// 检查辅助功能权限
 170 |     static func checkAccessibilityPermission() -> Bool {
 171 |         // 检查是否有辅助功能权限（CGEvent 需要）
 172 |         let trusted = AXIsProcessTrusted()
 173 |         return trusted
 174 |     }
 175 |     
 176 |     /// 请求辅助功能权限
 177 |     static func requestAccessibilityPermission() {
 178 |         let options = [kAXTrustedCheckOptionPrompt.takeUnretainedValue() as String: true] as CFDictionary
 179 |         AXIsProcessTrustedWithOptions(options)
 180 |     }
 181 |     
 182 |     // MARK: - Private
 183 |     
 184 |     /// 使用 CGEvent 发送 Unicode 字符串
 185 |     private func postUnicodeString(_ string: String) {
 186 |         guard !string.isEmpty else { return }
 187 |         
 188 |         let source = CGEventSource(stateID: .hidSystemState)
 189 |         
 190 |         // 将字符串转换为 UTF-16 数组
 191 |         var chars = Array(string.utf16)
 192 |         
 193 |         // 创建 Key Down 事件
 194 |         guard let keyDown = CGEvent(keyboardEventSource: source, virtualKey: 0, keyDown: true) else {
 195 |             logger.error("❌ Failed to create key down event")
 196 |             return
 197 |         }
 198 |         
 199 |         // 设置 Unicode 字符串
 200 |         keyDown.keyboardSetUnicodeString(stringLength: chars.count, unicodeString: &chars)
 201 |         
 202 |         // 发送事件
 203 |         keyDown.post(tap: .cghidEventTap)
 204 |         
 205 |         // 创建 Key Up 事件
 206 |         if let keyUp = CGEvent(keyboardEventSource: source, virtualKey: 0, keyDown: false) {
 207 |             keyUp.post(tap: .cghidEventTap)
 208 |         }
 209 |     }
 210 |     
 211 |     /// 模拟按下退格键（危险操作，暂不使用）
 212 |     /// - Parameter count: 退格次数
 213 |     private func postBackspace(count: Int) {
 214 |         guard count > 0 else { return }
 215 |         
 216 |         let source = CGEventSource(stateID: .hidSystemState)
 217 |         let backspaceKeyCode: CGKeyCode = 51  // kVK_Delete
 218 |         
 219 |         for _ in 0..<count {
 220 |             if let keyDown = CGEvent(keyboardEventSource: source, virtualKey: backspaceKeyCode, keyDown: true) {
 221 |                 keyDown.post(tap: .cghidEventTap)
 222 |             }
 223 |             if let keyUp = CGEvent(keyboardEventSource: source, virtualKey: backspaceKeyCode, keyDown: false) {
 224 |                 keyUp.post(tap: .cghidEventTap)
 225 |             }
 226 |             
 227 |             // 小延迟避免按键丢失
 228 |             usleep(1000)  // 1ms
 229 |         }
 230 |     }
 231 | }

  93 |

  95 |         let screen = screenWithMouse() ?? NSScreen.main ?? NSScreen.screens.first!
  96 |         let screenFrame = screen.visibleFrame
  97 |

 117 |         
 118 |         // 获取鼠标所在屏幕
 119 |         let screen = screenWithMouse() ?? NSScreen.main ?? NSScreen.screens.first!
 120 |         let screenFrame = screen.visibleFrame
 121 |         
 122 |         // 更新面板高度以适应屏幕
 123 |         let panelWidth = panel.frame.width
 124 |         let panelHeight = screenFrame.height
 125 |         
 126 |         // 左边缘，垂直居中
 127 |         let x = screenFrame.minX
 128 |         let y = screenFrame.minY
 129 |         
 130 |         panel.setFrame(NSRect(x: x, y: y, width: panelWidth, height: panelHeight), display: true)
 131 |     }
 132 |     
 133 |     /// 获取鼠标所在屏幕
 134 |     private func screenWithMouse() -> NSScreen? {
 135 |         let mouseLocation = NSEvent.mouseLocation
 136 |         return NSScreen.screens.first { screen in
 137 |             NSMouseInRect(mouseLocation, screen.frame, false)
 138 |         }
 139 |     }

  75 |

  96 |     /// 发送问题
  97 |     func sendQuestion() async {
  98 |         // 停止录音
  99 |         stopRecording()
 100 |         
 101 |         // 切换到发送状态
 102 |         state.startSending()

 216 |     /// 构建发送给 LLM 的 prompt
 217 |     private func buildPrompt() -> String {
 218 |         var parts: [String] = []
 219 |         
 220 |         // 用户输入
 221 |         let userInput = state.userInput.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
 222 |         if !userInput.isEmpty {

 224 |         }

 228 |         if !voiceText.isEmpty {

 230 |             
 231 |             // 如果同时有用户输入和语音，添加提示
 232 |             if !userInput.isEmpty {
 233 |                 parts.append("> 注意：语音转写可能存在偏差（如专业术语、人名等），请结合用户输入理解真实意图。")
 234 |             }
 235 |         }
 236 |         
 237 |         // 附件说明
 238 |         if !state.attachments.isEmpty {
 239 |             var attachmentParts: [String] = []
 240 |             var textBundleContents: [String] = []
 241 |             
 242 |             for attachment in state.attachments {
 243 |                 switch attachment {
 244 |                 case .image:
 245 |                     attachmentParts.append("[图片]")
 246 |                 case .screenshot:
 247 |                     attachmentParts.append("[截图]")
 248 |                 case .file(let url, _):
 249 |                     attachmentParts.append("[文件: \(url.lastPathComponent)]")
 250 |                 case .textBundle(let content, let source, let count, _):
 251 |                     attachmentParts.append("[代码包: \(source) (\(count) 文件)]")
 252 |                     textBundleContents.append("### \(source)\n\(content)")
 253 |                 }
 254 |             }
 255 |             
 256 |             parts.append("## 附件\n\(attachmentParts.joined(separator: ", "))")
 257 |             
 258 |             // 添加文本包内容
 259 |             if !textBundleContents.isEmpty {
 260 |                 parts.append("## 代码/文档内容\n\(textBundleContents.joined(separator: "\n\n---\n\n"))")
 261 |             }
 262 |         }
 263 |         
 264 |         return parts.joined(separator: "\n\n")
 265 |     }

 331 |         state.startSession(targetApp: targetApp)
 332 |         
 333 |         panel?.positionAtBottomCenter()
 334 |         
 335 |         // 🔥 第三步：先显示窗口
 336 |         panel?.orderFront(nil)
 337 |         
 338 |         // 🔥 第四步：延迟一帧再激活（等待窗口完全显示）
 339 |         DispatchQueue.main.async { [weak self] in
 340 |             guard let panel = self?.panel else { return }
 341 |             
 342 |             // 激活应用（强制激活，忽略其他应用）
 343 |             NSApp.activate(ignoringOtherApps: true)
 344 |             
 345 |             // 让窗口成为 key window 和 main window
 346 |             panel.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
 347 |             panel.makeMain()
 348 |             
 349 |             print("📱 QuickAskService.show() activated, isKeyWindow: \(panel.isKeyWindow), isMainWindow: \(panel.isMainWindow)")
 350 |         }
 351 |     }
 352 |     
 353 |     func hide() {
 354 |         // 关闭按键调试日志
 355 |         HotKeyService.shared.debugKeyEvents = false
 356 |         
 357 |         // 🔥 重新启用 event tap
 358 |         HotKeyService.shared.setQuickAskActive(false)
 359 |         
 360 |         NSAnimationContext.runAnimationGroup { context in
 361 |             context.duration = 0.3
 362 |             panel?.animator().alphaValue = 0
 363 |         } completionHandler: { [weak self] in
 364 |             Task { @MainActor in
 365 |                 self?.panel?.orderOut(nil)
 366 |                 self?.panel?.alphaValue = 1
 367 |                 // 恢复为辅助应用模式
 368 |                 NSApp.setActivationPolicy(.accessory)
 369 |             }
 370 |         }
 371 |     }
 372 |     
 373 |     func fail(with message: String) {
 374 |         state.fail(with: message)
 375 |         DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 2.0) { [weak self] in
 376 |             self?.hide()
 377 |             self?.state.reset()
 378 |         }
 379 |     }
 380 |     
 381 |     // MARK: - Private
 382 |     
 383 |     private func createPanelIfNeeded() {
 384 |         guard panel == nil else { return }
 385 |         
 386 |         var contentView = QuickAskCapsuleView(state: state)
 387 |         contentView.onSend = { [weak self] in
 388 |             self?.onSend?()
 389 |         }
 390 |         contentView.onCancel = { [weak self] in
 391 |             self?.onCancel?()
 392 |         }
 393 |         
 394 |         let framedView = contentView
 395 |             .frame(width: Self.fixedWindowWidth, height: Self.fixedWindowHeight, alignment: .bottom)
 396 |         
 397 |         let hostingView = NSHostingView(rootView: framedView)
 398 |         
 399 |         let frame = NSRect(
 400 |             origin: .zero,
 401 |             size: NSSize(width: Self.fixedWindowWidth, height: Self.fixedWindowHeight)
 402 |         )
 403 |         
 404 |         let newPanel = QuickAskPanel(contentRect: frame)
 405 |         newPanel.contentView = hostingView
 406 |         
 407 |         self.panel = newPanel
 408 |     }
 409 | }

 282 |     // MARK: - Processing
 283 |     
 284 |     private func processTranscription() {
 285 |         Task {
 286 |             // 等待最终结果（最多等待 2 秒，每 100ms 检查一次）
 287 |             var waitTime = 0
 288 |             while waitTime < Self.maxWaitForFinalResult {
 289 |                 try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(Self.checkInterval))
 290 |                 waitTime += Self.checkInterval
 291 |                 // 如果处理已完成，提前退出
 292 |                 if !audioService.isProcessing { break }
 293 |             }
 294 |             
 295 |             let transcribedText = lastTranscription
 296 |             
 297 |             if transcribedText.isEmpty {
 298 |                 hudManager.fail(with: "未检测到语音")
 299 |                 hotKeyService.resetState()
 300 |                 return
 301 |             }
 302 |             
 303 |             // 第一次写入剪贴板（原始转写文本）
 304 |             copyToClipboard(transcribedText)
 305 |             logger.info("📋 Clipboard #1: transcribed text")
 306 |             
 307 |             // 发送 ASR 结果到 Message Panel
 308 |             MessagePanelManager.shared.addASRResult(
 309 |                 model: "Apple Speech",
 310 |                 content: transcribedText
 311 |             )
 312 |             
 313 |             // 获取临时音频文件 URL
 314 |             let tempAudioURL = audioService.tempAudioFileURL
 315 |             let appBundleId = contextService.getCurrentTargetApp()?.bundleIdentifier
 316 |             
 317 |             // 检查是否需要 LLM 处理
 318 |             guard llmPipeline.shouldProcess else {
 319 |                 // 不需要 LLM，直接完成
 320 |                 hudManager.complete(with: transcribedText)
 321 |                 
 322 |                 // 保存到历史记录
 323 |                 await historyManager.saveRecording(
 324 |                     rawText: transcribedText,
 325 |                     processedText: nil,
 326 |                     tempAudioURL: tempAudioURL,
 327 |                     appBundleId: appBundleId
 328 |                 )
 329 |                 
 330 |                 hotKeyService.resetState()
 331 |                 logger.info("✅ Transcription complete (no LLM): \(transcribedText)")
 332 |                 return
 333 |             }
 334 |             
 335 |             // 已经在 thinking 状态了（stopRecordingSession 时已切换）
 336 |             // 调用 LLM 精炼
 337 |             let result = await llmPipeline.refine(transcribedText)
 338 |             
 339 |             var processedText: String?
 340 |             
 341 |             switch result {
 342 |             case .success(let refinedText):
 343 |                 // 第二次写入剪贴板（精炼后文本）
 344 |                 copyToClipboard(refinedText)
 345 |                 logger.info("📋 Clipboard #2: refined text")
 346 |                 
 347 |                 // 发送 LLM 结果到 Message Panel
 348 |                 MessagePanelManager.shared.addLLMResult(
 349 |                     model: llmPipeline.currentProviderName,
 350 |                     content: refinedText
 351 |                 )
 352 |                 
 353 |                 // 完成
 354 |                 hudManager.complete(with: refinedText)
 355 |                 processedText = refinedText
 356 |                 logger.info("✅ LLM refinement complete: \(refinedText)")
 357 |                 
 358 |             case .failure(let error):
 359 |                 // LLM 失败，保留原始文本
 360 |                 logger.error("❌ LLM failed: \(error.localizedDescription)")
 361 |                 hudManager.complete(with: transcribedText)
 362 |                 logger.info("⚠️ Fallback to transcribed text")
 363 |             }
 364 |             
 365 |             // 保存到历史记录（替代临时文件清理）
 366 |             await historyManager.saveRecording(
 367 |                 rawText: transcribedText,
 368 |                 processedText: processedText,
 369 |                 tempAudioURL: tempAudioURL,
 370 |                 appBundleId: appBundleId
 371 |             )
 372 |             
 373 |             // 确保热键状态已重置（防止异常情况）
 374 |             hotKeyService.resetState()
 375 |         }
 376 |     }
 377 |     
 378 |     private func copyToClipboard(_ text: String) {
 379 |         NSPasteboard.general.clearContents()
 380 |         NSPasteboard.general.setString(text, forType: .string)
 381 |     }
 382 | }

 174 | // MARK: - Attachment Type (简化版，用于测试)
 175 | 
 176 | import UniformTypeIdentifiers
 177 | 
 178 | enum Attachment: Identifiable, Equatable {
 179 |     case image(NSImage, NSImage?, UUID)
 180 |     case screenshot(NSImage, NSImage?, UUID)
 181 |     case file(URL, UUID)
 182 |     case textBundle(String, String, Int, UUID)
 183 |     
 184 |     var id: UUID {
 185 |         switch self {
 186 |         case .image(_, _, let id), .screenshot(_, _, let id),
 187 |              .file(_, let id), .textBundle(_, _, _, let id):
 188 |             return id
 189 |         }
 190 |     }
 191 |     
 192 |     var thumbnail: NSImage? {
 193 |         switch self {
 194 |         case .image(_, let thumb, _), .screenshot(_, let thumb, _): return thumb
 195 |         default: return nil
 196 |         }
 197 |     }
 198 |     
 199 |     var originalImage: NSImage? {
 200 |         switch self {
 201 |         case .image(let img, _, _), .screenshot(let img, _, _): return img
 202 |         default: return nil
 203 |         }
 204 |     }
 205 |     
 206 |     var fileName: String? {
 207 |         switch self {
 208 |         case .file(let url, _): return url.lastPathComponent
 209 |         case .textBundle(_, let source, _, _): return source
 210 |         default: return nil
 211 |         }
 212 |     }
 213 |     
 214 |     var displayTitle: String {
 215 |         switch self {
 216 |         case .image: return "图片"
 217 |         case .screenshot: return "截图"
 218 |         case .file(let url, _): return url.lastPathComponent
 219 |         case .textBundle(_, let source, let count, _): return "\(source) (\(count) 文件)"
 220 |         }
 221 |     }
 222 |     
 223 |     var isVideo: Bool {
 224 |         if case .file(let url, _) = self,
 225 |            let uti = UTType(filenameExtension: url.pathExtension) {
 226 |             return uti.conforms(to: .movie) || uti.conforms(to: .video)
 227 |         }
 228 |         return false
 229 |     }
 230 |     
 231 |     var isTextBundle: Bool {
 232 |         if case .textBundle = self { return true }
 233 |         return false
 234 |     }
 235 |     
 236 |     var textContent: String? {
 237 |         if case .textBundle(let content, _, _, _) = self { return content }
 238 |         return nil
 239 |     }
 240 |     
 241 |     static func == (lhs: Attachment, rhs: Attachment) -> Bool { lhs.id == rhs.id }
 242 |     
 243 |     static func makeThumbnail(from image: NSImage, maxSize: CGFloat = 256) -> NSImage {
 244 |         let size = image.size
 245 |         guard size.width > 0 && size.height > 0 else { return image }
 246 |         
 247 |         let scale = min(maxSize / size.width, maxSize / size.height, 1.0)
 248 |         let newSize = NSSize(width: size.width * scale, height: size.height * scale)
 249 |         
 250 |         let thumbnail = NSImage(size: newSize)
 251 |         thumbnail.lockFocus()
 252 |         image.draw(in: NSRect(origin: .zero, size: newSize),
 253 |                    from: NSRect(origin: .zero, size: size),
 254 |                    operation: .copy, fraction: 1.0)
 255 |         thumbnail.unlockFocus()
 256 |         return thumbnail
 257 |     }
 258 | }
 259 | 
 260 | // MARK: - Assertion Helpers
 261 | 
 262 | struct TestError: Error, CustomStringConvertible {
 263 |     let message: String
 264 |     init(_ message: String) { self.message = message }
 265 |     var description: String { message }
 266 | }
 267 | 
 268 | func assertEqual<T: Equatable>(_ actual: T, _ expected: T, _ name: String) throws {
 269 |     if actual != expected {
 270 |         throw TestError("\(name): 期望 \(expected), 实际 \(actual)")
 271 |     }
 272 | }
 273 | 
 274 | func assertTrue(_ condition: Bool, _ message: String) throws {
 275 |     if !condition { throw TestError(message) }
 276 | }
 277 | 
 278 | func assertFalse(_ condition: Bool, _ message: String) throws {
 279 |     if condition { throw TestError(message) }
 280 | }
 281 | 
 282 | func assertNil<T>(_ value: T?, _ message: String) throws {
 283 |     if value != nil { throw TestError("\(message) 应该是 nil") }
 284 | }
 285 | 
 286 | func assertNotNil<T>(_ value: T?, _ message: String) throws {
 287 |     if value == nil { throw TestError("\(message) 不应该是 nil") }
 288 | }
 289 | 
 290 | extension String {
 291 |     static func * (string: String, count: Int) -> String {
 292 |         String(repeating: string, count: count)
 293 |     }
 294 | }

  27 |             
  28 |             // 2. 检查音频头
  29 |             print("   音频头部: \(audioData.prefix(16).map { String(format: "%02X", $0) }.joined(separator: " "))")
  30 |             
  31 |             // 3. 保存到文件测试
  32 |             let tempPath = "/tmp/edge_tts_test.mp3"
  33 |             try audioData.write(to: URL(fileURLWithPath: tempPath))
  34 |             print("   ✅ 已保存到: \(tempPath)")
  35 |             
  36 |             // 4. 用 AVAudioPlayer 播放
  37 |             print("   正在播放...")
  38 |             let player = try AVAudioPlayer(contentsOf: URL(fileURLWithPath: tempPath))
  39 |             player.prepareToPlay()
  40 |             player.play()
  41 |             
  42 |             // 等待播放完成
  43 |             while player.isPlaying {
  44 |                 try await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 100_000_000)
  45 |             }
  46 |             print("   ✅ 播放完成!")

  50 |         }

  53 |     /// 合成音频
  54 |     static func synthesize(text: String, voice: String) async throws -> Data {
  55 |         // DRM Token
  56 |         let trustedClientToken = "6A5AA1D4EAFF4E9FB37E23D68491D6F4"
  57 |         let chromiumVersion = "130.0.2849.68"
  58 |         let windowsFileTimeEpoch: Int64 = 11_644_473_600
  59 |         
  60 |         let currentTime = Int64(Date().timeIntervalSince1970)
  61 |         let ticks = (currentTime + windowsFileTimeEpoch) * 10_000_000
  62 |         let roundedTicks = ticks - (ticks % 3_000_000_000)
  63 |         let strToHash = "\(roundedTicks)\(trustedClientToken)"
  64 |         
  65 |         // SHA256
  66 |         import CryptoKit
  67 |         let hash = SHA256.hash(data: strToHash.data(using: .ascii)!)
  68 |         let secMsGec = hash.map { String(format: "%02X", $0) }.joined()
  69 |         
  70 |         // URL
  71 |         let urlString = "wss://speech.platform.bing.com/consumer/speech/synthesize/readaloud/edge/v1?TrustedClientToken=\(trustedClientToken)&Sec-MS-GEC=\(secMsGec)&Sec-MS-GEC-Version=1-\(chromiumVersion)"
  72 |         let url = URL(string: urlString)!
  73 |         
  74 |         // WebSocket
  75 |         var request = URLRequest(url: url)
  76 |         request.setValue("chrome-extension://jdiccldimpdaibmpdkjnbmckianbfold", forHTTPHeaderField: "Origin")
  77 |         request.setValue("Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/\(chromiumVersion) Edg/\(chromiumVersion)", forHTTPHeaderField: "User-Agent")
  78 |         
  79 |         let session = URLSession.shared
  80 |         let ws = session.webSocketTask(with: request)
  81 |         ws.resume()
  82 |         
  83 |         // 等待连接
  84 |         try await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 500_000_000)
  85 |         
  86 |         // 发送配置
  87 |         let configMessage = "Content-Type:application/json; charset=utf-8\r\nPath:speech.config\r\n\r\n{\"context\":{\"synthesis\":{\"audio\":{\"metadataoptions\":{\"sentenceBoundaryEnabled\":\"false\",\"wordBoundaryEnabled\":\"false\"},\"outputFormat\":\"audio-24khz-48kbitrate-mono-mp3\"}}}}"
  88 |         try await ws.send(.string(configMessage))
  89 |         
  90 |         // 发送 SSML
  91 |         let ssml = "<speak version=\"1.0\" xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis\" xml:lang=\"zh-CN\"><voice name=\"\(voice)\"><prosody rate=\"+0%\" pitch=\"+0Hz\">\(text)</prosody></voice></speak>"
  92 |         let ssmlMessage = "X-RequestId:\(UUID().uuidString)\r\nContent-Type:application/ssml+xml\r\nPath:ssml\r\n\r\n\(ssml)"
  93 |         try await ws.send(.string(ssmlMessage))
  94 |         
  95 |         // 接收音频
  96 |         var audioData = Data()
  97 |         
  98 |         while true {
  99 |             let message = try await ws.receive()
 100 |             
 101 |             switch message {
 102 |             case .data(let data):
 103 |                 // 检查是否包含 Path:audio
 104 |                 if let str = String(data: data, encoding: .utf8), str.contains("Path:audio\r\n") {
 105 |                     if let range = str.range(of: "Path:audio\r\n") {
 106 |                         let offset = range.upperBound.utf16Offset(in: str)
 107 |                         audioData.append(data[offset...])
 108 |                     }
 109 |                 } else {

 111 |                 }
 112 |

 116 |                     return audioData
 117 |                 }

 122 |         }

 301 | // MARK: - TextExtractionService (简化版，用于测试)
 302 | 
 303 | struct TextBundle {
 304 |     let content: String
 305 |     let fileCount: Int
 306 |     let sourcePath: String
 307 |     let files: [String]
 308 | }
 309 | 
 310 | enum TextExtractionError: Error, Equatable {
 311 |     case folderNotFound
 312 |     case zipExtractionFailed(String)
 313 |     case noTextFilesFound
 314 |     case accessDenied
 315 | }
 316 | 
 317 | func extractFromFolder(_ folderURL: URL) async -> Result<TextBundle, TextExtractionError> {
 318 |     let codeExtensions: Set<String> = [
 319 |         "js", "jsx", "ts", "tsx", "mjs", "cjs",
 320 |         "html", "htm", "css", "scss", "less", "vue", "svelte",
 321 |         "py", "pyw", "pyi",
 322 |         "java", "kt", "kts", "scala",
 323 |         "c", "cpp", "cc", "cxx", "h", "hpp", "hxx",
 324 |         "rs", "go", "rb", "erb", "php", "swift",
 325 |         "sh", "bash", "zsh", "fish",
 326 |         "json", "yaml", "yml", "toml", "xml", "ini", "cfg", "conf",
 327 |         "md", "mdx", "txt", "rst", "asciidoc",
 328 |         "sql", "graphql", "proto", "dockerfile"
 329 |     ]
 330 |     
 331 |     let excludedDirs: Set<String> = [
 332 |         "node_modules", ".git", ".svn", ".hg",
 333 |         "dist", "build", "target", ".next", ".nuxt",
 334 |         "__pycache__", ".pytest_cache", ".tox",
 335 |         "venv", "env", ".env", ".venv",
 336 |         "vendor", "Pods", "Carthage",
 337 |         ".idea", ".vscode", ".vs"
 338 |     ]
 339 |     
 340 |     let excludedFiles: Set<String> = [
 341 |         ".DS_Store", "Thumbs.db", ".gitignore", ".gitattributes",
 342 |         "package-lock.json", "yarn.lock", "pnpm-lock.yaml",
 343 |         "Podfile.lock", "Gemfile.lock", "Cargo.lock"
 344 |     ]
 345 |     
 346 |     // 递归收集文件
 347 |     func collectFiles(in directory: URL) -> [URL] {
 348 |         var result: [URL] = []
 349 |         let fm = FileManager.default
 350 |         
 351 |         guard let contents = try? fm.contentsOfDirectory(
 352 |             at: directory,
 353 |             includingPropertiesForKeys: [.isRegularFileKey, .isDirectoryKey],
 354 |             options: [.skipsHiddenFiles]
 355 |         ) else { return [] }
 356 |         
 357 |         for url in contents {
 358 |             let fileName = url.lastPathComponent
 359 |             if excludedFiles.contains(fileName) { continue }
 360 |             
 361 |             let values = try? url.resourceValues(forKeys: [.isRegularFileKey, .isDirectoryKey])
 362 |             
 363 |             if values?.isDirectory == true {
 364 |                 if !excludedDirs.contains(fileName) {
 365 |                     result.append(contentsOf: collectFiles(in: url))
 366 |                 }
 367 |             } else if values?.isRegularFile == true {
 368 |                 let ext = url.pathExtension.lowercased()
 369 |                 if codeExtensions.contains(ext) {
 370 |                     result.append(url)
 371 |                 }
 372 |             }
 373 |         }
 374 |         return result.sorted { $0.path < $1.path }
 375 |     }
 376 |     
 377 |     let files = collectFiles(in: folderURL)
 378 |     guard !files.isEmpty else {
 379 |         return .failure(.noTextFilesFound)
 380 |     }
 381 |     
 382 |     // 合并内容
 383 |     var parts: [String] = ["# 目录结构\n```"]
 384 |     for file in files {
 385 |         let rel = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: folderURL.path + "/", with: "")
 386 |         parts.append(rel)
 387 |     }
 388 |     parts.append("```\n\n# 文件内容\n")
 389 |     
 390 |     for file in files {
 391 |         let rel = file.path.replacingOccurrences(of: folderURL.path + "/", with: "")
 392 |         let ext = file.pathExtension
 393 |         if let content = try? String(contentsOf: file, encoding: .utf8) {
 394 |             let numbered = content.components(separatedBy: .newlines).enumerated()
 395 |                 .map { "\($0.offset + 1)│ \($0.element)" }.joined(separator: "\n")
 396 |             parts.append("## \(rel)\n```\(ext)\n\(numbered)\n```\n")
 397 |         }
 398 |     }
 399 |     
 400 |     return .success(TextBundle(
 401 |         content: parts.joined(separator: "\n"),
 402 |         fileCount: files.count,
 403 |         sourcePath: folderURL.path,
 404 |         files: files.map { $0.path }
 405 |     ))
 406 | }
 407 | 
 408 | func extractFromZIP(_ zipURL: URL) async -> Result<TextBundle, TextExtractionError> {
 409 |     let tempDir = FileManager.default.temporaryDirectory.appendingPathComponent("zip-\(UUID().uuidString)")
 410 |     try? FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: tempDir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
 411 |     defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at: tempDir) }
 412 |     
 413 |     let process = Process()
 414 |     process.executableURL = URL(fileURLWithPath: "/usr/bin/unzip")
 415 |     process.arguments = ["-q", "-o", zipURL.path, "-d", tempDir.path]
 416 |     process.standardOutput = FileHandle.nullDevice
 417 |     process.standardError = FileHandle.nullDevice
 418 |     
 419 |     do {
 420 |         try process.run()
 421 |         process.waitUntilExit()
 422 |         
 423 |         guard process.terminationStatus == 0 else {
 424 |             return .failure(.zipExtractionFailed("Exit code: \(process.terminationStatus)"))
 425 |         }
 426 |         
 427 |         return await extractFromFolder(tempDir)
 428 |     } catch {
 429 |         return .failure(.zipExtractionFailed(error.localizedDescription))
 430 |     }
 431 | }
 432 | 
 433 | // MARK: - Helpers
 434 | 
 435 | struct TestError: Error, CustomStringConvertible {
 436 |     let message: String
 437 |     init(_ message: String) { self.message = message }
 438 |     var description: String { message }
 439 | }
 440 | 
 441 | extension String {
 442 |     static func * (string: String, count: Int) -> String {
 443 |         String(repeating: string, count: count)
 444 |     }
 445 | }

  51 | // MARK: - Drop Handler Modifier
  52 | 
  53 | /// 通用拖拽处理修饰符
  54 | struct AttachmentDropHandler: ViewModifier {
  55 |     /// 添加附件的回调
  56 |     let onAdd: (Attachment) -> Void
  57 |     
  58 |     /// 圆角半径（用于蒙版）
  59 |     var cornerRadius: CGFloat = 16
  60 |     
  61 |     @State private var isDragOver = false
  62 |

  64 |

  66 |         content
  67 |             .overlay {
  68 |                 AttachmentDropOverlay(
  69 |                     cornerRadius: cornerRadius,
  70 |                     isVisible: isDragOver
  71 |                 )
  72 |             }
  73 |             .onDrop(of: supportedTypes, isTargeted: $isDragOver) { providers in
  74 |                 handleDrop(providers: providers)
  75 |                 return true
  76 |             }
  77 |     }
  78 |     
  79 |     /// 支持的拖拽类型
  80 |     private var supportedTypes: [UTType] {
  81 |         [.image, .fileURL, .folder, .zip]
  82 |     }
  83 |     
  84 |     private func handleDrop(providers: [NSItemProvider]) {
  85 |         attachmentManager.handleDrop(providers: providers, onAdd: onAdd)
  86 |     }
  87 | }
  88 | 
  89 | // MARK: - View Extension
  90 | 
  91 | extension View {
  92 |     /// 添加通用拖拽处理
  93 |     func attachmentDropHandler(
  94 |         cornerRadius: CGFloat = 16,
  95 |         onAdd: @escaping (Attachment) -> Void
  96 |     ) -> some View {
  97 |         modifier(AttachmentDropHandler(onAdd: onAdd, cornerRadius: cornerRadius))
  98 |     }
  99 | }

   1 | import SwiftUI
   2 | import AppKit
   3 | 
   4 | /// 悬浮面板视图 - Spokenly 风格
   5 | /// 纵向布局：上方文字区域（向上扩展）+ 下方控制栏
   6 | struct FloatingCapsuleView: View {
   7 |     @State private var levels: [Float] = Array(repeating: 0.05, count: 30)
   8 |     @State private var isHovering = false
   9 |     @State private var isHoveringComplete = false
  10 |     @State private var isHoveringCancel = false
  11 |     
  12 |     let state: RecordingState
  13 |     
  14 |     /// 完成录音回调
  15 |     var onComplete: (() -> Void)?
  16 |     /// 取消录音回调
  17 |     var onCancel: (() -> Void)?
  18 |     /// Hover 状态改变回调
  19 |     var onHoverChange: ((Bool) -> Void)?
  20 |     
  21 |     var body: some View {
  22 |         // 外层容器：固定高度，内容从底部向上扩展
  23 |         VStack {
  24 |             Spacer() // 顶部弹性空间，把内容推到底部
  25 |             
  26 |             // 实际内容区域
  27 |             VStack(spacing: 0) {
  28 |                 // 上方：转写文字区域（向上扩展）
  29 |                 // .success 状态也保留文字显示，直到 UI 消失
  30 |                 if state.phase == .recording || state.phase == .processing || state.phase == .thinking || state.phase == .success {
  31 |                     textArea
  32 |                 }
  33 |                 
  34 |                 // 下方：固定控制栏（始终在底部）
  35 |                 controlBar
  36 |             }
  37 |             .opacity((isHovering && state.phase == .recording) ? 0 : 1)
  38 |             // Hover 操作层：用 overlay 自动继承正常内容的尺寸
  39 |             .overlay {
  40 |                 if isHovering && state.phase == .recording {
  41 |                     hoverOverlay
  42 |                         .transition(.opacity)
  43 |                 }
  44 |             }
  45 |             .background(
  46 |             ZStack {
  47 |                 // 毛玻璃底层
  48 |                 VisualEffectBackground(material: .hudWindow, blendingMode: .behindWindow)
  49 |                 
  50 |                 // 深色叠加
  51 |                 Color.black.opacity(0.3)
  52 |                 
  53 |                 // 底部红色晕染 (仅在非 Hover 时显示)
  54 |                 if state.phase == .recording && !isHovering {
  55 |                     VStack {
  56 |                         Spacer()
  57 |                         LinearGradient(
  58 |                             colors: [
  59 |                                 Color.red.opacity(0.25),
  60 |                                 Color.red.opacity(0.08),
  61 |                                 Color.clear
  62 |                             ],
  63 |                             startPoint: .bottom,
  64 |                             endPoint: .top
  65 |                         )
  66 |                         .frame(height: 44)
  67 |                     }
  68 |                 }
  69 |                 
  70 |                 // 顶部微光
  71 |                 VStack {
  72 |                     LinearGradient(
  73 |                         colors: [
  74 |                             Color.white.opacity(0.08),
  75 |                             Color.clear
  76 |                         ],
  77 |                         startPoint: .top,
  78 |                         endPoint: .bottom
  79 |                     )
  80 |                     .frame(height: 30)
  81 |                     Spacer()
  82 |                 }
  83 |             }
  84 |         )
  85 |         .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16))
  86 |         .overlay(
  87 |             // 思考状态：跑马灯边框
  88 |             // 非思考状态：普通边框
  89 |             Group {
  90 |                 if state.phase == .thinking {
  91 |                     RunningLightBorder()
  92 |                 } else {
  93 |                     RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 16)
  94 |                         .strokeBorder(Color.white.opacity(0.1), lineWidth: 0.5)
  95 |                 }
  96 |             }
  97 |         )
  98 |         .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.2), value: isHovering) // Hover 切换动画
  99 |         .onChange(of: state.audioLevel) { _, newLevel in
 100 |             updateWaveform(newLevel)
 101 |         }
 102 |         // 监听整个视图的 Hover 状态
 103 |         .onHover { hovering in
 104 |             withAnimation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.2)) {
 105 |                 isHovering = hovering
 106 |             }
 107 |             onHoverChange?(hovering)
 108 |         }
 109 |         .background {
 110 |             // 隐藏的快捷键监听：Cmd + , 打开设置
 111 |             Button("") {
 112 |                 if let appDelegate = NSApp.delegate as? AppDelegate {
 113 |                     appDelegate.openSettings()
 114 |                 }
 115 |             }
 116 |             .keyboardShortcut(",", modifiers: .command)
 117 |             .hidden()
 118 |         }
 119 |         } // VStack 结束
 120 |     }
 121 |     
 122 |     // MARK: - Text Area (上方，向上扩展)
 123 |     
 124 |     private var textArea: some View {
 125 |         VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 4) {
 126 |             // 转写文字（最新的在底部，可滚动）
 127 |             if !state.partialText.isEmpty {
 128 |                 Text(state.partialText)
 129 |                     .font(.system(size: 14))
 130 |                     .foregroundStyle(HUDTheme.textPrimary)
 131 |                     .lineSpacing(4)
 132 |                     .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
 133 |                     .fixedSize(horizontal: false, vertical: true) // 高度自适应
 134 |             } else if state.phase == .processing {
 135 |                 HStack(spacing: 8) {
 136 |                     ProgressView()
 137 |                         .controlSize(.small)
 138 |                     Text("处理中...")
 139 |                         .font(.system(size: 14))
 140 |                         .foregroundStyle(HUDTheme.textSecondary)
 141 |                 }
 142 |             } else if state.phase == .thinking || state.phase == .success {
 143 |                 // 思考中状态：文字模糊效果 + 提示
 144 |                 // Success 状态下也保持这个布局，但提示语可能会变
 145 |                 VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: 8) {
 146 |                     if !state.partialText.isEmpty {
 147 |                         Text(state.partialText)
 148 |                             .font(.system(size: 14))
 149 |                             .foregroundStyle(state.phase == .success ? HUDTheme.textPrimary : Color.white.opacity(0.5)) // 成功后变亮
 150 |                             .lineSpacing(4)
 151 |                             .blur(radius: state.phase == .thinking ? 2 : 0) // 思考时模糊，成功后清晰
 152 |                             .animation(.easeInOut(duration: 0.3), value: state.phase)
 153 |                     }
 154 |                     
 155 |                     if state.phase == .thinking {
 156 |                         HStack(spacing: 6) {
 157 |                             ThinkingIndicator()
 158 |                             Text("AI 思考中...")
 159 |                                 .font(.system(size: 13))
 160 |                                 .foregroundStyle(HUDTheme.textPrimary)
 161 |                         }
 162 |                         .transition(.opacity)
 163 |                     }
 164 |                 }
 165 |             } else {
 166 |                 Text("正在聆听...")
 167 |                     .font(.system(size: 14))
 168 |                     .foregroundStyle(Color.white.opacity(0.5))
 169 |             }
 170 |         }
 171 |         .padding(.horizontal, 16)
 172 |         .padding(.top, 16)
 173 |         .padding(.bottom, 12)
 174 |         .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, alignment: .leading)
 175 |     }

 192 |                     .frame(width: 20, height: 20)

 198 |                 brandLabel

 301 |         newLevels.removeFirst()
 302 |         newLevels.append(level)

 310 | // MARK: - Visual Effect Background (毛玻璃)
 311 | 
 312 | struct VisualEffectBackground: NSViewRepresentable {
 313 |     let material: NSVisualEffectView.Material
 314 |     let blendingMode: NSVisualEffectView.BlendingMode
 315 |     
 316 |     func makeNSView(context: Context) -> NSVisualEffectView {
 317 |         let view = NSVisualEffectView()
 318 |         view.material = material
 319 |         view.blendingMode = blendingMode
 320 |         view.state = .active
 321 |         return view
 322 |     }
 323 |     
 324 |     func updateNSView(_ nsView: NSVisualEffectView, context: Context) {
 325 |         nsView.material = material
 326 |         nsView.blendingMode = blendingMode
 327 |     }
 328 | }

 330 | // MARK: - Scrolling Waveform
 331 | 
 332 | struct ScrollingWaveform: View {
 333 |     let levels: [Float]
 334 |     
 335 |     var body: some View {
 336 |         HStack(alignment: .center, spacing: 2) {
 337 |             ForEach(Array(levels.enumerated()), id: \.offset) { index, level in
 338 |                 Capsule()
 339 |                     .fill(barColor(for: index))
 340 |                     // 动态高度：即使音量很小，也给一个基础波动
 341 |                     .frame(width: 2, height: barHeight(for: level))
 342 |             }
 343 |         }
 344 |     }
 345 |     
 346 |     private func barHeight(for level: Float) -> CGFloat {
 347 |         let minH: CGFloat = 4
 348 |         let maxH: CGFloat = 20 // 增加最大高度
 349 |         
 350 |         // 非线性映射：让小音量也能有明显的高度
 351 |         // pow(level, 0.7) 会提升小数值的权重
 352 |         let adjustedLevel = CGFloat(pow(Double(level), 0.7))
 353 |         
 354 |         return minH + adjustedLevel * (maxH - minH)
 355 |     }
 356 |     
 357 |     private func barColor(for index: Int) -> Color {
 358 |         let count = levels.count
 359 |         // 让右侧（最新）的波纹更亮更红
 360 |         let progress = Double(index) / Double(count - 1)
 361 |         // 增加一点不透明度
 362 |         return Color.red.opacity(0.4 + 0.6 * progress)
 363 |     }
 364 | }
 365 | 
 366 | // MARK: - Status Indicator (Spinner -> Checkmark)
 367 | 
 368 | struct StatusIndicator: View {
 369 |     /// 当前状态：true = thinking (spinner), false = success (checkmark)
 370 |     let isThinking: Bool
 371 |     
 372 |     @State private var checkmarkScale: CGFloat = 0
 373 |     @State private var rotation: Double = 0
 374 |     
 375 |     // 彩色点的颜色
 376 |     private let dotColors: [Color] = [
 377 |         Color(red: 0.3, green: 0.5, blue: 1.0),   // 蓝
 378 |         Color(red: 0.5, green: 0.3, blue: 1.0),   // 紫蓝
 379 |         Color(red: 0.8, green: 0.3, blue: 0.9),   // 紫
 380 |         Color(red: 1.0, green: 0.4, blue: 0.7),   // 粉
 381 |         Color(red: 1.0, green: 0.5, blue: 0.4),   // 橙红
 382 |         Color(red: 0.3, green: 0.7, blue: 0.9),   // 青
 383 |     ]
 384 |     
 385 |     var body: some View {
 386 |         ZStack {
 387 |             if isThinking {
 388 |                 // 彩色点旋转
 389 |                 ZStack {
 390 |                     ForEach(0..<6, id: \.self) { index in
 391 |                         Circle()
 392 |                             .fill(dotColors[index])
 393 |                             .frame(width: 4, height: 4)
 394 |                             .offset(y: -7) // 半径
 395 |                             .rotationEffect(.degrees(Double(index) * 60))
 396 |                     }
 397 |                 }
 398 |                 .rotationEffect(.degrees(rotation))
 399 |             } else {
 400 |                 // 成功对号
 401 |                 Image(systemName: "checkmark")
 402 |                     .font(.system(size: 11, weight: .bold))
 403 |                     .foregroundStyle(.green)
 404 |                     .scaleEffect(checkmarkScale)
 405 |             }
 406 |         }
 407 |         .frame(width: 18, height: 18)
 408 |         .onAppear {
 409 |             if isThinking {
 410 |                 startSpinner()
 411 |             }
 412 |         }
 413 |         .onChange(of: isThinking) { wasThinking, nowThinking in
 414 |             if wasThinking && !nowThinking {
 415 |                 // 转到成功状态
 416 |                 withAnimation(.spring(response: 0.4, dampingFraction: 0.6)) {
 417 |                     checkmarkScale = 1
 418 |                 }
 419 |             } else if nowThinking {
 420 |                 // 重置到思考状态
 421 |                 checkmarkScale = 0
 422 |                 rotation = 0
 423 |                 startSpinner()
 424 |             }
 425 |         }
 426 |     }
 427 |     
 428 |     private func startSpinner() {
 429 |         withAnimation(.linear(duration: 1.5).repeatForever(autoreverses: false)) {
 430 |             rotation = 360
 431 |         }
 432 |     }
 433 | }
 434 | 
 435 | // MARK: - Thinking Indicator (文字旁的小动画)
 436 | 
 437 | struct ThinkingIndicator: View {
 438 |     @State private var isAnimating = false
 439 |     
 440 |     var body: some View {
 441 |         HStack(spacing: 3) {
 442 |             ForEach(0..<3) { index in
 443 |                 Circle()
 444 |                     .fill(Color.white.opacity(0.8))
 445 |                     .frame(width: 4, height: 4)
 446 |                     .scaleEffect(isAnimating ? 1.0 : 0.5)
 447 |                     .animation(
 448 |                         .easeInOut(duration: 0.6)
 449 |                         .repeatForever()
 450 |                         .delay(Double(index) * 0.2),
 451 |                         value: isAnimating
 452 |                     )
 453 |             }
 454 |         }
 455 |         .onAppear {
 456 |             isAnimating = true
 457 |         }
 458 |     }
 459 | }

   4 | /// 悬浮面板 - 不抢夺焦点的置顶窗口
   5 | /// 用于显示录音状态胶囊
   6 | final class FloatingPanel: NSPanel {
   7 |     
   8 |     override var canBecomeKey: Bool { false }
   9 |     override var canBecomeMain: Bool { false }
  10 |     
  11 |     init(contentRect: NSRect) {
  12 |         super.init(
  13 |             contentRect: contentRect,
  14 |             styleMask: [.borderless, .nonactivatingPanel],
  15 |             backing: .buffered,
  16 |             defer: false
  17 |         )
  18 |         
  19 |         configure()
  20 |     }
  21 |     
  22 |     private func configure() {
  23 |         // 窗口层级：悬浮在普通窗口之上
  24 |         level = .floating
  25 |         
  26 |         // 透明背景
  27 |         isOpaque = false
  28 |         backgroundColor = .clear
  29 |         
  30 |         // 不在 Dock/Mission Control 显示
  31 |         collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary, .transient]
  32 |         
  33 |         // 动画
  34 |         animationBehavior = .utilityWindow
  35 |         
  36 |         // 圆角
  37 |         isMovableByWindowBackground = false
  38 |         hasShadow = false // 禁用系统阴影，防止出现方框黑影
  39 |     }
  40 |     
  41 |     /// 定位到屏幕底部中央（固定位置，内容向上扩展）
  42 |     func positionAtBottomCenter() {
  43 |         guard let screen = NSScreen.main else { return }
  44 |         
  45 |         let screenFrame = screen.visibleFrame
  46 |         let panelWidth = frame.width
  47 |         
  48 |         let x = screenFrame.midX - panelWidth / 2
  49 |         // 底部固定，距离底部 80pt
  50 |         let y = screenFrame.minY + 80
  51 |         
  52 |         setFrameOrigin(NSPoint(x: x, y: y))
  53 |     }
  54 | }
  55 | 
  56 | // MARK: - Quick Ask Panel
  57 | 
  58 | /// Quick Ask 悬浮面板 - 可以接收键盘输入
  59 | /// 用于 Quick Ask 输入交互
  60 | /// 改为继承 NSWindow 以获得系统级的一等公民待遇，彻底解决输入法问题
  61 | final class QuickAskPanel: NSWindow {
  62 |     
  63 |     // 允许接收键盘输入和成为主窗口
  64 |     override var canBecomeKey: Bool { true }
  65 |     override var canBecomeMain: Bool { true }
  66 |     
  67 |     init(contentRect: NSRect) {
  68 |         // 关键修复：使用 .titled | .fullSizeContentView 来欺骗系统，获得完整的输入法支持
  69 |         super.init(
  70 |             contentRect: contentRect,
  71 |             // .titled + .fullSizeContentView 是让 InputContext 正常工作的关键
  72 |             styleMask: [.titled, .fullSizeContentView, .resizable], 
  73 |             backing: .buffered,
  74 |             defer: false
  75 |         )
  76 |         
  77 |         configure()
  78 |     }
  79 |     
  80 |     private func configure() {
  81 |         // 窗口层级：悬浮在普通窗口之上
  82 |         level = .floating
  83 |         
  84 |         // 透明背景
  85 |         isOpaque = false
  86 |         backgroundColor = .clear
  87 |         
  88 |         // 关键配置：隐藏标题栏但保留 .titled 属性
  89 |         titlebarAppearsTransparent = true
  90 |         titleVisibility = .hidden
  91 |         
  92 |         // 禁用系统标准窗口按钮
  93 |         standardWindowButton(.closeButton)?.isHidden = true
  94 |         standardWindowButton(.miniaturizeButton)?.isHidden = true
  95 |         standardWindowButton(.zoomButton)?.isHidden = true
  96 |         
  97 |         // 不在 Dock/Mission Control 显示
  98 |         collectionBehavior = [.canJoinAllSpaces, .fullScreenAuxiliary, .transient, .ignoresCycle]
  99 |         
 100 |         // 动画
 101 |         animationBehavior = .utilityWindow
 102 |         
 103 |         // 允许通过背景拖动
 104 |         isMovableByWindowBackground = true
 105 |         
 106 |         // 禁用阴影
 107 |         hasShadow = false
 108 |     }
 109 |     
 110 |     /// 定位到屏幕底部中央
 111 |     func positionAtBottomCenter() {
 112 |         guard let screen = NSScreen.main else { return }
 113 |         
 114 |         let screenFrame = screen.visibleFrame
 115 |         let panelWidth = frame.width
 116 |         
 117 |         let x = screenFrame.midX - panelWidth / 2
 118 |         let y = screenFrame.minY + 80
 119 |         
 120 |         setFrameOrigin(NSPoint(x: x, y: y))
 121 |     }
 122 |     
 123 |     // 处理 ESC 键
 124 |     override func cancelOperation(_ sender: Any?) {
 125 |         // 发送取消通知
 126 |         NotificationCenter.default.post(name: .quickAskCancelRequested, object: nil)
 127 |     }
 128 | }
 129 | 
 130 | // MARK: - Notifications
 131 | 
 132 | extension Notification.Name {
 133 |     static let quickAskCancelRequested = Notification.Name("QuickAskCancelRequested")
 134 | }

  25 |     var onCancel: (() -> Void)?
  26 |     
  27 |     /// 拖拽状态

  56 |             .background(

  59 |                     VisualEffectBackground(material: .hudWindow, blendingMode: .behindWindow)
  60 |                     
  61 |                     // 深色叠加
  62 |                     Color.black.opacity(0.3)

  65 |                     if state.phase == .recording {

 144 |     /// 尝试设置 FirstResponder，最多重试 5 次
 145 |     private func tryMakeFirstResponder(_ textView: QuickAskNSTextView, attempt: Int) {
 146 |         guard attempt <= 5 else {
 147 |             print("📝 ⚠️ Failed to make firstResponder after 5 attempts")
 148 |             return
 149 |         }
 150 |         
 151 |         guard let window = textView.window else {
 152 |             // 窗口还没准备好，延迟重试
 153 |             DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.05 * Double(attempt)) {
 154 |                 self.tryMakeFirstResponder(textView, attempt: attempt + 1)
 155 |             }
 156 |             return
 157 |         }
 158 |         
 159 |         // 🔥 等待窗口成为 key window（输入法需要）
 160 |         if !window.isKeyWindow {
 161 |             print("📝 ⏳ Waiting for window to become key (attempt \(attempt))...")
 162 |             DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.1) {
 163 |                 self.tryMakeFirstResponder(textView, attempt: attempt + 1)
 164 |             }
 165 |             return
 166 |         }
 167 |         
 168 |         let result = window.makeFirstResponder(textView)
 169 |         print("📝 makeFirstResponder attempt \(attempt): result=\(result), isKeyWindow=\(window.isKeyWindow), isMainWindow=\(window.isMainWindow)")
 170 |         
 171 |         if !result {
 172 |             // 设置失败，延迟重试
 173 |             DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.1) {
 174 |                 self.tryMakeFirstResponder(textView, attempt: attempt + 1)
 175 |             }
 176 |         } else {
 177 |             // 🔥 成功后再次确认输入法上下文已激活
 178 |             if let inputContext = textView.inputContext {
 179 |                 inputContext.activate()
 180 |                 print("📝 ✅ InputContext activated after focus")
 181 |             }
 182 |         }
 183 |     }

 391 |         // 其他命令默认处理
 392 |         super.doCommand(by: selector)
 393 |     }
 394 |     
 395 |     /// 捕获 ⌘V 等快捷键
 396 |     override func performKeyEquivalent(with event: NSEvent) -> Bool {
 397 |         if event.modifierFlags.contains(.command) {
 398 |             switch event.charactersIgnoringModifiers {
 399 |             case "v":
 400 |                 // ⌘V: 粘贴
 401 |                 paste(nil)
 402 |                 return true
 403 |             case "c":
 404 |                 // ⌘C: 复制
 405 |                 copy(nil)
 406 |                 return true
 407 |             case "x":
 408 |                 // ⌘X: 剪切
 409 |                 cut(nil)
 410 |                 return true
 411 |             case "a":
 412 |                 // ⌘A: 全选
 413 |                 selectAll(nil)
 414 |                 return true
 415 |             default:
 416 |                 break
 417 |             }
 418 |         }
 419 |         return super.performKeyEquivalent(with: event)
 420 |     }
 421 |     
 422 |     override func paste(_ sender: Any?) {
 423 |         let pasteboard = NSPasteboard.general
 424 |         
 425 |         // 1. 优先检查 TIFF 数据（macOS 截图格式）
 426 |         if let tiffData = pasteboard.data(forType: .tiff),
 427 |            let image = NSImage(data: tiffData) {
 428 |             onPasteImage?(image)
 429 |             return
 430 |         }
 431 |         
 432 |         // 2. 检查 PNG 数据
 433 |         if let pngData = pasteboard.data(forType: .png),
 434 |            let image = NSImage(data: pngData) {
 435 |             onPasteImage?(image)
 436 |             return
 437 |         }
 438 |         
 439 |         // 3. 通用图片对象检查
 440 |         if let image = pasteboard.readObjects(forClasses: [NSImage.self], options: nil)?.first as? NSImage {
 441 |             onPasteImage?(image)
 442 |             return
 443 |         }
 444 |         
 445 |         // 4. 检查图片文件 URL
 446 |         if let urls = pasteboard.readObjects(forClasses: [NSURL.self], options: [.urlReadingFileURLsOnly: true]) as? [URL] {
 447 |             for url in urls {
 448 |                 if let uti = UTType(filenameExtension: url.pathExtension),
 449 |                    uti.conforms(to: .image),
 450 |                    let image = NSImage(contentsOf: url) {
 451 |                     onPasteImage?(image)
 452 |                     return
 453 |                 }
 454 |             }
 455 |         }
 456 |         
 457 |         // 5. 普通文本粘贴
 458 |         super.paste(sender)
 459 |     }
 460 |     
 461 |     override func draw(_ dirtyRect: NSRect) {
 462 |         super.draw(dirtyRect)
 463 |         
 464 |         // 绘制 placeholder
 465 |         if string.isEmpty && !placeholderString.isEmpty {
 466 |             let attributes: [NSAttributedString.Key: Any] = [
 467 |                 .font: NSFont.systemFont(ofSize: 14),
 468 |                 .foregroundColor: HUDTheme.NS.textPlaceholder
 469 |             ]
 470 |             let placeholderRect = NSRect(x: textContainerInset.width, y: textContainerInset.height, width: bounds.width, height: bounds.height)
 471 |             placeholderString.draw(in: placeholderRect, withAttributes: attributes)
 472 |         }
 473 |     }
 474 | }

 489 | }
